# Generated by eu5autobuild.generator.
eu5ab_sync_cmf_action_bar_toggle = {
	cmm_for_each_list_item = {
		setting = cmf_core__action_bar_buttons
		effect = eu5ab_sync_cmf_action_bar_toggle_item
	}
}

eu5ab_sync_cmf_action_bar_toggle_item = {
	if = {
		# Consume the iterator's setting/i contract and reject rows without an attached value;
		# CMF's temporary value scope may still refer to the preceding row.
		limit = { has_variable_list = $setting$_i$i$_value scope:cmm_list_current_item_value = flag:eu5ab_action_bar }
		if = {
			limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = cmf_action_bar_active_elements target = flag:eu5ab_action_bar } }
			cmm_set_list_field_value = { mod_id = cmf_core setting_id = action_bar_buttons field_id = active item = $i$ value = 1 }
		}
		else = { cmm_set_list_field_value = { mod_id = cmf_core setting_id = action_bar_buttons field_id = active item = $i$ value = 0 } }
	}
}

eu5ab_rebuild_candidate_priority = {
	cmm_build_list_ordered_values = { setting = eu5ab_regional_development__candidate_priority list_name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features }
	# Saved games without an initialized CMM list retain deterministic defaults.
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_upgrade value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_expand value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo value = 3 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_new value = 4 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features }
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_country
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter value = 0 }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_feature
			scope:eu5ab_priority_country = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter add = 1 }
				switch = {
					trigger = scope:eu5ab_priority_feature
					flag:eu5ab_feature_upgrade_building = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_upgrade value = var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter } }
					flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_building = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_expand value = var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter } }
					flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_rgo = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_rgo value = var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter } }
					flag:eu5ab_feature_new_building = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_priority_new value = var:eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter } }
				}
			}
		}
		remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_priority_counter
	}
}

eu5ab_recalculate_budget_limit = {
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_budget_mode = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = eu5ab_manual_value_global_fixed_annual_budget }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_budget_mode = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = {
			value = monthly_income_total
			multiply = 4
		} }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_budget_mode = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = {
			value = monthly_income_total
			multiply = 6
		} }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_budget_mode = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = {
			value = monthly_income_total
			multiply = 8
		} }
	}
	else = {
		# Defensive fallback for settings saved by an incompatible CMM version.
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = {
			value = monthly_income_total
			multiply = 6
		} }
	}
}

# Persistent twenty-bucket location registry. Policy application and owner
# changes maintain it incrementally; monthly scans never rebuild all locations.
eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = {
 eu5ab_profile_remember_location = yes
	eu5ab_sync_location_template_coverage = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket } }
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_registry_location
		owner = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment value = 0 } }
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment add = 1 }
			if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment > 20 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment value = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_registry_schema_version value = 1 }
			scope:eu5ab_registry_location = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment } }
			switch = {
				trigger = var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment
				1 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				2 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_2_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				3 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_3_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				4 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_4_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				5 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_5_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				6 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_6_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				7 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_7_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				8 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_8_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				9 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_9_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				10 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_10_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				11 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_11_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				12 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_12_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				13 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_13_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				14 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_14_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				15 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_15_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				16 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_16_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				17 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_17_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				18 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_18_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				19 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_19_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				20 = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
			}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_unregister_location_from_scan = {
	owner ?= { eu5ab_ensure_template_coverage = yes }
	eu5ab_remove_location_template_coverage = yes
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket }
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_registry_location
		owner = {
			switch = {
				trigger = scope:eu5ab_registry_location.var:eu5ab_scan_bucket
				1 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				2 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_2_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				3 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_3_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				4 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_4_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				5 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_5_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				6 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_6_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				7 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_7_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				8 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_8_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				9 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_9_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				10 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_10_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				11 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_11_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				12 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_12_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				13 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_13_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				14 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_14_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				15 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_15_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				16 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_16_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				17 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_17_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				18 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_18_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				19 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_19_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
				20 = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations target = scope:eu5ab_registry_location } }
			}
		}
		remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket
	}
}

# wrote policy bindings without registering their locations in the buckets.
eu5ab_rebuild_scan_registry_v1 = {
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_2_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_3_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_4_locations

	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_15_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_16_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_17_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_18_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_19_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_assignment
	every_owned_location = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket
			eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = yes
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_registry_schema_version value = 1 }
}

	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_priority
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_score
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_need
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_economic
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_labor_jobs
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_labor_current
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_labor_projected
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_rgo_price_factor
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_rgo_pending_factor
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_rgo_pending_quantity
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_rgo_pending_limit
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_rgo_market_gap
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_rgo_labor_factor
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_reason
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_location
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_building
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_kind
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_priority
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_score
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_need
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_economic
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_labor_jobs
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_labor_current
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_labor_projected
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_rgo_price_factor
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_rgo_pending_factor
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_rgo_pending_quantity
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_rgo_pending_limit
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_rgo_market_gap
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_rgo_labor_factor
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_reason
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_location
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_building
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_kind
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_priority
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_score
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_need
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_economic
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_labor_jobs
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_labor_current
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_labor_projected
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_rgo_price_factor
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_rgo_pending_factor
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_rgo_pending_quantity
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_rgo_pending_limit
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_rgo_market_gap
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_rgo_labor_factor
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_reason
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_score value = -1000000 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_score value = -1000000 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_3_score value = -1000000 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_priority value = 999 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_priority value = 999 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_3_priority value = 999 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_monthly_build_hard_cap } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_hard_cap value = 9 }
	}
	# Snapshot performance settings once. Mid-run changes apply next month.
	# Snapshot the CMM setting only at scan start.
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_backfill_enabled
	if = { limit = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_candidate_backfill_enabled > 0 } set_variable = eu5ab_scan_backfill_enabled }
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_triggered
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_checked
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_input_rejected
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_output_rejected
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_stage_failed
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_budget_exhausted
	remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_upstream_rechecks

	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_max_additions value = eu5ab_manual_value_global_max_additions_per_run }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_early_stop value = eu5ab_manual_value_global_early_stop_when_candidates_sufficient }
	clamp_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit min = 1 max = 30 }
	clamp_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_max_additions min = 0 max = 600 }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_computing }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_max_additions value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_early_stop value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_parallel value = 1 } }
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_active_project_locations_next
	# Count only locations indexed after this Mod confirmed a project.
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_active_project_country
	every_in_list = {
		variable = eu5ab_active_project_locations
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_active_project_location
		if = {
			limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_active_project_country has_variable_list = eu5ab_active_building_types }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_active_building_types
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
				scope:eu5ab_active_project_location = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location eu5ab_refresh_active_building_type = yes }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_active_project_country has_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction }
			if = {
				# Population/workforce capacity is not construction completion.
				# Keep confirmed attribution while the exact RGO queue is unknown.
				limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgos_under_construction = 0 } }
				owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects add = 1 } }
			}
			else = { remove_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				owner = scope:eu5ab_active_project_country
				OR = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_active_building_types has_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_active_project_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations_next target = scope:eu5ab_active_project_location } }
		}
	}
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_active_project_locations
	every_in_list = {
		variable = eu5ab_active_project_locations_next
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_active_project_location
		scope:eu5ab_active_project_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_active_project_location } }
	}
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_active_project_locations_next
	# Persistent scan buckets are maintained when a policy is applied or a
	# location changes owner. No all-owned-location rebuild occurs here.
	# The slider is extra concurrent capacity: 0 means one total slot, 599 means 600.
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota value = eu5ab_manual_value_monthly_build_hard_cap }
	change_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota > 600 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota value = 600 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_base_quota value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
	change_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota subtract = var:eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects }
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_max_additions > 0 var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota > { value = var:eu5ab_scan_max_additions } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota value = var:eu5ab_scan_max_additions }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects >= { value = var:eu5ab_diag_base_quota } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_concurrent_limit_state value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_diag_run_state = 0 var:eu5ab_diag_concurrent_limit_state = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_run_state value = 2 }
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_final_quota value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
	eu5ab_update_scan_candidate_target = yes
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_budget value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
	change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_budget multiply = 8 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget > 600 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_budget value = 600 }
	}
	# The daily limit controls pacing, not the round's search coverage.
	# Remaining locations are dispatched by the existing bounded refill.
	# Preserve the minimum deep budget for small quotas; early stop may still
	# prevent later buckets from dispatching workers in this scan.
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget < 20 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_budget value = 20 } }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts value = 0 }
	eu5ab_prepare_engine_candidate_queue = yes
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota > 0 }
		# Rotate only when a scan starts, not on quota-zero checks or daily events.
		# Persist the start across loads so early buckets cannot monopolize every run.
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_start_bucket } var:eu5ab_scan_start_bucket < 1 var:eu5ab_scan_start_bucket >= 20 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_start_bucket value = 1 }
		}
		else = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_start_bucket add = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_day value = 1 }
		set_variable = eu5ab_scan_active
		set_variable = eu5ab_scan_round_active
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 2 }
		# Queue preparation also performs stale-state cleanup, but an empty
		# check must not be displayed as a prepared construction queue.
		remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_queue_state
	}
}

		if = {

			eu5ab_capture_rgo_pending_diagnostics = yes
			eu5ab_stage_rgo_candidate = yes
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_market_need_present = yes } }
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_fail_market_need add = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_score_allowed = yes } }
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_fail_score add = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_pending_allowed = yes } }
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_fail_pending_limit add = 1 }
			eu5ab_capture_rgo_pending_diagnostics = yes
		}
		else = {
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_rgo_eligible add = 1 }
			eu5ab_capture_rgo_pending_diagnostics = yes
			# RGO participates in the same per-location diagnostic choice as buildings.
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_diag_priority value = owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo }
			if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_diag_priority add = 4 } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind }
						var:eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority > { value = var:eu5ab_rgo_diag_priority }
					}
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_score
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_need

				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_labor_current

				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_rgo_price_factor
				remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_top_1_rgo_pending_factor

				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_kind value = 2 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_top_1_priority value = var:eu5ab_rgo_diag_priority }

		}
		eu5ab_clear_rgo_screening = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_pending_failure_cooldown }

# Build one transient view for the template currently opened in the scope window.
# The previous implementation recalculated 20 slots and every preset on each click.
eu5ab_prepare_template_scope_view = {
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_location_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_province_count value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_area_count value = 0 }
	every_owned_location = {
		remove_variable = eu5ab_scope_view_selected
		if = {
			limit = { root = { var:eu5ab_scope_view_mode = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot }
				if = {
					limit = { var:eu5ab_template_slot = root.var:eu5ab_scope_view_value }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_view_selected value = 1 }
					root = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_location_count add = 1 } }
				}
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { root = { var:eu5ab_scope_view_mode = 2 } }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_slot } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
					if = {
						limit = { var:eu5ab_policy_id = root.var:eu5ab_scope_view_value }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_view_selected value = 1 }
						root = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_location_count add = 1 } }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scope_view_selected }
			province = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_list = eu5ab_scope_selected_provinces } }
					add_to_temporary_list = eu5ab_scope_selected_provinces
				}
			}
			area = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { is_in_list = eu5ab_scope_selected_areas } }
					add_to_temporary_list = eu5ab_scope_selected_areas
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# Count only the deduplicated parents reached from selected owned locations.
	# This replaces the former every_province/every_area world scans.
	every_in_list = {
		list = eu5ab_scope_selected_provinces
		root = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_province_count add = 1 } }
	}
	every_in_list = {
		list = eu5ab_scope_selected_areas
		root = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scope_area_count add = 1 } }
	}
}

eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_target_location = {
	scope:actor ?= {
		eu5ab_template_slot_1_ensure_defaults = yes
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_saved } }
			eu5ab_template_slot_1_save = yes
		}
	}
	scope:target_location ?= {
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_policy_id value = 100 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_template_slot value = 1 }
		remove_variable = eu5ab_policy_decoupled
		eu5ab_register_location_for_scan = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_target_province = {
	scope:target_province ?= {
		every_location_in_province = {
			limit = { owner ?= scope:actor }
			save_scope_as = target_location
			scope:actor ?= { eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_target_location = yes }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_target_area = {
	scope:target_area ?= {
		every_location_in_area = {
			limit = { owner ?= scope:actor }
			save_scope_as = target_location
			scope:actor ?= { eu5ab_apply_template_slot_1_to_target_location = yes }
		}
	}
}

			scope:actor ?= { eu5ab_apply_template_slot_12_to_target_location = yes }
		}
	}

eu5ab_scan_regional_development_bucket = { if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes } }

	eu5ab_record_scan_date = yes
	# Previous workers have merged before this country-only refresh.
	eu5ab_refresh_rgo_pending = yes
	eu5ab_ensure_build_pending = yes
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_scan_country
	# Keep the event's day counter independent of the rotated physical bucket.
	# Missing start state retains the legacy day-to-bucket mapping.
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_index value = var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_day }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_start_bucket }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_index add = var:eu5ab_scan_start_bucket }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_index subtract = 1 }
	}
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_index > 20 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_bucket_index subtract = 20 } }
	# Per-call scratch state; never carry a stop decision into a new scan.
	remove_variable = eu5ab_bucket_dispatch_stopped
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget value = { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget divide = 21 ceiling = yes } }
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget > { value = var:eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget value = var:eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit } }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_index = 1 }
		# Only the global budget/reserve stop is permanent for this scan.
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { eu5ab_scan_attempt_count >= { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } AND = { eu5ab_scan_early_stop_value > 0 eu5ab_scan_reserve_count >= { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
			# Ordered dispatch reads each member's owner. Preserve legacy behavior
			# if a stale bucket contains a location belonging to another country.
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { any_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations NOT = { owner = scope:eu5ab_scan_country } } } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bucket_dispatch_stopped value = 1 }
			}
		}
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations
			limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_scan_country has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_build_cooldown subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_build_cooldown <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_failure_cooldown <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_recent_build_penalty <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
					eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				}
				owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_preliminary_passed add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_wait_months } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_wait_months value = 0 } }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_wait_months add = 1 }
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				owner = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } }
				# Cache after cooldown and waiting updates so both mutually exclusive
				# sorts observe exactly the same daily score as before.
				if = {
					limit = { scope:eu5ab_scan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bucket_dispatch_stopped } } }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bucket_need_score value = eu5ab_location_need_score }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bucket_dispatch_stopped } }
			ordered_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations
				limit = {
					has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
					eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
					eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
					eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes
				}
				order_by = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score
				max = 30
				check_range_bounds = no
				if = {
					limit = { owner = { eu5ab_scan_daily_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget } eu5ab_scan_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } OR = { eu5ab_scan_early_stop_value <= 0 eu5ab_scan_reserve_count < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
					save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score value = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score }
					owner = {
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
						remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_deep_scored add = 1 }
					}
					remove_variable = eu5ab_wait_months
					eu5ab_prepare_backfill_dispatch = yes
					owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					eu5ab_request_building_capacity = yes
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations
				limit = {
					has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
					eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
					eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
					NOT = { eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
				}
				order_by = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score
				max = 30
				check_range_bounds = no
				if = {
					limit = { owner = { eu5ab_scan_daily_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget } eu5ab_scan_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } OR = { eu5ab_scan_early_stop_value <= 0 eu5ab_scan_reserve_count < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
					save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score value = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score }
					owner = {
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
						remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_deep_scored add = 1 }
					}
					remove_variable = eu5ab_wait_months
					eu5ab_prepare_backfill_dispatch = yes
					owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					eu5ab_request_building_capacity = yes
				}
			}
		}
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_1_locations
			remove_variable = eu5ab_bucket_need_score
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_bucket_index = 2 }
		# Only the global budget/reserve stop is permanent for this scan.
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { eu5ab_scan_attempt_count >= { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } AND = { eu5ab_scan_early_stop_value > 0 eu5ab_scan_reserve_count >= { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
			# Ordered dispatch reads each member's owner. Preserve legacy behavior
			# if a stale bucket contains a location belonging to another country.
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { any_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_2_locations NOT = { owner = scope:eu5ab_scan_country } } } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bucket_dispatch_stopped value = 1 }
			}
		}
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_2_locations
			limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_scan_country has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_build_cooldown subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_build_cooldown <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_failure_cooldown <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty subtract = 1 } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_recent_build_penalty <= 0 } remove_variable = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty } }
			if = {
				limit = {
					eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
					eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				}
				owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_preliminary_passed add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_wait_months } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_wait_months value = 0 } }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_wait_months add = 1 }
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				owner = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } }
				# Cache after cooldown and waiting updates so both mutually exclusive
				# sorts observe exactly the same daily score as before.
				if = {
					limit = { scope:eu5ab_scan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bucket_dispatch_stopped } } }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bucket_need_score value = eu5ab_location_need_score }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bucket_dispatch_stopped } }
			ordered_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_2_locations
				limit = {
					has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
					eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
					eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }

					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				}
				owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_preliminary_passed add = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_wait_months } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_wait_months value = 0 } }
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_wait_months add = 1 }
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				owner = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } }
				# Cache after cooldown and waiting updates so both mutually exclusive
				# sorts observe exactly the same daily score as before.
				if = {
					limit = { scope:eu5ab_scan_country = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bucket_dispatch_stopped } } }
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bucket_need_score value = eu5ab_location_need_score }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bucket_dispatch_stopped } }
			ordered_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations
				limit = {
					has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
					eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
					eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
					eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes
				}
				order_by = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score
				max = 30
				check_range_bounds = no
				if = {
					limit = { owner = { eu5ab_scan_daily_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget } eu5ab_scan_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } OR = { eu5ab_scan_early_stop_value <= 0 eu5ab_scan_reserve_count < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
					save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score value = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score }
					owner = {
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
						remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_deep_scored add = 1 }
					}
					remove_variable = eu5ab_wait_months
					eu5ab_prepare_backfill_dispatch = yes
					owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					eu5ab_request_building_capacity = yes
				}
			}
			ordered_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations
				limit = {
					has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
					eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
					eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
					NOT = { eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
				}
				order_by = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score
				max = 30
				check_range_bounds = no
				if = {
					limit = { owner = { eu5ab_scan_daily_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget } eu5ab_scan_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } OR = { eu5ab_scan_early_stop_value <= 0 eu5ab_scan_reserve_count < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
					save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score value = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score }
					owner = {
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
						remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_deep_scored add = 1 }
					}
					remove_variable = eu5ab_wait_months
					eu5ab_prepare_backfill_dispatch = yes
					owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
					eu5ab_request_building_capacity = yes
				}
			}
		}
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_20_locations
			remove_variable = eu5ab_bucket_need_score
		}
	}
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_index
	remove_variable = eu5ab_bucket_dispatch_stopped
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_parallel <= 0 } eu5ab_merge_location_worker_results = yes }
	remove_variable = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget
	remove_variable = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts

}
}

eu5ab_finish_regional_development_scan = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations }
		set_variable = eu5ab_scan_finalizing eu5ab_count_capacity_waiting = yes
		trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.2 days = 1 }
	}
	else = {
	# EU5 drops variables set to zero; persist non-zero snapshot states for GUI reads.
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_run_state } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_run_state value = 5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 2 } }
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_active
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_day
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_diag_run_state = 0 var:eu5ab_diag_covered_locations <= 0 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_run_state value = 1 } }
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_diag_run_state = 0 var:eu5ab_diag_preliminary_passed <= 0 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_run_state value = 4 } }
	# The final reducer has selected the displayed Top-3. Hydrate expensive
	# building-only diagnostic details once per displayed candidate.
	eu5ab_hydrate_final_building_diagnostics = yes
	eu5ab_start_engine_candidate_queue = yes
	}
}

# Called once per completed worker with candidates; count each location once.
eu5ab_record_scan_candidate_location = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_candidate_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_scan_candidate_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_candidate_reserve }
            change_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_candidate_reserve add = 1 }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_candidate_reserve value = 1 } }
    }
}

eu5ab_update_scan_candidate_target = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_acceptance_rate } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_acceptance_rate value = 0.5 } }
    # Bound the estimate, never the validation gates. Zero successes still have
    # a finite target and all work remains bounded by the original deep budget.
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_acceptance_rate value = { value = var:eu5ab_scan_acceptance_rate min = 0.05 max = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_candidate_target value = { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota subtract = eu5ab_scan_started_count min = 0 divide = var:eu5ab_scan_acceptance_rate ceiling = yes } }
}

eu5ab_clear_scan_continuation = {
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_candidate_locations
    remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_round_active
    remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_active
    remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_backfill_enabled
    remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_last_attempt
    remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_stall_days
}

eu5ab_complete_scan_round = {
    eu5ab_clear_scan_continuation = yes
}

eu5ab_settle_scan_candidate_batch = { if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes } }

    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = eu5ab_scan_round_active
            eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
            NOT = { var:eu5ab_diag_queue_state = 5 }
            eu5ab_scan_started_count < { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
        }
        # Exhausted queues have visited all their candidate locations. Sum unique
        # locations, not building probes; retries and RGO cannot inflate capacity.
        if = {
            limit = { eu5ab_scan_reserve_count > 0 }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_settled_locations value = { value = eu5ab_scan_settled_count add = eu5ab_scan_reserve_count } }
            # One success and one failure of smoothing prevent small samples
            # from oscillating between a zero and a perfect acceptance rate.
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_acceptance_rate value = { value = eu5ab_scan_started_count add = 1 divide = { value = var:eu5ab_scan_settled_locations add = 2 } min = 0.05 max = 1 } }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_manual_value_global_enabled > 0
                eu5ab_scan_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget }
                has_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations
            }
            set_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_active
            # Always dispatch on a new day. Finishing a GUI batch must not reset
            # the current day's worker allowance or the round's total allowance.
            trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.3 days = 1 }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_active } } eu5ab_complete_scan_round = yes }

}
}

# Initial scanning is bounded to days 2-22; GUI execution has its own watchdog.
# Continuation needs a separate bound: an empty retry consumes no deep budget.
eu5ab_check_scan_refill_progress = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_last_attempt } }
        # Offset the snapshot so even zero completed work survives serialization.
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_refill_last_attempt value = { value = eu5ab_scan_attempt_count add = 1 } }
        remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_stall_days
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { eu5ab_scan_attempt_count > { value = var:eu5ab_scan_refill_last_attempt subtract = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_refill_last_attempt value = { value = eu5ab_scan_attempt_count add = 1 } }
        remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_stall_days
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_refill_stall_days value = { value = eu5ab_scan_refill_stall_count add = 1 } }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { eu5ab_scan_refill_stall_count >= 6
            NOT = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations } }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_scan_stalled value = 1 }
        # Clear only transient workers/candidates and material reservations.
        # Confirmed projects, budgets, templates and cooldowns remain intact.
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations eu5ab_clear_location_worker_state = yes eu5ab_clear_location_candidate_state = yes }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
        eu5ab_clear_engine_candidate_queue = yes
        eu5ab_reset_committed_construction_demand = yes
        remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_active
        eu5ab_complete_scan_round = yes
    }
}

eu5ab_refill_regional_development_scan = { if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes } }

	if = { limit = { eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes }
	    eu5ab_record_scan_date = yes
	    save_scope_as = eu5ab_scan_country
	    if = {
	        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active } }
	        eu5ab_prepare_engine_candidate_queue = yes
	        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_scan_candidate_locations
	        remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_candidate_reserve
	        eu5ab_update_scan_candidate_target = yes
	        set_variable = eu5ab_scan_active
	    }
	    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget value = var:eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit }
	    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts value = 0 }
	    eu5ab_scan_deferred_locations = yes
	    remove_variable = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget
	    remove_variable = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts
	}

}
}

# Keep the twenty persisted buckets intact. The 21st scan day uses their
# undelivered locations, without repeating cooldown/waiting maintenance.
eu5ab_scan_initial_tail = { if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes } }

    eu5ab_record_scan_date = yes
    eu5ab_refresh_rgo_pending = yes
    eu5ab_ensure_build_pending = yes
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_scan_country
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget value = { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget divide = 21 ceiling = yes } }
    if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget > var:eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget value = var:eu5ab_scan_daily_task_limit } }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts value = 0 }
    if = { limit = { eu5ab_scan_attempt_count < var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget
        OR = { eu5ab_scan_early_stop_value <= 0 eu5ab_scan_reserve_count < var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } }
        eu5ab_scan_deferred_locations = yes }
    remove_variable = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget
    remove_variable = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts

}
}

eu5ab_scan_deferred_locations = {
    # Refresh eligibility and cheap ordering only. Monthly cooldown/waiting
    # maintenance already ran; dispatched locations have left this list forever.
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations
        if = {
            limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_scan_country
                has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
                eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
                eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
                NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
                NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown } }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bucket_need_score value = eu5ab_location_need_score }
        }
        else = {
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
            scope:eu5ab_scan_country = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } }
        }
    }
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations
			limit = {
				has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
				eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
				eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes
			}
			order_by = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { eu5ab_scan_daily_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget } eu5ab_scan_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } OR = { eu5ab_scan_early_stop_value <= 0 eu5ab_scan_reserve_count < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score value = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score }
				owner = {
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_deep_scored add = 1 }
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_wait_months
				eu5ab_prepare_backfill_dispatch = yes
				owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
				eu5ab_request_building_capacity = yes
			}
		}
		ordered_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations
			limit = {
				has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id
				eu5ab_location_template_not_paused = yes
				eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_build_cooldown }
				NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown }
				NOT = { eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			}
			order_by = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score
			max = 30
			check_range_bounds = no
			if = {
				limit = { owner = { eu5ab_scan_daily_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_daily_deep_score_budget } eu5ab_scan_attempt_count < { value = var:eu5ab_deep_score_budget } OR = { eu5ab_scan_early_stop_value <= 0 eu5ab_scan_reserve_count < { value = var:eu5ab_scan_candidate_target } } } }
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_location_need_score value = var:eu5ab_bucket_need_score }
				owner = {
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_daily_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_deep_score_attempts add = 1 }
					remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_deep_scored add = 1 }
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_wait_months
				eu5ab_prepare_backfill_dispatch = yes
				owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
				eu5ab_request_building_capacity = yes
			}
		}
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_scan_unscanned_locations remove_variable = eu5ab_bucket_need_score }
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations remove_variable = eu5ab_bucket_need_score }
    if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_parallel <= 0 } eu5ab_merge_location_worker_results = yes }
}

eu5ab_hydrate_final_building_diagnostics = {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } }
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_diag_country
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_kind }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:eu5ab_diag_top_1_kind = 1
				has_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_location
				has_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_building
			}
			var:eu5ab_diag_top_1_location = {
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				scope:eu5ab_diag_country = {
					var:eu5ab_diag_top_1_building = {
						save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building

							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_need value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_universal_need_score }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_economic value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_economic_efficiency_score }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_labor_jobs value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs multiply = 1000 } }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_labor_current value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_labor_projected value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}

	if = {

		if = {

				var:eu5ab_diag_top_2_kind = 1
				has_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_location
				has_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_2_building

				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				scope:eu5ab_diag_country = {

						save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
						scope:eu5ab_diag_country = {
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_need value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_universal_need_score }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_economic value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_economic_efficiency_score }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_labor_jobs value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs multiply = 1000 } }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_labor_current value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_labor_projected value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_kind }
		if = {
			limit = {
				var:eu5ab_diag_top_3_kind = 1
				has_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_location
				has_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_3_building
			}
			var:eu5ab_diag_top_3_location = {
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
				scope:eu5ab_diag_country = {
					var:eu5ab_diag_top_3_building = {
						save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
						scope:eu5ab_diag_country = {
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_3_need value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_universal_need_score }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_3_economic value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_economic_efficiency_score }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_3_labor_jobs value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs multiply = 1000 } }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_3_labor_current value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }
							set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_3_labor_projected value = { value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_available_workers multiply = 1000 } }

eu5ab_try_construct_saved_building_type = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } } }
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_stage_engine_candidate = yes }
	}
}

# Country/template catalogs are rebuilt lazily once per monthly scan.
# Location permission, capacity and workforce remain live per candidate.
eu5ab_rebuild_eu5ab_active_normal_catalog_policy_1 = {
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_active_normal_catalog_policy_1
	ordered_buildable_building_type = {
		max = 330
		check_range_bounds = no
		limit = {
			eu5ab_granary_building_allowed = yes
			eu5ab_candidate_is_latest_unlocked = yes
		}
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = {
			add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_normal_catalog_policy_1 target = prev }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_active_normal_catalog_policy_1_ready_month value = var:eu5ab_scan_month }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_active_normal_catalog_policy_1_ready_year value = var:eu5ab_scan_year }
	set_variable = eu5ab_active_normal_catalog_policy_1_ready
}

# Only one synchronous location worker shares these stable gates.
# Nonzero result codes preserve passed/failed state even in old saves
# whose serializer omits zero map values. Diagnostics still run per pool.
eu5ab_prepare_candidate_collection_gate = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_active
				AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gates trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gates } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gates target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gate value = "variable_map(eu5ab_candidate_collection_gates|scope:eu5ab_candidate_building)" }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gate value = 1 }
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
				if = { limit = { employment_size > 0 scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_open } } } eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_upgrades = yes }
				if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_capacity = yes } }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gate value = 2 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_irrigation_demand = yes } }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gate value = 3 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_storage_project_available = yes } }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gate value = 4 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_demand = yes } }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gate value = 5 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_demand = yes } }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gate value = 6 } } }
			}
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_active }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gates key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = var:eu5ab_candidate_collection_gate } }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_clear_candidate_collection_cache = {
if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_country
    owner = var:eu5ab_sp_country
    var:eu5ab_sp_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
clear_variable_list = eu5ab_sp_ordinary_seen
clear_variable_list = eu5ab_sp_input_seen
}
	eu5ab_clear_worker_screening = yes
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gates
	remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_collection_gate

eu5ab_try_construct_current_policy = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	eu5ab_clear_candidate_collection_cache = yes
	eu5ab_clear_scan_promotion_cache = yes
	if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_active } set_variable = eu5ab_worker_screen_active }
	set_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_active
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_preset_origin
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_manual_policy_value = 100 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_preset_origin value = eu5ab_uncached_preset_origin }
	}
	remove_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate
	remove_variable = eu5ab_had_workforce_blocked_candidate
	eu5ab_collect_current_candidate_pools = yes
	owner = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features }
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_country
			every_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_feature
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
					switch = {
						trigger = scope:eu5ab_priority_feature
						flag:eu5ab_feature_upgrade_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_upgrade_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_new_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_new_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_expansion_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_rgo = { }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				eu5ab_stage_current_upgrade_candidates = yes
				eu5ab_stage_current_expansion_candidates = yes
				eu5ab_stage_current_new_candidates = yes
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				eu5ab_current_policy_auto_builds_input_sources = yes
				# Optional legacy-style fallback: an otherwise idle location may
				# search the same constrained pool for a scarce upstream industry.
				owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_fill_market_shortages_when_idle > 0
			}
		}
		eu5ab_try_construct_current_input_source = yes
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_country } eu5ab_try_candidate_backfill = yes }
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_current_upgrade_candidate_pool
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_current_expansion_candidate_pool
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_current_new_candidate_pool
	# Candidate collection already records projects rejected only by the
	# strict workforce gate, so no second full-domain scan is needed here.
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate }
			has_variable = eu5ab_had_workforce_blocked_candidate
		}
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_pending_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_workforce add = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_had_capacity_blocked_candidate } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_pending_failure_cooldown value = 3 }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_no_legal add = 1 }
	}
	remove_variable = eu5ab_had_workforce_blocked_candidate
	remove_variable = eu5ab_had_capacity_blocked_candidate
	remove_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate
	eu5ab_clear_candidate_collection_cache = yes
	eu5ab_clear_scan_promotion_cache = yes
	remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_preset_origin
}

eu5ab_stage_current_upgrade_candidates = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_stage_candidate_priority value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_upgrade }
	every_in_list = {
		variable = eu5ab_current_upgrade_candidate_pool
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { set_variable = eu5ab_had_legal_candidate change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_legal_candidates add = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } } } eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_pending_allowed = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
				NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_pending_preliminary_allowed = yes }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_pending_output add = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } } } eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_inputs = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
					NOT = { eu5ab_inputs_available = yes }
				}
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_pending_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
				}
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } } } eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_prices = yes }
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
						NOT = { eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes }
					}
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_pending_failure_cooldown value = 3 }
					}
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_oversupply add = 1 }
					}
				}
				else = {
					eu5ab_try_construct_saved_building_type = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	remove_variable = eu5ab_stage_candidate_priority
}

			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			}
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_pending_output add = 1 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } } } eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_inputs = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
					NOT = { eu5ab_inputs_available = yes }
				}
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
					set_variable = { name = eu5ab_pending_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
				}
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
					change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 }
				}
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } } } eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_prices = yes }
				if = {
					limit = {
						scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } }
						NOT = { eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes }
					}
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_pending_failure_cooldown value = 3 }
					}
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
						change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_eu5ab_diag_fail_oversupply add = 1 }
					}
				}
				else = {
					eu5ab_try_construct_saved_building_type = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
	remove_variable = eu5ab_stage_candidate_priority
}

eu5ab_try_construct_current_input_source = {
	set_variable = eu5ab_collecting_supplemental
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	eu5ab_collect_current_input_candidate_pools = yes
	owner = {
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features }
			every_in_list = {
				variable = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_feature
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
					switch = {
						trigger = scope:eu5ab_priority_feature
						flag:eu5ab_feature_upgrade_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_input_upgrade_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_new_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_input_new_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_building = { eu5ab_stage_current_input_expansion_candidates = yes }
						flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_rgo = { }
					}
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				eu5ab_stage_current_input_upgrade_candidates = yes
				eu5ab_stage_current_input_expansion_candidates = yes
				eu5ab_stage_current_input_new_candidates = yes
			}
		}
	}
	remove_variable = eu5ab_collecting_supplemental
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_current_input_upgrade_candidate_pool
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_current_input_expansion_candidate_pool
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_current_input_new_candidate_pool
}

	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_backfill_new_candidates
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_backfill_upstream_checked
	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_country
	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_budget
	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_remaining
	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_rank
	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_head_limit
	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_window_limit
	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_stage_before

	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_food_layer
	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_consumed
}

	eu5ab_clear_backfill_scratch = yes
	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_dispatch_country
	remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_triggered
	remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_checked
	remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_input_rejected
	remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_output_rejected
	remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_stage_failed
	remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_staged
	remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_budget_exhausted
	remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_upstream_rechecks
}
eu5ab_prepare_backfill_dispatch = {
	remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_dispatch_country
	if = {
		limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_scan_country owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active has_variable = eu5ab_scan_backfill_enabled } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_backfill_dispatch_country value = owner }
	}
}
eu5ab_initialize_candidate_backfill = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	if = {
		limit = {
			owner = scope:eu5ab_backfill_dispatch_country
			owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active has_variable = eu5ab_scan_backfill_enabled is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } }
		}
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_backfill_country value = owner }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_backfill_budget value = 2 }
		if = { limit = { owner.var:eu5ab_global_candidate_ranking_mode = 2 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_backfill_budget value = 5 } }
	}
}

eu5ab_record_backfill_upstream_check = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = {
			is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_backfill_upgrade_candidates target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
			is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_backfill_expansion_candidates target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
			is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_backfill_new_candidates target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
		} NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_backfill_upstream_checked target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_backfill_upstream_checked target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
	}
}
# Root is the building; never run the mutating ordinary failure chain here.
eu5ab_check_backfill_candidate = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_backfill_remaining subtract = 1 }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_checked } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_checked add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_checked value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_backfill_upstream_checked target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_upstream_rechecks } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_upstream_rechecks add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_upstream_rechecks value = 1 } } }
	}
	if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_inputs_available = yes } } scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_input_rejected } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_input_rejected add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_input_rejected value = 1 } } } }
	else_if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes } } scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_output_rejected } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_output_rejected add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_output_rejected value = 1 } } } }
	else = {
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_backfill_stage_before value = var:eu5ab_worker_staged }
			eu5ab_stage_engine_candidate = yes
			if = {
				limit = { var:eu5ab_worker_staged > var:eu5ab_backfill_stage_before }
				set_variable = eu5ab_backfill_done
				if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_staged } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_staged add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_staged value = 1 } }
			}
			else = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_stage_failed } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_stage_failed add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_stage_failed value = 1 } } }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_stage_before
		}
	}
}
eu5ab_visit_backfill_upgrade_candidates = {
	if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_backfill_remaining > 0 NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_done } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_stage_candidate_priority value = owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_upgrade }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_backfill_upgrade_candidates
			if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { var:eu5ab_backfill_remaining > 0 NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_done } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } owner = var:eu5ab_backfill_country owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active has_variable = eu5ab_scan_backfill_enabled } } }
				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
				if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_food_layer eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_food_layer } NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } } } } } eu5ab_check_backfill_candidate = yes }
			}
		}
		remove_variable = eu5ab_stage_candidate_priority
	}
}

				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
				if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_food_layer eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_food_layer } NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } } } } } eu5ab_check_backfill_candidate = yes }

				save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
				if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_food_layer eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_food_layer } NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_is_food_emergency = yes } } } } } eu5ab_check_backfill_candidate = yes }
