eu5ab_visit_backfill_layer = {
	owner = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features }
			every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_candidate_priority_features save_scope_as = eu5ab_priority_feature
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { switch = { trigger = scope:eu5ab_priority_feature
					flag:eu5ab_feature_upgrade_building = { eu5ab_visit_backfill_upgrade_candidates = yes }
					flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_building = { eu5ab_visit_backfill_expansion_candidates = yes }
					flag:eu5ab_feature_new_building = { eu5ab_visit_backfill_new_candidates = yes }
					flag:eu5ab_feature_expand_rgo = { }
				} }
			}
		}
		else = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_visit_backfill_upgrade_candidates = yes eu5ab_visit_backfill_expansion_candidates = yes eu5ab_visit_backfill_new_candidates = yes } }
	}
}
eu5ab_try_candidate_backfill = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	if = { limit = {
		has_variable = eu5ab_worker_active has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_country
		NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_consumed }
		NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_action_taken } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_ordinary_candidate_staged }
		owner = var:eu5ab_backfill_country owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active has_variable = eu5ab_scan_backfill_enabled }
		var:eu5ab_backfill_budget > 0 OR = {
			has_variable_list = eu5ab_backfill_upgrade_candidates
			has_variable_list = eu5ab_backfill_expansion_candidates
			has_variable_list = eu5ab_backfill_new_candidates
		} }
		set_variable = eu5ab_backfill_consumed
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_triggered } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_triggered add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_triggered value = 1 } }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_backfill_remaining value = var:eu5ab_backfill_budget }
		set_variable = eu5ab_backfill_food_layer
		eu5ab_visit_backfill_layer = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_backfill_food_layer
		eu5ab_visit_backfill_layer = yes
		if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_backfill_remaining <= 0 NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_backfill_done } } if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_backfill_budget_exhausted } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_budget_exhausted add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_backfill_budget_exhausted value = 1 } } }
	}
}

eu5ab_try_construct_rgo_need = {
	if = {
		limit = { owner = { eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes } eu5ab_rgo_expansion_allowed = yes }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_queue_before_attempt value = num_civil_constructions }
		eu5ab_capture_rgo_start_output = yes
		# Capture the native payment for budget settlement.
		set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_paid_cost value = owner.gold }
		construct_rgo_upgrade = { }
		change_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_paid_cost subtract = owner.gold }
		if = {
			# The native effect can reject hidden vanilla constraints; charge only on success.
			limit = { num_civil_constructions > eu5ab_queue_before_attempt_value }
			remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown
			eu5ab_record_queue_start_location = yes
			eu5ab_record_rgo_start = yes
			set_variable = eu5ab_action_taken
			set_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects value = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick value = 1 } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick value = 1 } }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 1 }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_location value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_kind value = 1 }
			}
			owner = {
				# Gold is charged by the native effect. Only settle the internal budget here.
				# Unexpected negative cash movement must never refund the budget.
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:eu5ab_rgo_paid_cost >= 0 }
					set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_budget_charge value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_paid_cost }
					eu5ab_charge_annual_budget = yes
				}
			}
		}
		else = {
			owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla add = 1 } }
		}
		remove_variable = eu5ab_queue_before_attempt
		remove_local_variable = eu5ab_rgo_paid_cost
		remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_output
		remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_level
		remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue
		remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue_known
	}
}

eu5ab_rgo_adjust_horizon_step = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = eu5ab_global_rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
            exists = scope:setting
            NOT = {
                exists = scope:cmm_reset_key
            }
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_rgo_horizon_delta
            value = {
                value = "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_job_fill_deadline_months)"
                subtract = eu5ab_manual_value_global_rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_job_fill_deadline_months)" = 1200
                eu5ab_manual_value_global_rgo_job_fill_deadline_months < 1200
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_rgo_horizon_value
                value = {
                    value = eu5ab_manual_value_global_rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
                    add = 120
                    max = 1200
                }
            }
            cmm_set_setting_value = {
                setting = eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
                value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_horizon_value
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                "variable_map(cmm|flag:eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_job_fill_deadline_months)" = 0
                eu5ab_manual_value_global_rgo_job_fill_deadline_months > 0
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_rgo_horizon_value
                value = {
                    value = eu5ab_manual_value_global_rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
                    subtract = 120
                    min = 0
                }
            }
            cmm_set_setting_value = {
                setting = eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
                value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_horizon_value
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                local_var:eu5ab_rgo_horizon_delta = 5
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_rgo_horizon_value
                value = {
                    value = eu5ab_manual_value_global_rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
                    add = 12
                    max = 1200
                }
            }
            cmm_set_setting_value = {
                setting = eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
                value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_horizon_value
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                local_var:eu5ab_rgo_horizon_delta = -5
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_rgo_horizon_value
                value = {
                    value = eu5ab_manual_value_global_rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
                    subtract = 12
                    min = 0
                }
            }
            cmm_set_setting_value = {
                setting = eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
                value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_horizon_value
            }
        }
    }
    remove_local_variable = eu5ab_rgo_horizon_value
}
eu5ab_initialize_rgo_settings = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = { has_variable_map = cmm trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = cmm } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                    name = cmm
                    target = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_workforce_mode
                } } }
            }
        }
        cmm_set_setting_value = {
            setting = eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_workforce_mode
            value = 1
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = { has_variable_map = cmm trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = cmm } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                    name = cmm
                    target = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
                } } }
            }
        }
        cmm_set_setting_value = {
            setting = eu5ab_regional_development__rgo_job_fill_deadline_months
            value = 180
        }
    }
}

# Repair the lost active marker only from a confirmed, unmixed pending record
# whose original level has not completed. Never enroll arbitrary civil work.
# An unknown queue keeps existing attribution but cannot prove a recovery.
eu5ab_restore_active_rgo = {
    if = { limit = {
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction }
        exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner
        has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_good
        has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline
        has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ambiguous }
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_level_loss }
    }
        if = { limit = {
            owner = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner
            raw_material = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_good
            rgo_level = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline
            var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels > 0
            eu5ab_rgos_under_construction > 0
        }
            set_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction
            owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = prev }
            } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = prev } } }
        }
    }
}

# Only this registry is authoritative. Unproven legacy location totals never
# enroll a location. Clearing a record removes the index as well as its data.
eu5ab_clear_rgo_pending_location = {
    if = { limit = { exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner }
        var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner = {
            remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_locations target = prev }
            remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_timing_requests target = prev }
        }
    }

    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_good
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_market
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_last_level
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ambiguous
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_level_loss
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unit_output
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_timing_ready
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_build_days
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_wait_construction
}

eu5ab_reconcile_rgo_pending_location = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown
    if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = {
        exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner owner = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner
        exists = raw_material has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_good
        raw_material = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_good
        has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels > 0
        has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline
        has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_last_level
    } } }
        eu5ab_clear_rgo_pending_location = yes
    }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_pending_location_data_available = yes } }
        # Unknown readings cannot establish completion, cancellation or output.
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown value = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels }
        if = { limit = { eu5ab_rgos_under_construction < 0 } eu5ab_request_rgo_queue = yes }
    }
    else = {
        eu5ab_request_rgo_timing = yes
        if = { limit = { rgo_level < var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_last_level }
            # Destruction can remove old or Mod levels. The original baseline
            # no longer proves that a remaining project was cancelled.
            set_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_level_loss
        }
        if = { limit = { OR = {
            has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_level_loss
            eu5ab_rgos_under_construction > { value = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline add = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels subtract = rgo_level }
        } }
            # External additions/destruction make aggregate attribution unknown.
            # Once mixed, returning to the old total does not prove identity.
            set_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ambiguous
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ambiguous }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels value = {
                value = rgo_level add = eu5ab_rgos_under_construction
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_level_loss } }
                    subtract = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline }
                min = 0 max = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels
            } }
            if = { limit = { eu5ab_rgos_under_construction = 0 eu5ab_rgo_pending_staffing_due = yes }
                if = { limit = { eu5ab_rgo_staffed_levels >= rgo_level }
                    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels value = 0 }
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            # A monotonic staffing floor prevents unemployment from reopening
            # released capacity. Native construction alone never raises it.
            if = { limit = { eu5ab_rgo_pending_staffing_due = yes }
                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline value = {
                    value = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline min = eu5ab_rgo_staffed_levels
                } }
            }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels value = {
                value = rgo_level add = eu5ab_rgos_under_construction
                subtract = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline min = 0 max = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels
            } }
        }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_last_level value = rgo_level }
        if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels <= 0 }
            eu5ab_clear_rgo_pending_location = yes
        }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ambiguous }
            has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unit_output var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_unit_output > 0 }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity value = {
                value = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels multiply = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_unit_output
            } }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown value = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels } }
    }
}

# Template changes do not remove registered projects. Empty registries never
# traverse locations; refresh is idempotent and never discovers manual work.
eu5ab_ensure_rgo_pending = {
    if = { limit = { OR = {
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ready }
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_day }
        NOT = { var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_day = eu5ab_pl_today }
    } } eu5ab_refresh_rgo_pending = yes }
}

eu5ab_add_rgo_pending_summary = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_market
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels exists = market }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_market value = market }
    }

    if = {
        limit = { exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner
            exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market OR = {
            AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity } var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity > 0 } }
            AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown } var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown > 0 } }
        } }
        if = {
            limit = { var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_good = goods:alum }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity > 0 }
                var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner = {
                    set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add value = { value = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity multiply = 1 } }
                    if = {
                        limit = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_rgo_pending_output_alum trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_rgo_pending_output_alum } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_output_alum target = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market } } } }
                        change_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add add = "variable_map(eu5ab_rgo_pending_output_alum|prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market)" }
                    }
                    # Keep a numeric floor explicit: effect min/max mutation
                    # is not the script-value min/max clamp contract.
                    if = { limit = { local_var:eu5ab_rgo_summary_add < 0 }
                        set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add value = 0 }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_output_alum key = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_summary_add }
                    remove_local_variable = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown > 0 }
                var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner = {
                    set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add value = { value = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown multiply = 1 } }
                    if = {
                        limit = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_alum trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_alum } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_alum target = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market } } } }
                        change_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add add = "variable_map(eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_alum|prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market)" }

                        change_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add add = "variable_map(eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wine|prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market)" }
                    }
                    # Keep a numeric floor explicit: effect min/max mutation
                    # is not the script-value min/max clamp contract.
                    if = { limit = { local_var:eu5ab_rgo_summary_add < 0 }
                        set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add value = 0 }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wine key = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_summary_add }
                    remove_local_variable = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_good = goods:wool }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity > 0 }
                var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner = {
                    set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add value = { value = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_quantity multiply = -1 } }
                    if = {
                        limit = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_rgo_pending_output_wool trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_rgo_pending_output_wool } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_output_wool target = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market } } } }
                        change_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add add = "variable_map(eu5ab_rgo_pending_output_wool|prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market)" }
                    }
                    # Keep a numeric floor explicit: effect min/max mutation
                    # is not the script-value min/max clamp contract.
                    if = { limit = { local_var:eu5ab_rgo_summary_add < 0 }
                        set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add value = 0 }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_output_wool key = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_summary_add }
                    remove_local_variable = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown > 0 }
                var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner = {
                    set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add value = { value = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown multiply = -1 } }
                    if = {
                        limit = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wool trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wool } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wool target = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market } } } }
                        change_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add add = "variable_map(eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wool|prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market)" }
                    }
                    # Keep a numeric floor explicit: effect min/max mutation
                    # is not the script-value min/max clamp contract.
                    if = { limit = { local_var:eu5ab_rgo_summary_add < 0 }
                        set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add value = 0 }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unknown_wool key = prev.var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_market value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_summary_add }
                    remove_local_variable = eu5ab_rgo_summary_add
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Reconcile a previous record before issuing another command at this location.
# Debiting the stored market/owner handles same-day market/ownership changes.
eu5ab_prepare_rgo_pending_start = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels }
        eu5ab_remove_rgo_pending_summary = yes
        eu5ab_reconcile_rgo_pending_location = yes
        eu5ab_restore_active_rgo = yes
        eu5ab_add_rgo_pending_summary = yes
    }
}
# Called before the native command. A rejection discards these scratch values.
eu5ab_capture_rgo_start_output = {
    eu5ab_prepare_rgo_pending_start = yes
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_start_output value = eu5ab_rgo_full_level_output }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_start_level value = rgo_level }
    eu5ab_capture_rgo_start_queue = yes
}
# Only native success reaches this entry point; migration uses the helper below.
eu5ab_record_rgo_start = {
    eu5ab_update_rgo_queue_after_start = yes
    eu5ab_report_rgo_confirmed = yes
    eu5ab_register_rgo_pending_start = yes
}
eu5ab_register_rgo_pending_start = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels }
        eu5ab_remove_rgo_pending_summary = yes
        change_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels add = 1 }
        # Same-output confirmed Mod starts can share a known record. Different
        # snapshots cannot be assigned to individual completions from totals.
        if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = {
            has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unit_output has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_output
            var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_unit_output = var:eu5ab_rgo_start_output
        } } } set_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ambiguous }
    }
    else = {
        # Remove unproven legacy estimates; never turn them into Mod projects.
        eu5ab_clear_rgo_pending_location = yes
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels value = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_baseline value = var:eu5ab_rgo_start_level }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_last_level value = var:eu5ab_rgo_start_level }
        if = { limit = { OR = {
            NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue_known }
            AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue var:eu5ab_rgo_start_queue > 0 }
        } }
            set_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ambiguous
        }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_output var:eu5ab_rgo_start_output > 0 }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_unit_output value = var:eu5ab_rgo_start_output }
        }
    }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner value = owner }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_good value = raw_material }
    # A new confirmed command needs its own native remaining-time snapshot.
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_timing_ready
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_build_days
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_wait_construction
    owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_locations target = prev } } }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_locations target = prev }
    } }
    eu5ab_reconcile_rgo_pending_location = yes
    eu5ab_request_rgo_timing = yes
    eu5ab_add_rgo_pending_summary = yes
}

# Old broad totals and attempted/approved rows cannot prove a start.
# Only retained country-owned success receipts (4/6) can seed one level each.
# This one-time migration walks receipts, never owned locations.
eu5ab_migrate_rgo_pending_registry = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_registry_version } }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_pending_registry_version value = 1 }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_rgo_migration_country
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_records
            save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_rgo_migration_id value = this }
            scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_country = {
                if = { limit = {
                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status target = scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_id } } }
                    OR = { "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_status|scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_id)" = 4
                           "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_status|scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_id)" = 6 }
                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_location trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_location } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_location target = scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_id } } }
                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_good trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_good } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_good target = scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_id } } }
                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_level_before trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_level_before } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_level_before target = scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_id } } }
                }
                    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_location|scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_id)" = {
                        if = { limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_country
                            raw_material = "scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_country.variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_good|scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_id)"
                            NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels } }
                            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_start_level value = "scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_country.variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_level_before|scope:eu5ab_rgo_migration_id)" }
                            # Totals since this old receipt may include manual work.
                            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue value = 1 }
                            remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_output
                            eu5ab_register_rgo_pending_start = yes
                            remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_level
                            remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Worker-local snapshots are merged by the serial country dispatcher.
eu5ab_capture_rgo_pending_diagnostics = {
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_rgo_pending_gap value = eu5ab_rgo_market_gap }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_rgo_pending_quantity value = eu5ab_rgo_market_pending_quantity }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_rgo_pending_limit value = eu5ab_rgo_pending_limit }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_rgo_pending_factor value = { value = eu5ab_rgo_pending_factor multiply = 100 } }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_rgo_pending_state value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_rgo_pending_state value = 4 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_pending_data_available = yes } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_rgo_pending_state value = 3 } }
    else_if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_pending_below_limit = yes } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_rgo_pending_state value = 2 } }
}


eu5ab_request_rgo_timing = {
    if = { limit = { exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner }
        if = { limit = { OR = { eu5ab_rgos_under_construction = 0
            has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ambiguous has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_level_loss } }
            var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner = {
                remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_timing_requests target = prev }
            }
        }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner
        has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels
        trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels } var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_levels = 1 }
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_timing_ready }
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_ambiguous }
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_pending_level_loss }
        NOT = { eu5ab_rgos_under_construction = 0 } }
        if = { limit = { owner = var:eu5ab_rgo_pending_owner }
            owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_rgo_timing_requests target = prev }
            } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_rgo_timing_requests target = prev } } }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_clear_rgo_queue = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_ready
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_count
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_owner
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_day
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_civil
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_level
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_failed_day
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_failed_owner
}
eu5ab_stamp_rgo_queue = {
    set_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_ready
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_owner value = owner }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_day value = eu5ab_pl_today }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_civil value = num_civil_constructions }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_level value = rgo_level }
}
eu5ab_capture_rgo_queue = {
    eu5ab_clear_rgo_queue = yes
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_count
        scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_count >= 0
        scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_count <= num_civil_constructions }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_count value = scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_count }
        eu5ab_stamp_rgo_queue = yes
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_failed_day value = eu5ab_pl_today }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_failed_owner value = owner }
    }
}
# Called only after the synchronous command proved native success. A queued
# level adds one; an instant completion adds no queue entry. Never infer from
# all civil projects outside that single command's transaction.
eu5ab_update_rgo_queue_after_start = {
    eu5ab_clear_rgo_queue = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue_known
        rgo_level >= var:eu5ab_rgo_start_level
        rgo_level <= { value = var:eu5ab_rgo_start_level add = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_count value = { value = 1
            if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue } add = var:eu5ab_rgo_start_queue }
            add = var:eu5ab_rgo_start_level subtract = rgo_level } }
        eu5ab_stamp_rgo_queue = yes
    }
}
eu5ab_capture_rgo_start_queue = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue_known
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue value = eu5ab_rgos_under_construction }
    if = { limit = { eu5ab_rgos_under_construction >= 0 } set_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue_known }
}
eu5ab_request_rgo_queue = {
    if = { limit = { num_civil_constructions > 0 exists = owner
        NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_queue_failed_current = yes }
        NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_queue_request_current = yes } }
        if = { limit = { exists = var:eu5ab_rgo_queue_request_owner }
            var:eu5ab_rgo_queue_request_owner = {
                remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_requests target = prev }
            }
        }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_sequence value = { value = 1
            if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_queue_sequence } add = var:eu5ab_rgo_queue_sequence } } }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_request_owner value = owner }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_request_day value = eu5ab_pl_today }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_rgo_queue_tickets
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_tickets target = var:eu5ab_rgo_queue_sequence }
        owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_requests target = prev } } }
            add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_rgo_queue_requests target = prev }
        } }
    }
}

# Reserve a candidate's material demand immediately after approval so
# later candidates in the same GUI drain see the already-planned load.
eu5ab_commit_candidate_construction_demand = {
	market = { save_temporary_scope_as = eu5ab_material_market }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_material_market value = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
	if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_books > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_new_committed_books value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_books }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_books
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_books target = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
			}
			change_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_new_committed_books add = "global_variable_map(eu5ab_q_market_committed_books|scope:eu5ab_material_market)" }
			remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_books key = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
		}
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_books key = scope:eu5ab_material_market value = local_var:eu5ab_new_committed_books }
	}
	if = {

		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_wool > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_new_committed_wool value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_construction_demand_wool }
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_global_variable_map = eu5ab_q_market_committed_wool
				is_key_in_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_wool target = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
			}
			change_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_new_committed_wool add = "global_variable_map(eu5ab_q_market_committed_wool|scope:eu5ab_material_market)" }
			remove_from_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_wool key = scope:eu5ab_material_market }
		}
		add_to_global_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_q_market_committed_wool key = scope:eu5ab_material_market value = local_var:eu5ab_new_committed_wool }
	}
}

# Snapshot only meaningful queue progress. GUI callbacks may still fire while
# processing is stuck, so animation activity alone is not a liveness signal.

	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_active
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_phase
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_processed

			has_variable = eu5ab_q_confirmed

		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_phase value = var:eu5ab_q_phase }

	}
}

# Country-only reducer. It preserves insertion order and consumes only
# completed GUI/worker results; pending captures survive an early merge.
eu5ab_merge_location_worker_results = {
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_worker_merge_country
if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_merge_current value = 0 }
}
	every_in_list = {
		variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
		limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_worker_merge_country has_variable = eu5ab_worker_complete }
		save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
		# Count once per completed worker, not once per candidate or phase.
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_reason } scope:eu5ab_worker_merge_country = {
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_capacity_unavailable value = { value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_capacity_unavailable } add = var:eu5ab_diag_capacity_unavailable } add = 1 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_capacity_last_reason value = prev.var:eu5ab_capacity_reason } } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = {
				var:eu5ab_worker_staged > 0
				has_variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_1_rgo
				has_variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_2_rgo
				has_variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_3_rgo
				has_variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_4_rgo
				has_variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_5_rgo
				has_variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_6_rgo
				has_variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_7_rgo
				has_variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_8_rgo
			}
			OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_data_wait } has_variable = eu5ab_worker_data_ready }
			}
			scope:eu5ab_worker_merge_country = { eu5ab_record_scan_candidate_location = yes }
		}
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_1_types
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } scope:eu5ab_worker_merge_country = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_staged_candidates add = 1 } } }
			}
		}
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_1_rgo } scope:eu5ab_worker_merge_country = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } } } }
		every_in_list = {
			variable = eu5ab_worker_phase_2_types
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } scope:eu5ab_worker_merge_country = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_staged_candidates add = 1 } } }

# RGO actions are staged too, so the hidden bridge can execute them at their
# exact user-selected position between ordinary candidate classes.
eu5ab_stage_rgo_candidate = {
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_screen = yes
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_stage_location }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_pending_data_available = yes } } set_variable = eu5ab_worker_data_wait }
	else = { set_variable = eu5ab_worker_data_ready }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_cached_rgo_queue_score value = eu5ab_rgo_queue_order_score }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_active }
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_1_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_2_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_3_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_4_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_5_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_6_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_7_rgo value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_worker_phase_8_rgo value = 1 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 1 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_5_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 2 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_6_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_6_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_6_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 3 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_7_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_7_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_7_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_candidate_priority_rgo = 4 NOT = { eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes } }
			owner = {
				if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_8_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_8_rgo_unsorted_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_stage_location } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_8_rgo_staged add = 1 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_rgo_staged add = 1 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_start_engine_candidate_queue = {
    set_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_ranking_mode } }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_batch_ranking_mode value = 2 }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_candidate_ranking_mode }
                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_batch_ranking_mode value = eu5ab_manual_value_global_candidate_ranking_mode } }
        }
    set_variable = eu5ab_bridge_schema
	if = { limit = { eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes }
		eu5ab_sort_candidate_queue = yes
		eu5ab_sort_rgo_candidate_queue = yes
    eu5ab_refresh_rgo_pending = yes
    eu5ab_recover_pending_rgo_screens = yes
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { var:eu5ab_q_staged > 0 var:eu5ab_q_rgo_staged > 0 } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_active value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 2 }
			# A refill is another batch in the same round; retain earlier starts.
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 2 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick > 0 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 1 } } }
			eu5ab_reset_engine_candidate_watchdog_progress = yes
			trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_queue_watchdog.1 days = 2 }
			eu5ab_prepare_engine_priority_phase = yes
		}
		else = { eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes }
	}

    eu5ab_dispatch_queue_bridge = yes
}

			if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_locations } if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_expected } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected add = var:eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_staged } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected value = var:eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_staged } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 3 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_3_locations } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected value = var:eu5ab_q_phase_3_staged } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_locations } if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_expected } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected add = var:eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_staged } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected value = var:eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_staged } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:eu5ab_q_phase = 4 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_4_locations } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected value = var:eu5ab_q_phase_4_staged } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_locations } if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_expected } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected add = var:eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_staged } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected value = var:eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_staged } } }
		}
		if = {

			if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_5_locations } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_expected value = var:eu5ab_q_phase_5_staged } }

		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_expected } } eu5ab_advance_engine_priority_phase = yes }
	}
}

# Predicted-profit selection first records the strongest engine-valued candidate
# in each location. One priority point adds a 1% soft bonus based on the
# absolute profit magnitude (floored at 1), so priorities can decide close
# comparisons without defeating a materially larger predicted monthly profit.
eu5ab_record_actual_profit_candidate = {
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_priority value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_configured_priority }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit }
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude value = { value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value multiply = -1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value < 1 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude value = 1 } }
	set_variable = {
		name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
		value = {
			value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value
			multiply = eu5ab_profit_candidate_priority_value
			multiply = 0.01
			add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit
		}
	}
	# Penalize ranking only. Emergency negative-profit projects stay eligible.
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value >= 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank value = { value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_labor_factor } }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank value = { value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value divide = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_labor_factor } }
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank value = eu5ab_price_profit_rank }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank value = eu5ab_pending_profit_rank }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank value = eu5ab_capacity_profit_rank }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types }
				eu5ab_profit_best_rank_value < eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_best_actual value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value }
		clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types
		add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
	}
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_priority
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
}

	if = {

	}
	else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value <= 0 } eu5ab_advance_engine_priority_phase = yes }

    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_winner_limit
}

eu5ab_restart_engine_priority_phase = {
	if = { limit = { eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes }
		eu5ab_reset_engine_priority_phase_progress = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_q_retry_phase
		remove_variable = eu5ab_q_rank_refreshed
		eu5ab_prepare_engine_priority_phase = yes
	}
}

eu5ab_advance_engine_priority_phase = {
	eu5ab_clear_engine_priority_phase = yes
	if = {
		limit = {
			var:eu5ab_q_phase < 16
			OR = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_sampling var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota } }
		}
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase add = 1 }
		eu5ab_prepare_engine_priority_phase = yes
	}
	else = { eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes }
}

# Root is an approved location. Reserve actual engine cost without
# charging the annual pool until queue growth confirms success.
eu5ab_reserve_engine_candidate = {
	owner = {
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_spend add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_q_approved_cost_value }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_budget add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_q_approved_cost_value }
	}
}

eu5ab_release_engine_candidate_reservation = {
	owner = {
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_spend subtract = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_q_approved_cost_value }
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_budget subtract = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_q_approved_cost_value }
	}
}

eu5ab_commit_engine_candidate_budget = {
	set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_budget_charge value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_q_approved_cost_value }
	owner = { eu5ab_charge_annual_budget = yes }
	eu5ab_release_engine_candidate_reservation = yes
}

# Called by the validation GUI after all actual-value gates pass.
eu5ab_approve_engine_candidate = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_quote_ready
	eu5ab_report_candidate_approved = yes
	remove_variable = eu5ab_pending_predecessor
	remove_variable = eu5ab_pending_predecessor_before
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_queue_before value = num_civil_constructions }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_type_queue_before value = eu5ab_candidate_queued_levels }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_type_level_before value = eu5ab_candidate_completed_levels }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_cost value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_income value = scope:eu5ab_engine_income }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_profit value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit }
	# Snapshot the action before construction changes has_building state.
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_build_kind value = 3 }
	if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_replaces_existing_building = yes } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_build_kind value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_is_expansion = yes } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_build_kind value = 4 } }
	set_variable = eu5ab_q_location_approved
	add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_approved_location
	owner = {
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_approved_location } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_approved_location }
		}
		change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved add = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_actual_cost value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_actual_income value = scope:eu5ab_engine_income }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_actual_profit value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit }
	}
	eu5ab_reserve_engine_candidate = yes
	eu5ab_commit_candidate_construction_demand = yes
	eu5ab_reserve_candidate_output = yes
	eu5ab_acknowledge_approved_engine_candidate = yes
}

# Queue confirmation is the only place that settles annual budget and cooldown.
eu5ab_confirm_engine_candidate = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_approved_building_started = yes }
		eu5ab_commit_engine_candidate_budget = yes
		remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown
		set_variable = eu5ab_action_taken
		eu5ab_record_confirmed_building = yes
		eu5ab_report_candidate_confirmed = yes
		eu5ab_pf_confirm_start = yes
		eu5ab_record_queue_start_location = yes
		if = { limit = { eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes } owner = { set_variable = eu5ab_q_retry_phase } }
		if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_direct_output = yes } } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recent_build_penalty value = 12 } }
		owner = {
			if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick value = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { exists = var:eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override } }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_emergency_overrides_used } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_emergency_overrides_used add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_emergency_overrides_used value = 1 } }
			}
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_location value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_building value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_kind value = 3 }
			if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_build_kind } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_kind value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_q_approved_build_kind } }
		}
	}
	else = {
		eu5ab_release_engine_candidate_reservation = yes
		eu5ab_release_candidate_construction_demand = yes
		eu5ab_release_candidate_output = yes
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_failure_cooldown value = 2 }
		owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla add = 1 } }
		add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_failed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
		owner = { set_variable = eu5ab_q_retry_phase }
	}
	owner = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_confirmed } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed add = 1 } } else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed value = 1 } } }
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_material_market
	add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
	}
}

# Script-event watchdog for the hidden GUI bridge. It ignores callback activity
# and requires phase, processed, seen, or confirmed to make real progress.
eu5ab_check_engine_candidate_queue_watchdog = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country eu5ab_recover_queue_bridge = yes
        }
        else_if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } }
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_active
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_phase
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_processed
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_seen
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_confirmed
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_phase
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_processed
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_seen
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_confirmed
			has_variable = eu5ab_q_watchdog_stall_checks
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					var:eu5ab_q_phase > { value = var:eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_phase }
					var:eu5ab_q_processed > { value = var:eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_processed }
					var:eu5ab_q_seen > { value = var:eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_seen }
					var:eu5ab_q_confirmed > { value = var:eu5ab_q_watchdog_last_confirmed }
				}
			}
			eu5ab_reset_engine_candidate_watchdog_progress = yes
		}
		else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value > 0 NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire } eu5ab_q_outstanding_approvals_value <= 0 }
			eu5ab_ensure_build_pending = yes
			eu5ab_retry_waiting_candidate_data = yes
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_watchdog_stall_checks value = 0 }
		}
		else = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_watchdog_stall_checks add = 1 } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active var:eu5ab_q_watchdog_stall_checks >= 2 }
			change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_recoveries add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 5 }
			eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes
		}
	}

    eu5ab_recover_queue_bridge = yes
 }
    }

eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_computing has_variable = eu5ab_manual_sampling has_variable = eu5ab_q_active }
            remove_variable = eu5ab_manual_sampling
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase value = 1 }
            remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_phase remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_phase remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_done_phase
            clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_pool
            eu5ab_prepare_engine_priority_phase = yes
        }
        else_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_computing } eu5ab_manual_finish = yes }
        else = { eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue_live = yes } }

# Root country. Consume at most one RGO completion token per check, after
# the independent native parallel reader has published. Re-rank live after
# each start, using the existing safety/price/workforce/budget script gates.
eu5ab_process_script_rgo_queue = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } }

    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
        save_scope_as = actor
        switch = { trigger = var:eu5ab_q_phase
        1 = {
            ordered_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_rgo_locations
                limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo } }
                order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                set_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo
                eu5ab_prepare_rgo_dependencies = yes
                scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_waiting_rgo } }
                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_try_best_remaining_rgo = yes }
                }
            }
        }
        2 = {
            ordered_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_2_rgo_locations
                limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo } }
                order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                set_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo
                eu5ab_prepare_rgo_dependencies = yes
                scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_waiting_rgo } }
                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_try_best_remaining_rgo = yes }
                }
            }
        }
        3 = {
            ordered_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_3_rgo_locations
                limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo } }
                order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                set_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo
                eu5ab_prepare_rgo_dependencies = yes
                scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_waiting_rgo } }
                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_try_best_remaining_rgo = yes }
                }
            }
        }
        4 = {
            ordered_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_4_rgo_locations
                limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo } }
                order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                set_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo
                eu5ab_prepare_rgo_dependencies = yes
                scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_waiting_rgo } }
                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_try_best_remaining_rgo = yes }
                }
            }
        }
        5 = {
            ordered_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_5_rgo_locations
                limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo } }
                order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                set_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo
                eu5ab_prepare_rgo_dependencies = yes
                scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_waiting_rgo } }
                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_try_best_remaining_rgo = yes }
                }
            }
        }
        6 = {
            ordered_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_6_rgo_locations
                limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo } }
                order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                set_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo
                eu5ab_prepare_rgo_dependencies = yes
                scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_waiting_rgo } }
                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_try_best_remaining_rgo = yes }
                }
            }
        }
        7 = {
            ordered_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_7_rgo_locations
                limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo } }
                order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                set_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo
                eu5ab_prepare_rgo_dependencies = yes
                scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_waiting_rgo } }
                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_try_best_remaining_rgo = yes }
                }
            }
        }
        8 = {
            ordered_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_8_rgo_locations
                limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_done_rgo } }
                order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location

                eu5ab_prepare_rgo_dependencies = yes
