                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_try_best_remaining_rgo = yes }
                }
            }
        }
        }
    }

    }
}

# Root approved location. This acknowledges the approved script list itself;
# no engine quote, capacity sample, or client widget inspection is involved.
eu5ab_acknowledge_approved_engine_candidate = {
    if = { limit = {
        owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active
            eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
            OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire }
                AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting has_variable = eu5ab_winner_ticket } } }
        is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
        NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_seen_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
    }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_seen_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_seen add = 1 } }
    }
}

eu5ab_check_engine_phase_completion = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } }

    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire }
        has_variable = eu5ab_q_phase has_variable = eu5ab_q_processed has_variable = eu5ab_q_expected
        has_variable = eu5ab_q_approved has_variable = eu5ab_q_seen
        has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick has_variable = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
        if = { limit = { eu5ab_q_outstanding_approvals_value > 0 var:eu5ab_q_seen >= { value = var:eu5ab_q_approved } }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_fire value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 3 }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_q_processed >= { value = var:eu5ab_q_expected } }
        if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick >= var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
            eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes
        }
        else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_candidate_ranking_mode = 2
            NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } }
            eu5ab_prepare_actual_profit_selection = yes
        }
        else_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_retry_phase eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value <= 0 }
            eu5ab_restart_engine_priority_phase = yes
        }
        else_if = { limit = { eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value <= 0 }
            eu5ab_advance_engine_priority_phase = yes
        }
        }
    }

    }
}

eu5ab_check_engine_confirmation_completion = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } }

    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire
        eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
        has_variable = eu5ab_q_confirmed has_variable = eu5ab_q_approved
        has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick has_variable = eu5ab_monthly_build_quota
        var:eu5ab_q_confirmed >= { value = var:eu5ab_q_approved } }
        if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_q_processed < var:eu5ab_q_expected
            var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
            remove_variable = eu5ab_q_fire
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_confirm_stall_rounds value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 6 }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota }
            OR = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_retry_phase eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value > 0 } }
            eu5ab_restart_engine_priority_phase = yes
        }
        else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota } }
            eu5ab_advance_engine_priority_phase = yes
        }
        else = { eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes }
    }

    }
}

eu5ab_confirm_requested_engine_candidate = {
    if = { limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
        owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
            NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
        has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_requested
        is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
        NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
        eu5ab_confirm_engine_candidate = yes
        owner = { eu5ab_check_engine_confirmation_completion = yes }
    }
}
# Compatibility entry for already queued, stage-tagged GUI callbacks.
# Current data callbacks can call the completion-only effect directly.
eu5ab_tick_engine_script_queue = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } }

    if = { limit = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage OR = {
    AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage = 0 has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting }
    AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage > 0
        var:eu5ab_q_phase = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } }
} } eu5ab_process_script_rgo_queue = yes }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage OR = {
    AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage = 0 has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting }
    AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage > 0
        var:eu5ab_q_phase = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } }
} has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
        eu5ab_retry_waiting_candidate_data = yes
        eu5ab_check_engine_phase_completion = yes
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage OR = {
    AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage = 0 has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting }
    AND = { scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage > 0
        var:eu5ab_q_phase = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_check_stage
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } }
} has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire }
        eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value <= 0 has_variable = eu5ab_q_processed has_variable = eu5ab_q_seen
        has_variable = eu5ab_q_progress_last has_variable = eu5ab_q_stall_rounds }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_progress_now value = var:eu5ab_q_processed }
        change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_progress_now add = var:eu5ab_q_seen }
        if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_q_progress_now > { value = var:eu5ab_q_progress_last } }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_progress_last value = var:eu5ab_q_progress_now }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_stall_rounds value = 0 }
        }
        else = {
            change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_stall_rounds add = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_q_stall_rounds >= 12 }
                change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_recoveries add = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 5 }
                eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes
            }
        }
    }

    }
}

eu5ab_tick_engine_script_confirmation = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } }

    # Capture the phase before completion; late confirmation pulses cannot
    # spend a new phase's timeout after a successful restart or advance.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire
        eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
        eu5ab_check_engine_confirmation_completion = yes
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire
            has_variable = eu5ab_q_confirm_stall_rounds }
            change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_confirm_stall_rounds add = 1 }
            if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_q_confirm_stall_rounds >= 12 }
                change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_recoveries add = 1 }
                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 5 }
                eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes
            }
        }
    }

    }
}

# Count all owned template bindings, including paused and cooling locations.
# Old saves contain a partial scan counter under the same diagnostic name.
# Recount once without changing scan buckets, cursors or construction work.
eu5ab_ensure_template_coverage = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_coverage_initialized } }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_coverage_country
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_covered_locations value = 0 }
        every_owned_location = {
            # Owner changes can arrive in batches before their callbacks run.
            # Release a previous owner's count before adopting its location.
            eu5ab_remove_location_template_coverage = yes
            if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_template_coverage_owner value = scope:eu5ab_coverage_country }
                scope:eu5ab_coverage_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_covered_locations add = 1 } }
            }
        }
        set_variable = eu5ab_template_coverage_initialized
    }
}

# A location contributes once, even when its template is reapplied or replaced.
eu5ab_sync_location_template_coverage = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_coverage_location
        owner ?= {
            eu5ab_ensure_template_coverage = yes
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_coverage_country
            scope:eu5ab_coverage_location = {
                if = { limit = { NOT = { AND = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_template_coverage_owner
                    var:eu5ab_template_coverage_owner = scope:eu5ab_coverage_country
                } } }
                    eu5ab_remove_location_template_coverage = yes
                    scope:eu5ab_coverage_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_covered_locations add = 1 } }
                    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_template_coverage_owner value = scope:eu5ab_coverage_country }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# The stored country remains the contributor after a native ownership change.
eu5ab_remove_location_template_coverage = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_coverage_owner }
        var:eu5ab_template_coverage_owner ?= {
            if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_template_coverage_initialized }
                change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_covered_locations subtract = 1 }
            }
        }
        remove_variable = eu5ab_template_coverage_owner
    }
}

# Internal save migration. Persistent templates, settings, budgets, and
# already-confirmed construction markers are deliberately preserved.
eu5ab_migrate_runtime_v2 = {
	clear_variable_list = eu5ab_active_project_locations
	save_scope_as = eu5ab_migration_country
	every_owned_location = {
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_active_building_types has_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction } }
			save_scope_as = eu5ab_migration_active_location
			scope:eu5ab_migration_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_project_locations target = scope:eu5ab_migration_active_location } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_runtime_schema_version value = 2 }
}

eu5ab_mark_interrupted_scan_on_load = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active has_variable = eu5ab_scan_round_active has_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_active has_variable = eu5ab_q_active has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
		set_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load
	}
}

eu5ab_schedule_scan_resume_after_load = {
	if = {
		limit = { is_human = yes eu5ab_manual_value_global_enabled > 0 has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
		# Drain even the longest pre-load queue watchdog before resuming.
		trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.4 days = 3 }
	}
	else = { remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
}
eu5ab_recover_runtime_after_load = {
    eu5ab_migrate_rgo_pending_registry = yes
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_migrate_attempts = yes
    eu5ab_clear_winner_batch = yes
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_waiting
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_quote_restore_country
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_quote_pending_locations
        limit = { owner ?= scope:eu5ab_quote_restore_country }
        eu5ab_prepare_quote_reader_ticket = yes
    }
    eu5ab_clear_queue_bridge = yes set_variable = eu5ab_bridge_rebuild
    # Legacy rounds without a verifiable month are closed conservatively once.
    eu5ab_expire_old_scan_month = yes
    # Scan buckets, worker results, candidate lists, phase, expenditure and
    # settlement floors are persistent. None is a GUI animation continuation.
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_registry_schema_version } } eu5ab_rebuild_scan_registry_v1 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_scan_registry_schema_version < 1 } eu5ab_rebuild_scan_registry_v1 = yes }
    eu5ab_ensure_template_coverage = yes
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_runtime_schema_version } } eu5ab_migrate_runtime_v2 = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_runtime_schema_version < 2 } eu5ab_migrate_runtime_v2 = yes }
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_resume_country
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
        limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_resume_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_complete } }
        eu5ab_request_building_capacity = yes
    }
    # Rebuild aggregates from new confirmed IDs. No legacy GUI field enrolls
    # construction, and persistent completion dates are never reset here.
    eu5ab_pf_rebuild_goods_index = yes
    eu5ab_refresh_build_pending = yes
    eu5ab_pf_resume_maintenance = yes
    eu5ab_refresh_rgo_pending = yes
    if = { limit = { is_human = yes eu5ab_manual_value_global_enabled > 0
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_round_active } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active }
        any_owned_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_policy_id }
        OR = { current_day = 1 eu5ab_scan_calendar_open = yes }
    } trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_monthly.1 days = 1 } }
}
eu5ab_settle_saved_approvals = {
    save_scope_as = actor
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_resume_country
    # Settle a physical start before any approved cost or baseline is discarded.
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_approved_locations
        limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_resume_country }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_approved_types
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
                    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_issued eu5ab_approved_building_started = yes }
                        eu5ab_confirm_engine_candidate = yes
                    }
                    else = {
                        eu5ab_release_engine_candidate_reservation = yes
                        eu5ab_release_candidate_construction_demand = yes
                        eu5ab_release_candidate_output = yes
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    # All approvals are now settled or withdrawn, including locations no longer
    # owned by this country. No temporary spending reservation carries forward.
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_spend value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_budget value = 0 }
}
eu5ab_resume_saved_queue = {
    eu5ab_migrate_rgo_pending_registry = yes
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_migrate_attempts = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } eu5ab_batch_resume = yes }
    set_variable = eu5ab_bridge_schema eu5ab_clear_queue_bridge = yes
	if = { limit = { eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes }
	    eu5ab_settle_saved_approvals = yes
	    eu5ab_reset_engine_priority_phase_progress = yes
	    eu5ab_recover_pending_rgo_screens = yes
    eu5ab_prepare_engine_priority_phase = yes
	    eu5ab_reset_engine_candidate_watchdog_progress = yes
	    trigger_event_silently = { id = eu5ab_queue_watchdog.1 days = 1 }
	}

    eu5ab_dispatch_queue_bridge = yes
}

eu5ab_stamp_scan_month = {
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_year value = current_year }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 1 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 1 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 2 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 3 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 3 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 4 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 4 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 5 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 5 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 6 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 6 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 7 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 7 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 8 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 8 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 9 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 9 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 10 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 10 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 11 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 11 } }
    if = { limit = { current_month = 12 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_month value = 12 } }
}
eu5ab_expire_old_scan_month = {
    if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes }
        AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active NOT = { eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes } } }
        OR = {
        has_variable = eu5ab_scan_round_active has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active
        has_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_active has_variable = eu5ab_q_active
        has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load
        has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_approved_locations has_variable_list = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
    } }
        # No continuation or approval can execute while physical starts settle.
        remove_variable = eu5ab_q_active remove_variable = eu5ab_q_fire
        eu5ab_settle_saved_approvals = yes
        eu5ab_count_capacity_waiting = yes
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_capacity_expired value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_diag_capacity_waiting > 0 }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_capacity_expired value = var:eu5ab_diag_capacity_waiting }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_scan_stalled value = 1 }
        }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_expiring_country
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
            limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_expiring_country }
            eu5ab_clear_location_worker_state = yes eu5ab_clear_location_candidate_state = yes
        }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
        eu5ab_clear_engine_candidate_queue = yes
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_spend value = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_budget value = 0 }
        eu5ab_reset_committed_construction_demand = yes
        eu5ab_clear_scan_continuation = yes
        remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_active remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_finalizing
        remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_bucket_day remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load
        remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_dispatch_day
    }
}
eu5ab_clear_queue_bridge = {
    if = { limit = { exists = var:eu5ab_bridge_location }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_bridge_clear_country
        var:eu5ab_bridge_location = { if = { limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_bridge_clear_country }
            clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_parallel_tickets } }
    }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_candidate_1
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_candidate_2
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_profit_1
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_profit_2
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_rgo_1
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_rgo_2
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_fire_1
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_fire_2
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_confirmation_1
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_confirmation_2
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_bridge_request_locations clear_variable_map = eu5ab_bridge_request_types clear_variable_map = eu5ab_bridge_request_stages
    remove_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request remove_variable = eu5ab_bridge_location remove_variable = eu5ab_bridge_type
    remove_variable = eu5ab_bridge_kind remove_variable = eu5ab_bridge_parallel_needed remove_variable = eu5ab_bridge_parallel_received
    remove_variable = eu5ab_bridge_data_received remove_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request_day
}

eu5ab_publish_queue_bridge = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_sequence } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_sequence value = 0 } }
    change_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_sequence add = 1 }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_request value = var:eu5ab_bridge_sequence }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_request_day value = eu5ab_pl_today }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_phase value = var:eu5ab_q_phase }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_month value = var:eu5ab_scan_month }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_year value = var:eu5ab_scan_year }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_lane var:eu5ab_bridge_lane = 1 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_lane value = 2 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_lane value = 1 } }
    add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_bridge_request_locations key = var:eu5ab_bridge_request value = var:eu5ab_bridge_location }
    add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_bridge_request_stages key = var:eu5ab_bridge_request value = var:eu5ab_q_phase }
    if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_bridge_kind = 2 } add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_bridge_request_stages key = var:eu5ab_bridge_request value = 0 } }
    if = { limit = { exists = var:eu5ab_bridge_type } add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_bridge_request_types key = var:eu5ab_bridge_request value = var:eu5ab_bridge_type } }
    switch = { trigger = var:eu5ab_bridge_kind 1 = { if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_bridge_lane = 1 }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_candidate_1 target = var:eu5ab_bridge_request } }
        else = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_candidate_2 target = var:eu5ab_bridge_request } } }
2 = { if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_bridge_lane = 1 }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_profit_1 target = var:eu5ab_bridge_request } }
        else = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_profit_2 target = var:eu5ab_bridge_request } } }
3 = { if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_bridge_lane = 1 }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_rgo_1 target = var:eu5ab_bridge_request } }
        else = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_rgo_2 target = var:eu5ab_bridge_request } } }
4 = { if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_bridge_lane = 1 }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_fire_1 target = var:eu5ab_bridge_request } }
        else = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_fire_2 target = var:eu5ab_bridge_request } } } }
    if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_bridge_kind < 4 var:eu5ab_bridge_location = { num_civil_constructions > 0 } }
        set_variable = eu5ab_bridge_parallel_needed
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
        var:eu5ab_bridge_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_parallel_tickets target = scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_bridge_request } }
    }
}
eu5ab_publish_bridge_confirmation = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request }
        if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_bridge_lane = 1 } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_confirmation_1 target = var:eu5ab_bridge_request } }
        else = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_bridge_confirmation_2 target = var:eu5ab_bridge_request } }
    }
}
eu5ab_dispatch_queue_bridge = {
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } eu5ab_dispatch_construction_batch = yes }
        else = { eu5ab_dispatch_legacy_queue_bridge = yes }
    }

eu5ab_retire_bridge_candidate = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
    remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_unread_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_unread_types } }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_unread_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_clear_queue_bridge = yes }
}
eu5ab_recover_queue_bridge = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_schema has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
        save_scope_as = actor save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request eu5ab_pl_today >= { value = var:eu5ab_bridge_request_day add = 2 } }
            if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_bridge_kind = 4 }
                var:eu5ab_bridge_type = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building }
                var:eu5ab_bridge_location = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    if = { limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_issued } eu5ab_confirm_requested_engine_candidate = yes } }
            }
            eu5ab_clear_queue_bridge = yes set_variable = eu5ab_bridge_rebuild
        }
        eu5ab_dispatch_queue_bridge = yes
    }
}

eu5ab_record_cached_profit_candidate = {
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_priority value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_configured_priority }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit }
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value < 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude value = { value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value multiply = -1 } }
	}
	if = { limit = { eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value < 1 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude value = 1 } }
	set_variable = {
		name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
		value = {
			value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value
			multiply = eu5ab_profit_candidate_priority_value
			multiply = 0.01
			add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit
		}
	}
	# Penalize ranking only. Emergency negative-profit projects stay eligible.
	if = {
		limit = { eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value >= 0 }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank value = { value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_labor_factor } }
	}
	else = {
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank value = { value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value divide = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_labor_factor } }
	}
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank value = eu5ab_price_profit_rank }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank value = eu5ab_pending_profit_rank }
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank value = eu5ab_cached_capacity_profit_rank }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types }
				eu5ab_profit_best_rank_value < eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_best_actual value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_best_rank value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value }
		clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types
		add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
	}
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_priority
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
}

# Called by the country reducer after staging, never by parallel workers.
eu5ab_request_candidate_quotes = {
    if = { limit = { owner = { eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes OR = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema eu5ab_manual_value_global_candidate_ranking_mode = 2 } } }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
        if = { limit = { OR = {
        NOT = { eu5ab_quote_context_current = yes }
        AND = { owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } NOT = { var:eu5ab_batch_quote_schema = 3 } }
    } }
            eu5ab_clear_candidate_quotes = yes
        # Version 1 may contain corrupted build kinds; version 2 used the old
        # capital-only granary benefit. Retire both scores and GUI receipts.
        if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema } }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_batch_quote_schema value = 3 } }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_quote_country value = owner }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_quote_month value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_quote_year value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year }
            owner = {
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_quote_sequence } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_quote_sequence value = 0 } }
                change_variable = { name = eu5ab_quote_sequence add = 1 }
            }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_quote_ticket value = owner.var:eu5ab_quote_sequence }
        }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types
            limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = prev }
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = prev }
            } } } }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_quote_request_type
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = scope:eu5ab_quote_request_type } }
        }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_2_types
            limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = prev }
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = prev }
            } } } }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_quote_request_type
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = scope:eu5ab_quote_request_type } }
        }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_3_types
            limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = prev }
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = prev }
            } } } }

        }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_4_types
            limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = {

            limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = prev }
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = prev }
            } } } }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_quote_request_type
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = scope:eu5ab_quote_request_type } }
        }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_12_types
            limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = prev }
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = prev }
            } } } }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_quote_request_type
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = scope:eu5ab_quote_request_type } }
        }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_13_types
            limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = prev }
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = prev }
            } } } }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_quote_request_type
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = scope:eu5ab_quote_request_type } }
        }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_14_types
            limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = prev }
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = prev }
            } } } }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_quote_request_type
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = scope:eu5ab_quote_request_type } }
        }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_15_types
            limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = prev }
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = prev }
            } } } }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_quote_request_type
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = scope:eu5ab_quote_request_type } }
        }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_16_types
            limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { OR = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = prev }
                is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = prev }
            } } } }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_quote_request_type
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = scope:eu5ab_quote_request_type } }
        }
        eu5ab_prepare_quote_reader_ticket = yes
        owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
            add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_quote_requests }
            owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
                add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_pending_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
        }
    }
}

# One immutable numeric row per owner/month generation. Retries and load
# recovery rebuild this projection without changing the authoritative ticket.
eu5ab_prepare_quote_reader_ticket = {
    if = { limit = { eu5ab_quote_context_current = yes
        NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_tickets target = var:eu5ab_quote_ticket } } }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_quote_tickets
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_tickets target = var:eu5ab_quote_ticket }
    }
}
# No reservation or approval is allowed here. Preserve the original pool order
# even when native callbacks arrive out of order; pause at the first missing row.
eu5ab_rank_cached_queue = {
    save_scope_as = actor save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_waiting
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_bridge_unread_locations
        limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_quote_waiting } } }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
        eu5ab_request_candidate_quotes = yes
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_bridge_unread_types
            if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_quote_waiting } } }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                if = { limit = { eu5ab_quote_context_current = yes
                    is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_sample_day trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_sample_day } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_quote_sample_day target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } }
                        save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_cost value = eu5ab_cached_quote_cost }
                        save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_income value = eu5ab_cached_quote_income }
                        save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_profit value = eu5ab_cached_quote_profit }
                        save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_province_food_balance value = eu5ab_cached_quote_province_food_balance }
                        save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_province_food_natural value = eu5ab_cached_quote_province_food_natural }
                        save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_rgo_revenue value = eu5ab_cached_quote_rgo_revenue }
                    if = { limit = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_replaced_building trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_replaced_building } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_quote_replaced_building target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } }
                        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_quote_replacement value = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_replaced_building|scope:eu5ab_candidate_building)" }
                        var:eu5ab_quote_replacement = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_replaced_building }
                        remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_replacement
                        remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_no_replacement
                    }
                    else = { set_variable = eu5ab_quote_no_replacement }
                    eu5ab_prepare_candidate_dependencies = yes
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_done_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 } }
                    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_dependency_wait }
                        NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_failed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
                        eu5ab_refresh_native_recipes = yes
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_prepare_recipe_score_snapshot = yes }
                        if = { limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_engine_cost > 0
                            eu5ab_engine_candidate_in_current_priority_phase = yes
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
                                eu5ab_candidate_route_allowed = yes
                                eu5ab_has_local_workforce = yes
                                eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes
                                eu5ab_candidate_pending_allowed = yes
                                eu5ab_inputs_available = yes
                            }
                            eu5ab_cached_quote_capacity_factor > 0
                                scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_irrigation_demand = yes }
                                scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_storage_project_available = yes }
                                scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_demand = yes }
                                scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_demand = yes }
                                scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_food_balance = yes }
                                scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_return = yes }
                            OR = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_expected_output_value <= 0
                                eu5ab_engine_candidate_passes_selected_metric = yes
                                eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_emergency_demand = yes }
                        } eu5ab_record_cached_profit_candidate = yes }
                        eu5ab_clear_recipe_score_snapshot = yes
                    }
                    remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_unread_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
                    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_no_replacement
                }
                else = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { set_variable = eu5ab_quote_waiting } }
            }
            }
        }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_unread_types } }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_unread_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } } }
    }
}
eu5ab_clear_location_winner = { remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_cost remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_income remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_profit remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_province_food_balance remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_province_food_natural remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_rgo_revenue remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_parallel_modifier remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_ticket remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_type remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_requested remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_data_ready remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_parallel_needed remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_parallel_received remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_can_build remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_replaced_building
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_winner_parallel_tickets
}
eu5ab_clear_winner_batch = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_winner_clear_country
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_profit_locations limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_winner_clear_country }
        eu5ab_clear_location_winner = yes }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_winner_locations_1 clear_variable_list = eu5ab_winner_locations_2
    remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_ticket remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_phase
    remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_month remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_year
    remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_waiting
}
eu5ab_publish_winner_batch = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_winner_ticket } }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_sequence } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_sequence value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_sequence add = 1 }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_winner_ticket value = var:eu5ab_bridge_sequence }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_winner_phase value = var:eu5ab_q_phase }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_winner_month value = var:eu5ab_scan_month }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_winner_year value = var:eu5ab_scan_year }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_lane var:eu5ab_bridge_lane = 1 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_lane value = 2 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_lane value = 1 } }
    }
    ordered_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_bridge_unread_locations order_by = 1 max = var:eu5ab_q_expected check_range_bounds = no
        limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_winner_requested } }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
        eu5ab_clear_location_winner = yes
        set_variable = eu5ab_winner_requested
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_winner_ticket value = scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_winner_ticket }
        ordered_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_profit_best_types order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_winner_type value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
        if = { limit = { num_civil_constructions > 0 } set_variable = eu5ab_winner_parallel_needed
            add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_winner_parallel_tickets target = var:eu5ab_winner_ticket } }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_bridge_lane = 1 } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_winner_locations_1 target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } }
            else = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_winner_locations_2 target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_process_winner_batch = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
    has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting has_variable = eu5ab_winner_ticket
    var:eu5ab_winner_phase = var:eu5ab_q_phase
    var:eu5ab_winner_month = var:eu5ab_scan_month var:eu5ab_winner_year = var:eu5ab_scan_year }
        save_scope_as = actor save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
        remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_waiting
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_bridge_unread_locations limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country }
            if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_winner_waiting } } }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
            if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_winner_requested has_variable = eu5ab_winner_data_ready
                var:eu5ab_winner_ticket = scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_winner_ticket
                OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_winner_parallel_needed } has_variable = eu5ab_winner_parallel_received } }
                var:eu5ab_winner_type = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_cost value = eu5ab_winner_cost_value }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_income value = eu5ab_winner_income_value }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_profit value = eu5ab_winner_profit_value }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_province_food_balance value = eu5ab_winner_province_food_balance_value }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_province_food_natural value = eu5ab_winner_province_food_natural_value }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_rgo_revenue value = eu5ab_winner_rgo_revenue_value }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_engine_parallel_modifier value = eu5ab_winner_parallel_modifier_value }
                if = { limit = { exists = var:eu5ab_winner_replaced_building }
                    var:eu5ab_winner_replaced_building = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_replaced_building }
                    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_no_replacement }
                else = { set_variable = eu5ab_quote_no_replacement }
                eu5ab_prepare_candidate_dependencies = yes set_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_done
                scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_processed add = 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_engine_probes add = 1 } }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_dependency_wait } }
			eu5ab_clear_validation = yes
			eu5ab_refresh_native_recipes = yes
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_prepare_recipe_score_snapshot = yes }
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_location_approved }
					eu5ab_engine_candidate_in_current_priority_phase = yes
					eu5ab_engine_has_parallel_room = yes
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { eu5ab_q_outstanding_approvals_value < {
						value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota subtract = var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
					} }
					has_variable = eu5ab_winner_can_build
					eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_capacity = yes
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
						eu5ab_candidate_route_allowed = yes
						eu5ab_has_local_workforce = yes
						eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes
						eu5ab_candidate_pending_allowed = yes
					}
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_irrigation_demand = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_storage_project_available = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_demand = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_demand = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_food_balance = yes }
					scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_return = yes }
				}
				eu5ab_ensure_validation_inputs = yes
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_passed }
					eu5ab_ensure_validation_economics = yes
					if = {
						limit = {
							has_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_passed
							eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_actual_budget = yes
							eu5ab_engine_candidate_keeps_actual_cash_reserve = yes
						}
						eu5ab_ensure_validation_materials = yes
						if = {
							limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_materials_passed }
							set_variable = eu5ab_validation_passed
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_passed }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_emergency } set_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override }
				else = { remove_variable = eu5ab_q_approved_emergency_override }
				eu5ab_approve_engine_candidate = yes
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_capacity = yes } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_ready }
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_building_capacity add = 1 } }
				}
				else = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_capacity_unavailable add = 1 } } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_winner_can_build } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_pending_allowed = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_pending_output add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_oversupply add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_irrigation_demand = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_irrigation_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_storage_project_available = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_storage_pending add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_demand = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_granary_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_demand = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_windmill_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_granary_food_balance = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_granary_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { NOT = { eu5ab_candidate_has_windmill_return = yes } } }
				scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_windmill_need add = 1 } }
			}
			else = {
				eu5ab_ensure_validation_economics = yes
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_passed } }
					scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_engine_economics add = 1 } }
				}
				else = {
					eu5ab_ensure_validation_inputs = yes
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_passed } }
						scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_inputs add = 1 } }
					}
					else = {
						eu5ab_ensure_validation_materials = yes
						if = {
							limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_materials_passed } }
							scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_construction_materials add = 1 } }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_actual_budget = yes } }
							scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_budget add = 1 } }
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_keeps_actual_cash_reserve = yes } }
							scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_fail_cash add = 1 } }
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_passed } } eu5ab_report_candidate_rejected = yes }
			eu5ab_clear_validation = yes
			eu5ab_clear_recipe_score_snapshot = yes
                }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_location_approved } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_dependency_wait }
                    eu5ab_location_has_parallel_room = yes scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                        eu5ab_q_outstanding_approvals_value < { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota subtract = var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick } } }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_failed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { set_variable = eu5ab_q_retry_phase } }
                remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_no_replacement
                scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                    remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_unread_locations target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
                    remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_winner_locations_1 target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
                    remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_winner_locations_2 target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location } }
                eu5ab_clear_location_winner = yes
            }
            else = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { set_variable = eu5ab_winner_waiting } }
            }
        }
        eu5ab_check_engine_phase_completion = yes
    }
}

						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_soldiers } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_soldiers_ready } }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_promotion_soldiers value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_promotion }
						set_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_soldiers_ready
					}
				}
			}
			building_type:zhixian = {
				scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
					if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_nobles } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_nobles_ready } }
						set_variable = { name = eu5ab_scan_promotion_nobles value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_promotion }
						set_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_nobles_ready
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Eligibility is reused only within one worker, including failed results.
# The final construction/GUI workforce triggers remain live and uncached.
eu5ab_prepare_candidate_workforce = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_country
    owner = var:eu5ab_sp_country
    var:eu5ab_sp_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_workforce_calls } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_workforce_calls add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_workforce_calls value = 1 } }
}
remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_workforce_passed
		if = {
			limit = { owner.eu5ab_manual_value_global_pause_low_workforce <= 0 }
if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_country
    owner = var:eu5ab_sp_country
    var:eu5ab_sp_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_workforce_off } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_workforce_off add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_workforce_off value = 1 } }
}
			set_variable = eu5ab_candidate_workforce_passed
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_active
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_candidate_workforce_checked target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
			}
if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_country
    owner = var:eu5ab_sp_country
    var:eu5ab_sp_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_workforce_hit } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_workforce_hit add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_workforce_hit value = 1 } }
}
			if = {
				limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_candidate_workforce_passed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
				set_variable = eu5ab_candidate_workforce_passed
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_country
    owner = var:eu5ab_sp_country
    var:eu5ab_sp_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_workforce_live } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_workforce_live add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_workforce_live value = 1 } }
}
scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_evaluate_candidate_workforce = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_active }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_candidate_workforce_checked target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
				if = {
					limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_candidate_workforce_passed }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_candidate_workforce_passed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

# Dispatch once; keep the original available >= net-new-jobs arithmetic.
eu5ab_evaluate_candidate_workforce = {
	switch = {
		trigger = this
		building_type:academy_of_sciences = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				eu5ab_prepare_promotion_nobles = yes
				eu5ab_prepare_scan_queued_jobs_nobles = yes
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_required_workers value = {
					if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_screen_active AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs_ready trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs_ready } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs_ready target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } }
						value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_net_new_jobs
					}
					else = {
					value = 0.05
					}
				} }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_candidate_available_workers value = {
					value = "location_unemployed_population_for_building_type(building_type:academy_of_sciences)"
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_nobles }
						add = var:eu5ab_scan_promotion_nobles
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_nobles_ready } }
						add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_projected_promotion
					}
					subtract = { value = 0 min = eu5ab_scan_queued_jobs_nobles }
					min = 0
				} }
				if = {
					limit = { var:eu5ab_candidate_available_workers >= var:eu5ab_candidate_required_workers }
					set_variable = eu5ab_candidate_workforce_passed
				}
				remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_required_workers
				remove_variable = eu5ab_candidate_available_workers
			}
		}
		building_type:admiralty = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				eu5ab_prepare_promotion_burghers = yes
				eu5ab_prepare_scan_queued_jobs_burghers = yes

					}
					else = {
					value = 0.1

					value = "location_unemployed_population_for_building_type(building_type:lacquerware_guild)"
					if = {
						limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_burghers }
						add = var:eu5ab_scan_promotion_burghers

					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_promotion_burghers_ready } }

					}
					subtract = { value = 0 min = eu5ab_scan_queued_jobs_burghers }
					min = 0
				} }
				if = {
					limit = { var:eu5ab_candidate_available_workers >= var:eu5ab_candidate_required_workers }
					set_variable = eu5ab_candidate_workforce_passed

# Building scope. Never put mutable state on shared building types.
eu5ab_prepare_recipe_screen_snapshot = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_clear_recipe_score_snapshot = yes }
	switch = {
		trigger = this
		building_type:academy_of_sciences = {
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_slot_0 value = prev.eu5ab_recipe_academy_of_sciences_0_live_selected }
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_value value = {
					value = 0
					if = {
						limit = { var:eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_slot_0 = 1 }
					}
				} }
				set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_value_ready
				set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_building value = prev }
			}
		}

	if = { limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_rank_ready } } }
	switch = {
		trigger = this
		building_type:academy_of_sciences = {

eu5ab_prepare_candidate_score_snapshot = {
	eu5ab_complete_recipe_score_snapshot = yes
	eu5ab_prepare_town_rights_candidate_score = yes
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_weight_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_weight value = prev.eu5ab_output_weight }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_weight_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_low_weight_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_low_weight value = prev.eu5ab_output_low_weight }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_low_weight_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_high_weight_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_high_weight value = prev.eu5ab_output_high_weight }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_high_weight_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_price_factor_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_price_factor value = prev.eu5ab_output_price_factor }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_price_factor_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_high_price_bonus_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_high_price_bonus value = prev.eu5ab_output_high_price_bonus }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_output_high_price_bonus_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_base_score_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_base_score value = prev.eu5ab_candidate_base_score }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_base_score_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_current_labor_factor_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_current_labor_factor value = prev.eu5ab_candidate_current_labor_factor }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_current_labor_factor_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_unadjusted_candidate_score_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_unadjusted_candidate_score value = prev.eu5ab_unadjusted_candidate_score }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_unadjusted_candidate_score_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_price_adjusted_candidate_score_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_price_adjusted_candidate_score value = prev.eu5ab_price_adjusted_candidate_score }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_price_adjusted_candidate_score_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_pending_factor_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_pending_factor value = prev.eu5ab_candidate_pending_factor }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_pending_factor_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_pending_preliminary_factor_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_pending_preliminary_factor value = prev.eu5ab_candidate_pending_preliminary_factor }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_pending_preliminary_factor_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_pending_adjusted_candidate_score_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_pending_adjusted_candidate_score value = prev.eu5ab_pending_adjusted_candidate_score }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_pending_adjusted_candidate_score_ready
		}
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_capacity_factor_ready } }
			set_variable = { name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_capacity_factor value = prev.eu5ab_candidate_capacity_factor }
			set_variable = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_candidate_capacity_factor_ready
		}
	}
}

	}

eu5ab_clear_validation = {
	remove_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_checked
	remove_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_passed
	remove_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_checked
	remove_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_passed
	remove_variable = eu5ab_validation_materials_checked
	remove_variable = eu5ab_validation_materials_passed
	remove_variable = eu5ab_validation_emergency
	remove_variable = eu5ab_validation_passed
}

eu5ab_ensure_validation_inputs = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_checked } }
		if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_inputs_available = yes } } set_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_passed }
		set_variable = eu5ab_validation_inputs_checked
	}
}

eu5ab_ensure_validation_materials = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_materials_checked } }
		if = { limit = { eu5ab_engine_construction_materials_available = yes } set_variable = eu5ab_validation_materials_passed }
		set_variable = eu5ab_validation_materials_checked
	}
}

# Called only within one GUI invocation, before any reservation is changed.
eu5ab_ensure_validation_economics = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_checked } }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:eu5ab_engine_cost > 0 }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_recipe_expected_output_value <= 0 }
                set_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_passed
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_passes_selected_metric = yes }
                set_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_passed
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { eu5ab_engine_candidate_has_emergency_demand = yes }
                set_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_passed
                set_variable = eu5ab_validation_emergency
            }
        }
        set_variable = eu5ab_validation_economics_checked
    }
}

eu5ab_report_candidate_waiting = {
    owner = {
        if = { limit = {
                exists = var:eu5ab_diag_top_1_location var:eu5ab_diag_top_1_location = prev
                exists = var:eu5ab_diag_top_1_building var:eu5ab_diag_top_1_building = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_reason value = 10 } }
        if = { limit = {
                exists = var:eu5ab_diag_top_2_location var:eu5ab_diag_top_2_location = prev
                exists = var:eu5ab_diag_top_2_building var:eu5ab_diag_top_2_building = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_reason value = 10 } }
        if = { limit = {
                exists = var:eu5ab_diag_top_3_location var:eu5ab_diag_top_3_location = prev
                exists = var:eu5ab_diag_top_3_building var:eu5ab_diag_top_3_building = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_top_3_reason value = 10 } }
    }
}

eu5ab_clear_building_capacity = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_used
    remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_limit
    remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_ready
    remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_open
    remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_factor
}
# Readings belong to this invocation, never to a former candidate or owner.
eu5ab_refresh_approved_cash_quote = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_quote_ready
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost scope:eu5ab_engine_cost >= 0 }
        # Replace this project's hold in one expression, including a zero
        # balance. Other approved projects keep their reservations unchanged.
        owner = {
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_spend value = {
                value = eu5ab_q_planned_spend_value subtract = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_q_approved_cost_value add = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost } }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_planned_budget value = {
                value = eu5ab_q_planned_budget_value subtract = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_q_approved_cost_value add = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost } }
        }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_cost value = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost }
        set_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_quote_ready
    }
}
eu5ab_capture_building_capacity = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
    eu5ab_prepare_active_recipe_catalog_view = yes
    eu5ab_clear_building_capacity = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_capacity_used
            scope:eu5ab_engine_capacity_used >= 0
            modifier:free_building_levels > 0
        }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_capacity_used value = scope:eu5ab_engine_capacity_used }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_capacity_limit value = modifier:free_building_levels }
        set_variable = eu5ab_capacity_ready
        if = {
            limit = { eu5ab_capacity_below_stop = yes }
            set_variable = eu5ab_capacity_open
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_capacity_factor value = 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_capacity_no_discount = yes } }
                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_capacity_factor value = {
                    value = eu5ab_capacity_used_value
                    divide = eu5ab_capacity_limit_value
                    subtract = 1.10
                    multiply = -1
                    divide = 0.15
                    min = 0.00001
                    max = 1
                } }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { eu5ab_active_recipe_capture_needed = yes }
        eu5ab_refresh_native_recipes = yes
    }
    else = { eu5ab_clear_native_recipes = yes }
}
# Dispatch requests carry no old snapshot, including after loading an old save.
eu5ab_request_building_capacity = {
    eu5ab_clear_industry_snapshot = yes
    eu5ab_clear_rgo_queue = yes
    eu5ab_clear_building_capacity = yes
    eu5ab_clear_native_recipes = yes
    eu5ab_clear_parallel_capacity = yes
    remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_complete
    remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_received remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_reason
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_capacity_sequence value = { value = 0
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_sequence } add = var:eu5ab_capacity_sequence } add = 1 } }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_capacity_request value = var:eu5ab_capacity_sequence }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_capacity_month value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_capacity_year value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_capacity_tickets
    add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_capacity_tickets target = var:eu5ab_capacity_request }
    set_variable = eu5ab_capacity_requested
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_capacity_worker_country value = owner }
    eu5ab_request_upgrade_snapshot = yes
}
# A delayed parallel event and the next-day fallback can never run twice.
eu5ab_run_capacity_worker_once = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_worker_country has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_received
            NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_complete }
            NOT = { owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } } }
        if = {
            limit = {
                owner = var:eu5ab_capacity_worker_country
                var:eu5ab_capacity_month = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
                var:eu5ab_capacity_year = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
                owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes }
            }
            remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_worker_country
            remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_requested
            owner = { save_scope_as = actor }
            eu5ab_run_location_worker = yes
        }
        else = {
            remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_worker_country
            remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_requested
            eu5ab_clear_building_capacity = yes
        }
    }
}
# Retrying a missing receipt preserves its identity and never starts screening.
eu5ab_finish_pending_capacity_workers = {
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
        eu5ab_run_capacity_worker_once = yes
        if = { limit = {
    has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_requested
    has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_worker_country
    NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_complete }
    owner = var:eu5ab_capacity_worker_country
    has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_request
    var:eu5ab_capacity_month = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
    var:eu5ab_capacity_year = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
    owner = {
        has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active
        eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
        is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations target = prev }
    }
 }
            clear_variable_list = eu5ab_capacity_tickets
            add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_capacity_tickets target = var:eu5ab_capacity_request }
        }
    }
    eu5ab_count_capacity_waiting = yes
}
eu5ab_count_capacity_waiting = {
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_capacity_waiting value = 0 }
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_capacity_count_country
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
        limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_capacity_count_country has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_requested }
        scope:eu5ab_capacity_count_country = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_capacity_waiting value = {
            value = 0 if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_capacity_waiting } add = var:eu5ab_diag_capacity_waiting } add = 1 } } }
    }
}
# GUI callbacks are serial. Parallel worker events publish only location state;
# this reducer runs from the GUI pump as soon as the complete batch is ready.
eu5ab_reduce_capacity_batch = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_active eu5ab_scan_month_current = yes
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load }
        has_variable_list = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
        NOT = { any_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations owner = prev
            NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_complete } } } }
        eu5ab_merge_location_worker_results = yes
        eu5ab_count_capacity_waiting = yes
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_finalizing eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes }
            eu5ab_finish_regional_development_scan = yes }
    }
}
eu5ab_clear_native_recipes = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_native_recipe_owner
    remove_variable = eu5ab_native_recipe_capturing
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_native_recipe_types
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_native_recipe_conflicts
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_native_recipe_slot_0
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_native_recipe_slot_1
}
eu5ab_begin_native_recipe_capture = {
    eu5ab_clear_native_recipes = yes
    eu5ab_clear_recipe_score_snapshot = yes
    set_variable = eu5ab_native_recipe_capturing
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_native_recipe_location
    every_buildings_in_location = {
        limit = {
            owner = scope:eu5ab_native_recipe_location.owner
            NOT = { exists = estate_type }
            OR = {
                scope:eu5ab_native_recipe_location = { NOT = { eu5ab_active_recipe_catalog_current = yes } }
                building_type = { eu5ab_native_recipe_relevant_to_active_catalog = yes }
            }
        }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_native_recipe_building
        if = { limit = { eu5ab_pr_recipe_known = yes }
            every_production_method_of_building = {
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_native_recipe_method
                scope:eu5ab_native_recipe_location = { eu5ab_capture_native_recipe_method = yes }
            }
        }
        else = {
            building_type = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_native_recipe_unknown_type }
            scope:eu5ab_native_recipe_location = {
                add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_native_recipe_conflicts target = scope:eu5ab_native_recipe_unknown_type }
            }
        }
    }
}
