eu5ab_finish_native_recipe_capture = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_native_recipe_capturing }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = eu5ab_native_recipe_conflicts
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_conflicted_recipe_type
            prev = { remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_native_recipe_types target = scope:eu5ab_conflicted_recipe_type } }
        }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_native_recipe_owner value = owner }
        remove_variable = eu5ab_native_recipe_capturing
    }
}
eu5ab_refresh_native_recipes = {
    eu5ab_begin_native_recipe_capture = yes
    eu5ab_finish_native_recipe_capture = yes
}
eu5ab_clear_parallel_capacity = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_parallel_limit
    remove_variable = eu5ab_parallel_occupied
    remove_variable = eu5ab_parallel_modifier
    remove_variable = eu5ab_parallel_owner
}
eu5ab_capture_parallel_queue = {
    eu5ab_clear_parallel_capacity = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_count
            exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_has_room
            exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_parallel_modifier
            scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_has_room = yes
            scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_count = num_civil_constructions
            scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_count > 0
            scope:eu5ab_engine_parallel_modifier = modifier:max_constructions_at_same_time
        }
        # The GUI proves only that the next native slot is open. Require a new
        # sample after a start rather than inferring all remaining slots.
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_parallel_limit value = { value = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_count add = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_parallel_occupied value = scope:eu5ab_engine_queue_count }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_parallel_modifier value = scope:eu5ab_engine_parallel_modifier }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_parallel_owner value = owner }
    }
}
eu5ab_record_requested_engine_fire = {
    if = { limit = {
        owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
        owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } }
        OR = { owner = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_schema } }
    AND = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } exists = scope:eu5ab_bridge_ticket has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request
    scope:eu5ab_bridge_ticket = var:eu5ab_bridge_request
    var:eu5ab_bridge_phase = var:eu5ab_q_phase
    var:eu5ab_bridge_month = var:eu5ab_scan_month
    var:eu5ab_bridge_year = var:eu5ab_scan_year var:eu5ab_bridge_location = prev }
    OR = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_bridge_kind = 3
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_bridge_type = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
        has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_requested
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_issued }
        is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_approved_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
        NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
    }
        set_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_issued
        if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_schema } }
            owner = { eu5ab_publish_bridge_confirmation = yes }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_record_confirmed_building = {
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_active_count_next value = { value = eu5ab_active_type_count add = 1 } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_building_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_active_building_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
        add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_baselines key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = eu5ab_type_level_before_value }
    }
    add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_counts key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = var:eu5ab_active_count_next }
    remove_variable = eu5ab_active_count_next
}

        }

    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_q_started_locations
        limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_cooldown_country }

    }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_started_locations
}
# Called serially during the country project-count refresh.
eu5ab_refresh_active_building_type = {
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_active_count_next value = eu5ab_active_type_count }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_active_building_baselines AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_active_building_baselines trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_active_building_baselines } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_baselines target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } }
        if = {
            limit = { eu5ab_candidate_completed_levels >= { value = "variable_map(eu5ab_active_building_baselines|scope:eu5ab_candidate_building)" } }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_active_count_next value = {
                value = var:eu5ab_active_count_next
                min = 0
                max = eu5ab_candidate_queued_levels
            } }
        }
        else = { remove_variable = eu5ab_active_count_next }
    }
    else = { remove_variable = eu5ab_active_count_next }
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_active_count_next var:eu5ab_active_count_next > 0 }
        add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_counts key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = var:eu5ab_active_count_next }
        add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_baselines key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = eu5ab_candidate_completed_levels }
        owner = { change_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.var:eu5ab_active_count_next } }
    }
    else = {
        remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_active_building_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
        remove_from_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_counts key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
        remove_from_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_active_building_baselines key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
    }
    remove_variable = eu5ab_active_count_next
}
eu5ab_pf_observe_geometry = {
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_old_queue
        value = eu5ab_pf_queued_value
    }
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_done
        value = {
            value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_levels
            subtract = eu5ab_pf_last_levels_value
            subtract = {
                value = eu5ab_pf_last_queue_value
                subtract = local_var:eu5ab_pf_old_queue
                min = 0
            }
            min = 0
            max = local_var:eu5ab_pf_old_queue
        }
    }
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_cancelled
        value = {
            value = eu5ab_pf_last_levels_value
            add = eu5ab_pf_last_queue_value
            subtract = local_var:eu5ab_pf_levels
            subtract = local_var:eu5ab_pf_physical_queue
            min = 0
        }
    }
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_next_queue
        value = {
            value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_old_queue
            subtract = local_var:eu5ab_pf_done
            subtract = local_var:eu5ab_pf_cancelled
            min = 0
            max = local_var:eu5ab_pf_physical_queue
        }
    }
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_building
    eu5ab_pf_reconcile_cohorts = yes
    eu5ab_pf_store_geometry = yes
}
eu5ab_pf_observe = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_pf_registered = yes
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    building_level = eu5ab_pf_last_levels_value
                    building_levels_under_construction = eu5ab_pf_last_queue_value
                }
            }
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_levels
            value = building_level
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_physical_queue
            value = building_levels_under_construction
        }
        eu5ab_pf_observe_geometry = yes
    }
}
eu5ab_pf_capture_start_geometry = {
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_start_type
        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_start_owner
        value = owner
    }
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_start_levels
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_start_queue
    every_buildings_in_location = {
        limit = {
            owner = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner
            NOT = {
                exists = estate_type
            }
            building_type = {
                this = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            }
        }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_start_building
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_start_level_value
            value = building_level
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_start_queue_value
            value = building_levels_under_construction
        }
        location = {
            add_to_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_start_levels
                key = scope:eu5ab_pf_start_building
                value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_start_level_value
            }
            add_to_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_start_queue
                key = scope:eu5ab_pf_start_building
                value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_start_queue_value
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_pf_register_start = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = eu5ab_pf_start_type
            var:eu5ab_pf_start_type = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            var:eu5ab_pf_start_owner = owner
        }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_registered_this_attempt
            value = 0
        }
        every_buildings_in_location = {
            limit = {
                owner = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner
                NOT = {
                    exists = estate_type
                }
                building_type = {
                    this = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                }
                local_var:eu5ab_pf_registered_this_attempt = 0
                OR = {
                    building_level > eu5ab_pf_start_levels_value
                    building_levels_under_construction > eu5ab_pf_start_queue_value
                }
            }
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_building
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_levels
                value = eu5ab_pf_start_levels_value
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_physical_queue
                value = eu5ab_pf_start_queue_value
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    eu5ab_pf_registered = yes
                }
                eu5ab_pf_observe_geometry = yes
                set_local_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_next_queue
                    value = {
                        value = eu5ab_pf_queued_value
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                set_local_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_next_queue
                    value = 1
                }
                location = {
                    add_to_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_owner
                        key = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                        value = owner
                    }
                }
            }
            location.owner = {
                eu5ab_pf_register_cohort = yes
            }
            change_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_physical_queue
                add = 1
            }
            eu5ab_pf_store_geometry = yes
            location.owner = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                name = eu5ab_pf_projects
                                target = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_projects
                        target = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                    }
                }
            }
            eu5ab_pf_observe = yes
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_registered_this_attempt
                value = 1
            }
        }
        remove_variable = eu5ab_pf_start_type
        remove_variable = eu5ab_pf_start_owner
    }
}
eu5ab_pf_refresh_projects = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_country
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_pf_projects
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_building
        if = {
            limit = {
                exists = this
                location.owner = scope:eu5ab_pf_country
                eu5ab_pf_registered = yes
            }
            eu5ab_pf_observe = yes
        }
        else = {
            scope:eu5ab_pf_country = {
                remove_list_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_projects
                    target = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_pf_store_geometry = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_building
    location = {
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_queued
            key = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
            value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_next_queue
        }
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_last_levels
            key = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
            value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_levels
        }
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_last_queue
            key = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
            value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_physical_queue
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_clear_quote_production_values = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_type
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_known

    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_known
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_efficiency

    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_input_ready
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_adjusted_profit
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_adjusted_profit_ready

    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input

eu5ab_clear_quote_production_snapshot = {
    eu5ab_clear_quote_production_values = yes
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_active
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_search_type
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_search_reference
}
eu5ab_prepare_quote_production_snapshot = {
if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_active owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
owner = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_quote_production_calls } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_production_calls add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_production_calls value = 1 } } }
}
    eu5ab_clear_quote_production_values = yes
    scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_active
                    has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_search_type
                    var:eu5ab_quote_production_search_type = prev
                }
            }
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        exists = var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building
                        exists = var:eu5ab_quote_production_search_reference
                        var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building = var:eu5ab_quote_production_search_reference
                    }
                    set_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_known
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_pending_identity_known_live = yes
            }
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                set_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_known
            }
        }
        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_known
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                    value = var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_efficiency
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                eu5ab_pending_exact_predecessor_live = yes
            }
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                set_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_known
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_efficiency
                    value = scope:eu5ab_engine_replaced_building.eu5ab_pr_efficiency
                }
            }
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_quote_production_type
        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
    }
}

eu5ab_prepare_quote_economy_snapshot = {
if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_active owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
owner = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_quote_economy_calls } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_economy_calls add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_economy_calls value = 1 } } }
}
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_quote_production_adjusted_profit
        value = eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit_live
    }
    set_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_adjusted_profit_ready
}

        name = eu5ab_map_write_value
        value = {
            value = var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building.eu5ab_pr_nominal_input_incense_validated
            multiply = {
                value = 0
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                    }
                    add = var:eu5ab_quote_production_reference_efficiency
                }
            }
        }
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input
        key = goods:incense
        value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
    }
}
eu5ab_quote_production_cache_predecessor_input_incense = {
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_map_write_value
        value = {
            value = scope:eu5ab_engine_replaced_building.eu5ab_pr_nominal_input_incense_validated
            multiply = {
                value = 0
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_efficiency
                    }
                    add = var:eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_efficiency
                }
            }
        }
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_input
        key = goods:incense
        value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
    }
}
eu5ab_quote_production_cache_net_input_incense = {
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_map_write_value
        value = {
            value = {
                value = 0
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input
                            target = goods:incense
                        } } }
                    }
                    add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_reference_input|goods:incense)"
                }
            }
            subtract = {
                value = 0
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_input trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_input } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_input
                            target = goods:incense
                        } } }
                    }
                    add = "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_production_predecessor_input|goods:incense)"
                }
            }
            min = 0
        }
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_quote_production_net_input
        key = goods:incense
        value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
    }
}
eu5ab_pf_ensure_maintenance = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable_list = eu5ab_pf_cohorts
            NOT = {
                has_variable = eu5ab_pf_maintenance_after
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_maintenance_after
            value = {
                value = eu5ab_pl_today
                add = 1
            }
        }
        trigger_event_silently = {
            id = eu5ab_pf_maintenance.1
            days = 1
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_pf_resume_maintenance = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_pf_maintenance_after
    eu5ab_pf_ensure_maintenance = yes
}
eu5ab_pf_maintain_registered_projects = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = eu5ab_pf_maintenance_after
            var:eu5ab_pf_maintenance_after <= eu5ab_pl_today
        }
        remove_variable = eu5ab_pf_maintenance_after
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable_list = eu5ab_pf_cohorts
            }
            eu5ab_ensure_build_pending = yes
            eu5ab_pf_ensure_maintenance = yes
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_pf_capture_project_recipe = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_recipe_captured
                    target = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                }
            }
        }
        add_to_variable_list = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_recipe_captured
            target = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eu5ab_pf_building = {
                    eu5ab_pr_recipe_known = yes
                }
            }
            add_to_variable_list = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_recipe_known
                target = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
            }
            switch = {
                trigger = scope:eu5ab_pf_building.building_type
                building_type:academy_of_sciences = {
                    scope:eu5ab_pf_building = {
                        every_production_method_of_building = {
                            save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_recipe_method
                            scope:eu5ab_pf_country = {
                                switch = {
                                    trigger = scope:eu5ab_pf_recipe_method
                                    production_method:estate_building_input = {

                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                building_type:admiralty = {
                    scope:eu5ab_pf_building = {
                        every_production_method_of_building = {
                            save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_recipe_method
                            scope:eu5ab_pf_country = {
                                switch = {
                                    trigger = scope:eu5ab_pf_recipe_method
                                    production_method:admiralty_requirements = {
                                        if = {
                                            limit = {
                                                NOT = {
                                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_recipe_next_books trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_recipe_next_books } is_key_in_variable_map = {

                                                    value = {
                                                        value = 0

                                                            limit = {
                                                                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_recipe_head trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_recipe_head } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                                                    name = eu5ab_pf_recipe_head
                                                                    target = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                                                                } } }
                                                            }
                                                            add = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_recipe_head|scope:eu5ab_pf_building)"

                    NOT = {

                                    } } }
                                }
                            }

                    name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_next_alum

                            target = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                        } } }
                    }
                }
                set_local_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_map_write_value
                    value = {
                        value = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head
                                        target = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                                    } } }
                                }
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                NOT = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head
                                        target = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                                    } } }
                                }
                            }
                            value = -1
                        }
                    }
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_next_wool
                    key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                    value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head
                    key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                    value = 75
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_pf_reconcile_cohorts = {
    location.owner = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_country
        every_in_list = {
            variable = eu5ab_pf_cohorts
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_id
                value = this
            }
            scope:eu5ab_pf_country = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_building|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_state|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 0
                        local_var:eu5ab_pf_done > 0
                    }
                    eu5ab_pf_complete_cohort = yes
                    change_local_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_done
                        subtract = 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = eu5ab_pf_cohorts
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_id
                value = this
            }
            scope:eu5ab_pf_country = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_building|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_state|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 0
                        local_var:eu5ab_pf_cancelled > 0
                    }
                    eu5ab_pf_drop_cohort = yes
                    change_local_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_cancelled
                        subtract = 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        every_in_list = {
            variable = eu5ab_pf_cohorts
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_id
                value = this
            }
            scope:eu5ab_pf_country = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_building|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_state|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 1
                        local_var:eu5ab_pf_cancelled > 0
                    }
                    eu5ab_pf_drop_cohort = yes
                    change_local_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_cancelled
                        subtract = 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_pf_complete_cohort = {
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_c_state
        key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
        value = 1
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_c_jobs
        key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
        value = scope:eu5ab_pf_building.eu5ab_pr_jobs_per_level
    }
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_map_write_value
        value = {
            value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_levels
            subtract = local_var:eu5ab_pf_done
            min = 0
        }
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_c_baseline_levels
        key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
        value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
    }
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_map_write_value
        value = {
            value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_levels
            subtract = local_var:eu5ab_pf_done
            multiply = scope:eu5ab_pf_building.eu5ab_pr_jobs_per_level
            min = 0
        }
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_c_baseline_jobs
        key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
        value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_horizon|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" <= 0
        }
        eu5ab_pf_drop_cohort = yes
    }
    else = {
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_protection_months
            value = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_horizon|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_known|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 0
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_protection_months
                value = 3
            }
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_month_total
            value = {
                value = eu5ab_pf_current_month
                add = local_var:eu5ab_pf_protection_months
                subtract = 1
            }
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_year_offset
            value = {
                value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_month_total
                divide = 12
                floor = yes
            }
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_target_month
            value = {
                value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_month_total
                subtract = {
                    value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_year_offset
                    multiply = 12
                }
                add = 1
            }
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_month_days
            value = 31
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                OR = {
                    local_var:eu5ab_pf_target_month = 4
                    local_var:eu5ab_pf_target_month = 6
                    local_var:eu5ab_pf_target_month = 9
                    local_var:eu5ab_pf_target_month = 11
                }
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_month_days
                value = 30
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                local_var:eu5ab_pf_target_month = 2
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_month_days
                value = 28
            }
        }
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_c_deadline
            key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
            value = eu5ab_pf_completion_deadline
        }
    }
}

            subtract = 1
            min = 0
        }
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_active_records
        key = local_var:eu5ab_pf_drop_building
        value = local_var:eu5ab_pf_active_count

    if = {
        limit = {
            local_var:eu5ab_pf_active_count <= 0
        }
        remove_list_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_projects
            target = local_var:eu5ab_pf_drop_building

            name = eu5ab_pf_active_records
            key = local_var:eu5ab_pf_drop_building

        name = eu5ab_pf_cohorts
        target = scope:eu5ab_pf_id

eu5ab_pf_refresh_cohort = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_building|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
        }
        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_building|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = {
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_building
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eu5ab_pf_building = {
                    location.owner = scope:eu5ab_pf_country
                    owner = scope:eu5ab_pf_country
                    NOT = {
                        exists = estate_type
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_state|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 1
                    "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_deadline|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" <= eu5ab_pl_today
                }
                eu5ab_pf_drop_cohort = yes
            }
            else = {
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_c_market
                    key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                    value = scope:eu5ab_pf_building.location.market
                }
                eu5ab_pf_read_project_recipe = yes
                set_local_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_fraction
                    value = 1
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_state|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 1
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_jobs|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" <= 0
                            scope:eu5ab_pf_building.eu5ab_pr_jobs_per_level > 0
                        }
                        add_to_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_pf_c_jobs
                            key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                            value = scope:eu5ab_pf_building.eu5ab_pr_jobs_per_level
                        }
                        set_local_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_map_write_value
                            value = {
                                value = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_baseline_levels|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                                multiply = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_jobs|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                            }
                        }
                        add_to_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_pf_c_baseline_jobs
                            key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                            value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_jobs|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" > 0
                        }
                        set_local_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_pf_fraction
                            value = {
                                value = scope:eu5ab_pf_building.building_employed_amount
                                subtract = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_baseline_jobs|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                                divide = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_jobs|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                                min = 0
                                max = 1
                                multiply = -1
                                add = 1
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else_if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_pf_building = {
                                building_employment_size_amount > 0
                                is_full_capacity = yes
                            }
                        }
                        set_local_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_pf_fraction
                            value = 0
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            local_var:eu5ab_pf_fraction <= 0
                        }
                        add_to_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_pf_c_released
                            key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                            value = 1
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_released|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 1
                        }
                        set_local_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_pf_fraction
                            value = 0
                        }
                    }
                    eu5ab_pf_add_cooldown = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_known|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 1
                        exists = scope:eu5ab_pf_building.location.market
                    }
                    eu5ab_pf_add_reservation = yes
                }
            }
        }
        else = {
            eu5ab_pf_drop_cohort = yes
        }
    }
    else = {
        eu5ab_pf_drop_cohort = yes
    }
}
eu5ab_pf_read_project_recipe = {
    eu5ab_pf_ensure_goods = yes
    eu5ab_pf_capture_project_recipe = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:eu5ab_pf_building.building_level > 0
                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_recipe_known
                    target = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                }
            }
        }
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_c_known
            key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
            value = 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_eff_known|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 0
                "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_state|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 1
                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_recipe_known
                    target = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                }
                scope:eu5ab_pf_building = {
                    eu5ab_pr_efficiency_known = yes
                }
            }
            add_to_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_c_efficiency
                key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                value = scope:eu5ab_pf_building.eu5ab_pr_efficiency
            }
            add_to_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_c_eff_known
                key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                value = 1
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_eff_known|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 1
                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_recipe_known
                    target = scope:eu5ab_pf_building
                }
            }
            add_to_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_c_known
                key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                value = 1
            }
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_goods_cursor
            value = {
                value = 0
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head
                            target = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                        } } }
                    }
                    add = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                }
            }
        }
        remove_from_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head
            key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
        }
        while = {
            count = 75
            limit = {
                local_var:eu5ab_pf_goods_cursor > 0
            }
            switch = {
                trigger = local_var:eu5ab_pf_goods_cursor
                1 = {
                    set_local_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_goods_cursor
                        value = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_goods_next_alum|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_c_output_alum
                        key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                        value = 0
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_c_input_alum
                        key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                        value = 0
                    }
                    remove_from_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_next_alum
                        key = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_credit_alum|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" > 0
                                "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_input_credit_alum|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" > 0
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                NOT = {
                                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_next_alum trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_next_alum } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_next_alum
                                        target = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                                    } } }
                                }
                            }
                            set_local_variable = {
                                name = eu5ab_map_write_value
                                value = {
                                    value = {
                                        value = 0
                                        if = {
                                            limit = {
                                                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                                    name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head
                                                    target = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                                                } } }
                                            }
                                            add = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                                        }
                                    }
                                    if = {
                                        limit = {
                                            NOT = {
                                                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head } is_key_in_variable_map = {

eu5ab_pf_add_reservation = {
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_pf_goods_cursor
        value = {
            value = 0
            if = {
                limit = {
                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head
                        target = scope:eu5ab_pf_id
                    } } }
                }
                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_goods_head|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
            }
        }
    }
    while = {
        count = 75
        limit = {
            local_var:eu5ab_pf_goods_cursor > 0
        }
        switch = {
            trigger = local_var:eu5ab_pf_goods_cursor
            1 = {
                set_local_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_pf_goods_cursor
                    value = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_goods_next_alum|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                }
                set_local_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_pending_quantity
                    value = {
                        value = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_output_alum|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                        multiply = local_var:eu5ab_pf_fraction
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_state|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = 0
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_credit_alum|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" > 0
                    }
                    set_local_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_pf_old_loss
                        value = 1
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            exists = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_predecessor|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                        }
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_predecessor|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = {
                            save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_old_building
                        }
                        set_local_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_pf_old_loss
                            value = {
                                value = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_old_levels|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                                subtract = scope:eu5ab_pf_old_building.building_level
                                min = 0
                                max = 1
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    change_local_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_pending_quantity
                        add = {
                            value = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_credit_alum|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                            multiply = local_var:eu5ab_pf_old_loss
                        }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        local_var:eu5ab_pending_quantity > 0
                    }
                    "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_market|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)" = {
                        save_scope_as = eu5ab_pending_market
                    }
                    scope:eu5ab_pending_country = {
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_build_pending_alum trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_build_pending_alum } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_build_pending_alum
                                    target = scope:eu5ab_pending_market
                                } } }
                            }
                            change_local_variable = {
                                name = eu5ab_pending_quantity
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_build_pending_alum|scope:eu5ab_pending_market)"
                            }
                        }
                        add_to_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_build_pending_alum
                            key = scope:eu5ab_pending_market
                            value = local_var:eu5ab_pending_quantity
                        }
                    }
                }

                    value = {
                        value = "variable_map(eu5ab_pf_c_input_alum|scope:eu5ab_pf_id)"
                        multiply = local_var:eu5ab_pf_fraction

                                    name = eu5ab_build_future_input_wool
                                    target = scope:eu5ab_pending_market
                                } } }
                            }
                            change_local_variable = {
                                name = eu5ab_pending_quantity
                                add = "variable_map(eu5ab_build_future_input_wool|scope:eu5ab_pending_market)"
                            }
                        }
                        add_to_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_build_future_input_wool
                            key = scope:eu5ab_pending_market
                            value = local_var:eu5ab_pending_quantity
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

owner = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_quote_reference_calls } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_reference_calls add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_reference_calls value = 1 } } }
}
    remove_variable = eu5ab_pf_reference_building
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_search_type
    remove_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_search_reference
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_reference_destination
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = owner

eu5ab_find_local_production_reference = {
    every_buildings_in_location = {
        limit = {
            building_type = {
                this = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            }
            owner ?= scope:eu5ab_pf_reference_country
            NOT = {
                exists = estate_type
            }
            building_level > 0
            eu5ab_pr_recipe_known = yes
            eu5ab_pr_efficiency_known = yes
            scope:eu5ab_pf_reference_destination = {
                NOT = {
                    exists = var:eu5ab_pf_reference_building
                }
            }
        }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_pf_reference_donor
        scope:eu5ab_pf_reference_destination = {
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_pf_reference_building
                value = scope:eu5ab_pf_reference_donor
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_quote_production_active
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_quote_production_search_reference
                    value = scope:eu5ab_pf_reference_donor
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_retry_waiting_candidate_data = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value > 0
            NOT = {
                has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire
            }
            eu5ab_q_outstanding_approvals_value <= 0
            OR = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_q_data_day
                }
                NOT = {
                    var:eu5ab_q_data_day = eu5ab_pl_today
                }
            }
        }
        eu5ab_ensure_build_pending = yes
        eu5ab_restart_engine_priority_phase = yes
    }
}
eu5ab_prepare_rgo_dependencies = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                eu5ab_rgo_food_emergency_enabled = yes
            }
            NOT = {
                eu5ab_rgo_pending_data_available = yes
            }
            NOT = {
                has_variable = eu5ab_q_waiting_rgo
            }
        }
        set_variable = eu5ab_q_waiting_rgo
        eu5ab_report_rgo_waiting = yes
        owner = {
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_q_waiting_data
                value = {
                    value = eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value
                    add = 1
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_prepare_candidate_dependencies = {
    eu5ab_refresh_native_recipes = yes
    eu5ab_prepare_production_reference = yes
    owner = {
        eu5ab_ensure_build_pending = yes
    }
    remove_variable = eu5ab_q_dependency_wait
    if = {
        limit = {
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
                NOT = {
                    eu5ab_candidate_pending_data_ready = yes
                }
            }
        }
        set_variable = eu5ab_q_dependency_wait
        eu5ab_report_candidate_waiting = yes
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    is_target_in_variable_list = {
                        name = eu5ab_q_waiting_types
                        target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                    }
                }
            }
            add_to_variable_list = {
                name = eu5ab_q_waiting_types
                target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            }
            owner = {
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_q_waiting_data
                    value = {
                        value = eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            is_target_in_variable_list = {
                name = eu5ab_q_waiting_types
                target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            }
        }
        remove_list_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_q_waiting_types
            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
        }
        owner = {
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_q_waiting_data
                value = {
                    value = eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value
                    subtract = 1
                    min = 0
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_ensure_build_pending = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_build_pending_ready
                }
                has_variable = eu5ab_build_pending_dirty
                NOT = {
                    var:eu5ab_pf_aggregate_day = eu5ab_pl_today
                }
            }
        }
        eu5ab_refresh_build_pending = yes
    }
}

                            }
                            add = "variable_map(eu5ab_build_pending_wine|scope:eu5ab_pending_market)"
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_local_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_pending_total
                    value = {
                        value = local_var:eu5ab_pending_total
                        subtract = local_var:eu5ab_pending_delta
                        min = 0
                    }
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_build_pending_wine
                    key = scope:eu5ab_pending_market
                    value = local_var:eu5ab_pending_total
                }
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pending_approval_output trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_pending_approval_output } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_pending_approval_output
                    target = goods:wool
                } } }
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_pending_delta
                value = "variable_map(eu5ab_pending_approval_output|goods:wool)"
            }
            var:eu5ab_pending_approval_country = {
                set_local_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_pending_total
                    value = {
                        value = 0
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_build_pending_wool trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_build_pending_wool } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_build_pending_wool
                                    target = scope:eu5ab_pending_market
                                } } }
                            }
                            add = "variable_map(eu5ab_build_pending_wool|scope:eu5ab_pending_market)"
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_local_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_pending_total
                    value = {
                        value = local_var:eu5ab_pending_total
                        subtract = local_var:eu5ab_pending_delta
                        min = 0
                    }
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_build_pending_wool
                    key = scope:eu5ab_pending_market
                    value = local_var:eu5ab_pending_total
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_pf_confirm_start = {
    if = {
        limit = {

                eu5ab_candidate_has_direct_output = yes
            }
        }
        eu5ab_pf_register_start = yes

        }
    }
}

eu5ab_update_budget_remaining = {
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_remaining value = {
        value = eu5ab_global_budget_limit_value subtract = eu5ab_global_budget_spent_value min = 0
    } }
}
eu5ab_record_budget_settings = {
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_budget_config_mode value = eu5ab_budget_setting_mode_value }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_budget_config_fixed value = eu5ab_budget_setting_fixed_value }
}
eu5ab_ensure_annual_budget = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_budget_year } }
        # Initialize expenditure from the current pool before recalculating it.
        # An initialized missing balance
        # is a spent-out zero, not permission to fund the country again.
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_global_budget_limit } has_variable = eu5ab_global_budget_remaining }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_limit value = var:eu5ab_global_budget_remaining }
        }
        if = { limit = { OR = { has_variable = eu5ab_budget_initialized has_variable = eu5ab_global_budget_limit has_variable = eu5ab_global_budget_remaining } }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_spent value = {
                value = eu5ab_global_budget_limit_value subtract = eu5ab_global_budget_remaining_value min = 0
            } }
        }
        else = {
            eu5ab_recalculate_budget_limit = yes
            remove_variable = eu5ab_global_budget_spent
        }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_budget_year value = current_year }
        set_variable = eu5ab_budget_initialized
        eu5ab_record_budget_settings = yes
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_budget_year < current_year }
        eu5ab_recalculate_budget_limit = yes
        remove_variable = eu5ab_global_budget_spent
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_budget_year value = current_year }
        eu5ab_record_budget_settings = yes
    }
    eu5ab_update_budget_remaining = yes
}
eu5ab_refresh_global_budget = {
    eu5ab_ensure_annual_budget = yes
    if = { limit = { OR = {
        NOT = { eu5ab_budget_config_mode_value = eu5ab_budget_setting_mode_value }
        AND = { eu5ab_budget_setting_mode_value = 1 NOT = { eu5ab_budget_config_fixed_value = eu5ab_budget_setting_fixed_value } }
    } }
        eu5ab_recalculate_budget_limit = yes
        eu5ab_record_budget_settings = yes
    }
    eu5ab_update_budget_remaining = yes
}
eu5ab_charge_annual_budget = {
    eu5ab_ensure_annual_budget = yes
    if = { limit = { local_var:eu5ab_budget_charge >= 0 }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_global_budget_spent value = {
            value = eu5ab_global_budget_spent_value add = local_var:eu5ab_budget_charge
        } }
        eu5ab_update_budget_remaining = yes
    }
    remove_local_variable = eu5ab_budget_charge
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { exists = market owner = { NOT = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_scan_market_price_beer_ready trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_scan_market_price_beer_ready } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_scan_market_price_beer_ready target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market } } } } } } }
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = {
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_scan_market_price_beer key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market value = "scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market.market_price(goods:beer)" }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_scan_market_price_beer_ready key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_prepare_market_upstream_shortage_cloth = {

		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { exists = market owner = { NOT = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_scan_market_price_stone_ready trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_scan_market_price_stone_ready } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_scan_market_price_stone_ready target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market } } } } } } }
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = {
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_scan_market_price_stone key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market value = "scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market.market_price(goods:stone)" }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_scan_market_price_stone_ready key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_prepare_market_upstream_shortage_stone = {
	eu5ab_prepare_market_price_stone = yes
	if = {
		limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { exists = market owner = { NOT = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_scan_market_upstream_shortage_stone trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_scan_market_upstream_shortage_stone } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_scan_market_upstream_shortage_stone target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market } } } } } } }
		scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = { add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_scan_market_upstream_shortage_stone key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { eu5ab_market_upstream_shortage_stone_live = yes } scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner = { add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_scan_market_upstream_shortage_stone key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.market value = 2 } } }
	}
}

eu5ab_refresh_planning_queue = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_rank_country
    switch = { trigger = var:eu5ab_q_phase
        1 = {
            every_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_locations
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_phase_1_order
                remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_phase_1_order_ready
                clear_variable_map = eu5ab_candidate_sort_scores
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
                    eu5ab_prepare_candidate_score_snapshot = yes
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_candidate_sort_scores key = prev value = prev.eu5ab_current_candidate_score }
                        if = { limit = {
                            NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_failed_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
                                eu5ab_candidate_route_allowed = yes
                                eu5ab_output_not_oversupplied = yes
                                eu5ab_candidate_pending_preliminary_allowed = yes
                                eu5ab_inputs_available = yes
                                eu5ab_has_local_workforce = yes
                            }
                        }

                            if = {
                                limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_capacity_phase_1_order_ready } eu5ab_capacity_phase_1_order_value < scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_sort_score } }
                                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_capacity_phase_1_order value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_sort_score }
                                set_variable = eu5ab_capacity_phase_1_order_ready
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_clear_recipe_score_snapshot = yes }
                }
                clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_rank_types
                ordered_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types
                    order_by = eu5ab_candidate_sort_score
                    max = 100
                    check_range_bounds = no
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_rank_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
                }
                clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types
                every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_rank_types save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
                }
                clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_rank_types
                clear_variable_map = eu5ab_candidate_sort_scores
            }
            clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_rank_locations
            ordered_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_locations order_by = eu5ab_capacity_phase_1_order_value max = 600 check_range_bounds = no
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_rank_location
                scope:eu5ab_q_rank_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_rank_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_rank_location } }
            }
            clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_phase_1_locations
            every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_rank_locations save_scope_as = eu5ab_q_rank_location
                scope:eu5ab_q_rank_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_phase_1_locations target = scope:eu5ab_q_rank_location } }
            }
            clear_variable_list = eu5ab_q_rank_locations
        }
        2 = {
            every_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_2_locations
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_phase_2_order
                remove_variable = eu5ab_capacity_phase_2_order_ready

eu5ab_capture_upgrade_source = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_upgrade_source
    location = {
        remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_sampled_sources target = scope:eu5ab_upgrade_source }
        remove_from_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_reserved_levels key = scope:eu5ab_upgrade_source }
        remove_from_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels key = scope:eu5ab_upgrade_source }
        remove_from_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil key = scope:eu5ab_upgrade_source }
    }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_upgrade_reserved
        scope:eu5ab_engine_upgrade_reserved >= 0
        scope:eu5ab_engine_upgrade_reserved <= building_level }
        location = {
            add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_sampled_sources target = scope:eu5ab_upgrade_source }
            add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_reserved_levels key = scope:eu5ab_upgrade_source value = scope:eu5ab_engine_upgrade_reserved }
            add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_source_levels key = scope:eu5ab_upgrade_source value = scope:eu5ab_upgrade_source.building_level }
            add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_source_civil key = scope:eu5ab_upgrade_source value = num_civil_constructions }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_upgrade_snapshot_owner value = owner }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_clear_industry_snapshot = {
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_industry_types
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_industry_seen
        remove_variable = eu5ab_industry_sampled
        remove_variable = eu5ab_industry_expected
        remove_variable = eu5ab_industry_owner
        remove_variable = eu5ab_industry_ticket
        remove_variable = eu5ab_industry_ready
    }
    eu5ab_begin_industry_snapshot = {
        eu5ab_clear_industry_snapshot = yes
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_industry_owner value = owner }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_industry_ticket value = var:eu5ab_capacity_request }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_industry_expected value = scope:eu5ab_industry_count }
    }
    eu5ab_capture_industry_promotion = {
        if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_industry_seen target = scope:eu5ab_industry_promotion } } }
            add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_industry_seen target = scope:eu5ab_industry_promotion }
            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_industry_sampled value = { value = eu5ab_industry_sampled_count add = 1 } }
            if = { limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_industry_country area = scope:eu5ab_industry_area
                NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_industry_types target = scope:eu5ab_industry_type } } }
                add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_industry_types target = scope:eu5ab_industry_type }
            }
        }
    }
    eu5ab_finish_industry_snapshot = {
        remove_variable = eu5ab_industry_ready
        if = { limit = { exists = var:eu5ab_industry_owner owner = var:eu5ab_industry_owner
            has_variable = eu5ab_industry_ticket var:eu5ab_industry_ticket = var:eu5ab_capacity_request
            exists = scope:eu5ab_industry_count
            eu5ab_industry_expected_count = scope:eu5ab_industry_count
            eu5ab_industry_sampled_count = scope:eu5ab_industry_count }
            set_variable = eu5ab_industry_ready
        }
        # Incomplete sampling removes only the preference; never stalls a worker.
        else = { clear_variable_list = eu5ab_industry_types }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_industry_seen
    }

eu5ab_batch_compute_profit_base = {
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_priority
        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_configured_priority
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude
        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value < 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude
            value = {
                value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value
                multiply = -1
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value < 1
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude
            value = 1
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
        value = {
            value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_magnitude_value
            multiply = eu5ab_profit_candidate_priority_value
            multiply = 0.01
            add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_engine_adjusted_profit
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value >= 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
            value = {
                value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value
                multiply = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_labor_factor
            }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
            value = {
                value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value
                divide = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_current_labor_factor
            }
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
        value = eu5ab_price_profit_rank
    }
    remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_priority
    remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_magnitude

eu5ab_batch_screen_quote = {
if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
if = { limit = { exists = market NOT = {
        exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_can_build scope:eu5ab_engine_can_build = yes
        scope:eu5ab_engine_cost > 0 eu5ab_cached_quote_capacity_factor > 0 } }
        owner = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_screen_early_rejected } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_screen_early_rejected add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_screen_early_rejected value = 1 } } }
    }
}
if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
owner = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_screened } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_screened add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_screened value = 1 } } if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_window_screened } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_screened add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_screened value = 1 } } }
}
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
    eu5ab_clear_quote_production_snapshot = yes
    eu5ab_clear_recipe_score_snapshot = yes
    remove_variable = eu5ab_pf_reference_building
    owner = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_score_index_ready
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    AND = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_batch_ledger_month
                        has_variable = eu5ab_batch_ledger_year
                        var:eu5ab_batch_ledger_month = var:eu5ab_scan_month
                        var:eu5ab_batch_ledger_year = var:eu5ab_scan_year
                    }
                }
            }
            eu5ab_batch_reset_ledgers = yes
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_ledger_month
                value = var:eu5ab_scan_month
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_ledger_year
                value = var:eu5ab_scan_year
            }
        }
    }
    remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_quote_restored
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_failure_month
                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_failure_year
                    exists = var:eu5ab_batch_failure_country
                    owner = var:eu5ab_batch_failure_country
                    var:eu5ab_batch_failure_month = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
                    var:eu5ab_batch_failure_year = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
                }
            }
        }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_failed_types
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_failure_country
            value = owner
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_failure_month
            value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_failure_year
            value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            exists = market
        }
        market = {
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_market

eu5ab_batch_compute_quote_score = {
if = { limit = { owner = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
owner = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_screen_score_calls } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_screen_score_calls add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_screen_score_calls value = 1 } } }
}
    if = {
        limit = {
            owner.var:eu5ab_batch_ranking_mode = 2
        }
        eu5ab_batch_compute_profit_base = yes
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_quote_rank_base
            key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
            value = eu5ab_pending_profit_rank
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
            value = eu5ab_cached_capacity_profit_rank
        }
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_quote_score
            key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value
        }
        remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
    }
    else = {
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_quote_rank_base
            key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_price_adjusted_candidate_score
        }
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_quote_score
            key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_score
        }
    }
}
