eu5ab_batch_index_score_candidate = {
    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_market|scope:eu5ab_batch_index_id)" = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_index_market
    }
    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_type|scope:eu5ab_batch_index_id)" = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_index_type
    }
    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_location|scope:eu5ab_batch_index_id)" = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_net_output_alum trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_quote_net_output_alum } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_quote_net_output_alum
                    target = scope:eu5ab_batch_index_type
                } } }
                "variable_map(eu5ab_quote_net_output_alum|scope:eu5ab_batch_index_type)" > 0
            }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                set_local_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_map_write_value
                    value = {
                        value = -1
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_head_alum trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_head_alum } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_score_head_alum
                                    target = scope:eu5ab_batch_index_market
                                } } }
                            }
                            value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_score_head_alum|scope:eu5ab_batch_index_market)"
                        }
                    }
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_score_next_alum
                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_index_id
                    value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_score_head_alum
                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_index_market
                    value = scope:eu5ab_batch_index_id
                }
            }
        }

eu5ab_batch_ensure_score_index = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_variable = eu5ab_batch_score_index_ready
            }
        }
        eu5ab_batch_clear_score_index = yes
        every_in_list = {
            variable = eu5ab_batch_pool
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_index_id
                value = this
            }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                eu5ab_batch_index_score_candidate = yes
            }
        }
        set_variable = eu5ab_batch_score_index_ready
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_collect_score_changes = {
    eu5ab_batch_ensure_score_index = yes
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_seen
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_score_dirty
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_net_output_alum > 0
                scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_net_input_alum > 0
            }
            AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_head_alum trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_head_alum } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_score_head_alum
                target = scope:eu5ab_batch_market
            } } }
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_score_cursor
            value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_score_head_alum|scope:eu5ab_batch_market)"
        }
        while = {
            count = 100000
            limit = {
                local_var:eu5ab_batch_score_cursor > 0
            }
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                value = local_var:eu5ab_batch_score_cursor
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_score_cursor
                value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_score_next_alum|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)"
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = 1
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = 8
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_seen trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_seen } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_score_seen
                            target = scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                        } } }
                    }
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_score_seen
                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                    value = 1
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_score_dirty

                value = local_var:eu5ab_batch_score_cursor
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_score_cursor
                value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_score_next_wine|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)"
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = 1
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = 8
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_seen trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_seen } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_score_seen
                            target = scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                        } } }
                    }
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_score_seen
                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                    value = 1
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_score_dirty
                    target = scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_net_output_wool > 0
                scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_net_input_wool > 0
            }
            AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_head_wool trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_head_wool } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_score_head_wool
                target = scope:eu5ab_batch_market
            } } }
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_score_cursor
            value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_score_head_wool|scope:eu5ab_batch_market)"
        }
        while = {
            count = 100000
            limit = {
                local_var:eu5ab_batch_score_cursor > 0
            }
            save_scope_value_as = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                value = local_var:eu5ab_batch_score_cursor
            }
            set_local_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_score_cursor
                value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_score_next_wool|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)"
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = 1
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = 8
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_seen trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_seen } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_score_seen
                            target = scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                        } } }
                    }
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_score_seen
                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                    value = 1
                }
                add_to_variable_list = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_score_dirty
                    target = scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                }
            }
        }
    }
    remove_local_variable = eu5ab_batch_score_cursor
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_score_seen
}

eu5ab_batch_initialize_backfill = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    exists = var:eu5ab_batch_backfill_country
                    var:eu5ab_batch_backfill_country = owner
                }
            }
        }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_backfill_upgrade_candidates
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_backfill_expansion_candidates
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_backfill_new_candidates
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_primary_types
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_backfill_tried
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_backfill_reported_failures
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_country
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_phase
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_remaining
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_started
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_triggered
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_exhausted
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_added
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_country
            value = owner
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_remaining
            value = 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                owner = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_scan_backfill_enabled
                }
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_remaining
                value = 2
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    owner.var:eu5ab_batch_ranking_mode = 2
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_remaining
                    value = 5
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_record_backfill_failure = {
    eu5ab_batch_select_context = yes
    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_tried
                    target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                }
                NOT = {
                    is_target_in_variable_list = {
                        name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_reported_failures
                        target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                    }
                }
            }
            add_to_variable_list = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_reported_failures
                target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_stage_failed
                    }
                    change_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_stage_failed
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_stage_failed
                        value = 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_try_backfill = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = eu5ab_scan_backfill_enabled
        }
        switch = {
            trigger = var:eu5ab_q_phase
            1 = {
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_q_phase_1_locations
                    limit = {
                        owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    eu5ab_batch_promote_backfill = yes
                }
            }
            2 = {
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_q_phase_2_locations
                    limit = {
                        owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    eu5ab_batch_promote_backfill = yes
                }
            }
            3 = {
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_q_phase_3_locations
                    limit = {
                        owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    eu5ab_batch_promote_backfill = yes
                }
            }
            4 = {
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_q_phase_4_locations
                    limit = {
                        owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    eu5ab_batch_promote_backfill = yes
                }
            }
            5 = {
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_q_phase_5_locations
                    limit = {
                        owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    eu5ab_batch_promote_backfill = yes
                }
            }
            6 = {
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_q_phase_6_locations
                    limit = {
                        owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    eu5ab_batch_promote_backfill = yes
                }
            }
            7 = {
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_q_phase_7_locations
                    limit = {
                        owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    eu5ab_batch_promote_backfill = yes
                }
            }
            8 = {
                every_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_q_phase_8_locations
                    limit = {
                        owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    eu5ab_batch_promote_backfill = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_promote_backfill = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
            var:eu5ab_batch_backfill_country = owner
            has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_phase
            var:eu5ab_batch_backfill_phase = scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_q_phase
            NOT = {
                has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_started
            }
        }
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_added
        if = {
            limit = {
                var:eu5ab_batch_backfill_remaining > 0
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_added
                    }
                }
                ordered_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_backfill_upgrade_candidates
                    order_by = eu5ab_batch_quote_order
                    max = 1
                    check_range_bounds = no
                    limit = {
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                            NOT = {
                                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_failed_types
                                    target = prev
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_consumed_types
                                    target = prev
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_tried
                                    target = prev
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        remove_list_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_backfill_upgrade_candidates
                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_tried
                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_primary_types
                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_remaining
                            subtract = 1
                        }
                        set_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_added
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                NOT = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_triggered
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_triggered
                            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                                if = {
                                    limit = {
                                        has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_triggered
                                    }
                                    change_variable = {
                                        name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_triggered
                                        add = 1
                                    }
                                }
                                else = {
                                    set_variable = {
                                        name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_triggered
                                        value = 1
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_location
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
                            save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_type
                        }
                        eu5ab_batch_refresh_quote_pending = yes
                        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_checked
                                }
                                change_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_checked
                                    add = 1
                                }
                            }
                            else = {
                                set_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_checked
                                    value = 1
                                }
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_staged
                                }
                                change_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_staged
                                    add = 1
                                }
                            }
                            else = {
                                set_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_staged
                                    value = 1
                                }
                            }
                            eu5ab_batch_add_candidate = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_added
                    }
                }
                ordered_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_backfill_expansion_candidates
                    order_by = eu5ab_batch_quote_order
                    max = 1
                    check_range_bounds = no
                    limit = {
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                            NOT = {
                                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_failed_types
                                    target = prev
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_consumed_types
                                    target = prev
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_tried
                                    target = prev
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        remove_list_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_backfill_expansion_candidates
                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_tried
                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_primary_types
                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_remaining
                            subtract = 1
                        }
                        set_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_added
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                NOT = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_triggered
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_triggered
                            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                                if = {
                                    limit = {
                                        has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_triggered
                                    }
                                    change_variable = {
                                        name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_triggered
                                        add = 1
                                    }
                                }
                                else = {
                                    set_variable = {
                                        name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_triggered
                                        value = 1
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_location
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
                            save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_type
                        }
                        eu5ab_batch_refresh_quote_pending = yes
                        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_checked
                                }
                                change_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_checked
                                    add = 1
                                }
                            }
                            else = {
                                set_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_checked
                                    value = 1
                                }
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_staged
                                }
                                change_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_staged
                                    add = 1
                                }
                            }
                            else = {
                                set_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_staged
                                    value = 1
                                }
                            }
                            eu5ab_batch_add_candidate = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    NOT = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_added
                    }
                }
                ordered_in_list = {
                    variable = eu5ab_backfill_new_candidates
                    order_by = eu5ab_batch_quote_order
                    max = 1
                    check_range_bounds = no
                    limit = {
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                            NOT = {
                                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_failed_types
                                    target = prev
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_consumed_types
                                    target = prev
                                }
                            }
                            NOT = {
                                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_tried
                                    target = prev
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        remove_list_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_backfill_new_candidates
                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_tried
                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        }
                        add_to_variable_list = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_primary_types
                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        }
                        change_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_backfill_remaining
                            subtract = 1
                        }
                        set_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_added
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                NOT = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_triggered
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_triggered
                            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                                if = {
                                    limit = {
                                        has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_triggered
                                    }
                                    change_variable = {
                                        name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_triggered
                                        add = 1
                                    }
                                }
                                else = {
                                    set_variable = {
                                        name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_triggered
                                        value = 1
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_location
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
                            save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_type
                        }
                        eu5ab_batch_refresh_quote_pending = yes
                        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_checked
                                }
                                change_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_checked
                                    add = 1
                                }
                            }
                            else = {
                                set_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_checked
                                    value = 1
                                }
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_staged
                                }
                                change_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_staged
                                    add = 1
                                }
                            }
                            else = {
                                set_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_staged
                                    value = 1
                                }
                            }
                            eu5ab_batch_add_candidate = yes
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = {
                has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_triggered
                NOT = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_exhausted
                }
            }
            set_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_exhausted
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_diag_backfill_budget_exhausted
                    }
                    change_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_budget_exhausted
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_backfill_budget_exhausted
                        value = 1
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_added
    }
}

        name = eu5ab_recipe_snapshot_price_adjusted_candidate_score

        name = eu5ab_pending_approval_market

    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_pending_approval_country
        value = owner
    }
    set_variable = eu5ab_batch_quote_restored
}

eu5ab_batch_add_candidate = {
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_sequence
        value = {
            value = 0
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_sequence
                }
                add = var:eu5ab_batch_sequence
            }
            add = 1
        }
    }
    save_scope_value_as = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_id
        value = var:eu5ab_batch_sequence
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_location
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_type
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_market
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = "scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.variable_map(eu5ab_quote_market|scope:eu5ab_candidate_building)"
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_province
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = "scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.variable_map(eu5ab_quote_province|scope:eu5ab_candidate_building)"
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_phase
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = var:eu5ab_q_phase
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_month
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = var:eu5ab_scan_month
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_year
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = var:eu5ab_scan_year
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_score
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_score
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_cost
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_cached_quote_cost
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_status
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = 1
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_q_processed
        value = {
            value = 0
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_q_processed
                }
                add = var:eu5ab_q_processed
            }
            add = 1
        }
    }
    add_to_variable_list = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_pool
        target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
    }
    add_to_variable_list = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_records
        target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = eu5ab_batch_score_index_ready
        }
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_index_id
            value = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        }
        eu5ab_batch_index_score_candidate = yes
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_publish_diagnostics = {
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_diag_index
        value = 0
    }
    ordered_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_pool
        order_by = eu5ab_batch_order
        max = 3
        check_range_bounds = no
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_id
            value = this
        }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            eu5ab_batch_select_context = yes
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_diag_index
                value = {
                    value = 0
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            has_variable = eu5ab_batch_diag_index
                        }
                        add = var:eu5ab_batch_diag_index
                    }
                    add = 1
                }
            }
            switch = {
                trigger = var:eu5ab_batch_diag_index
                1 = {
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_kind
                        value = 1
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_location
                        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_building
                        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_priority
                        value = var:eu5ab_q_phase
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_score
                        value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_need
                        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_need
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_economic
                        value = {
                            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_adjusted_profit
                            divide = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_cached_quote_cost
                            multiply = 10
                        }
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_1_reason
                        value = 10
                    }
                    remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_labor_jobs
                    remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_labor_current
                    remove_variable = eu5ab_diag_top_1_labor_projected
                }
                2 = {
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_kind
                        value = 1
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_location
                        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_building
                        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_priority
                        value = var:eu5ab_q_phase
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_score
                        value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_need
                        value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_need
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_top_2_economic
                        value = {
                            value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_adjusted_profit
                            divide = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_cached_quote_cost
                            multiply = 10

                    name = eu5ab_diag_last_actual_income
                    value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_cached_quote_income
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_diag_last_actual_profit
                    value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_adjusted_profit
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_kind
                    value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_kind
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects
                    value = {
                        value = 0
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects
                            }
                            add = var:eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects
                        }
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_emergency > 0
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_diag_emergency_overrides_used
                        value = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_diag_emergency_overrides_used
                                }
                                add = var:eu5ab_diag_emergency_overrides_used
                            }
                            add = 1
                        }
                    }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                name = eu5ab_active_project_locations
                                target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_list = {
                        name = eu5ab_active_project_locations
                        target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location
                    }
                }
                scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                    eu5ab_report_candidate_confirmed = yes
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes }
                        has_variable = eu5ab_q_active
                        eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load
                        }
                        has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = eu5ab_batch_closing
                        }
                        eu5ab_global_budget_remaining_value > 0
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_kind = 4
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_slots_value > 0
                        var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota
                    }
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_location
                    }
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
                        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_type
                    }
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        eu5ab_batch_refresh_quote_pending = yes
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_pending_open > 0
                        }
                        eu5ab_batch_add_candidate = yes
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_approved
}

eu5ab_batch_update_market_scores = {
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_map_write_value
        value = {
            value = eu5ab_batch_market_generation_value
            add = 1
        }
    }
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_market_generation
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_market
        value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
    }
    eu5ab_batch_collect_score_changes = yes
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_score_dirty
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
            value = this
        }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    OR = {
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = 1
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = 8
                    }
                    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_market|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = scope:eu5ab_batch_market
                }
                "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_location|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                        }
                        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_location
                        "scope:eu5ab_engine_country.variable_map(eu5ab_batch_type|scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id)" = {
                            save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_type
                        }
                        eu5ab_batch_refresh_quote_pending = yes
                        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                            add_to_variable_map = {
                                name = eu5ab_batch_score
                                key = scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_id
                                value = scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_score
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_score_dirty
}

eu5ab_dispatch_construction_batch = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_running } } save_scope_as = actor save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country set_variable = eu5ab_batch_running eu5ab_batch_retire_cost_requests = yes eu5ab_clear_queue_bridge = yes remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_waiting while = { count = 100000 limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_waiting } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_sampling }
        OR = { OR = { eu5ab_global_budget_remaining_value <= 0 var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick >= var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota } AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_computing OR = {
            eu5ab_batch_planned_value >= eu5ab_global_budget_remaining_value
            eu5ab_batch_reserved_value >= var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota } } } } eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue = yes } else = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_rebuild } eu5ab_rebuild_queue_bridge = yes } if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_bridge_unread_rgos NOT = { AND = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_done_phase var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_done_phase = var:eu5ab_q_phase } } } eu5ab_batch_rgo_run = yes } else = { if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_phase } NOT = { var:eu5ab_batch_phase = var:eu5ab_q_phase } } } eu5ab_batch_prepare_phase = yes } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_waiting } } if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_sampling }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_pool }
        else = { eu5ab_batch_approve = yes eu5ab_batch_issue = yes } every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_batch_pool save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_batch_id value = this } scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { if = { limit = { "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" >= 5 } if = { limit = { NOT = { "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = 6 } } eu5ab_batch_record_backfill_failure = yes } remove_list_variable = { name = eu5ab_batch_pool target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id } } } } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_pool } } eu5ab_batch_try_backfill = yes } if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_pool } } eu5ab_advance_engine_priority_phase = yes } } } } } remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_running } }

eu5ab_batch_refresh_quote_pending = {
    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_saved_location
    }
    scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_saved_type
    }
    scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_location = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
    }
    scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_type = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
    }
    scope:eu5ab_batch_refresh_location = {
        eu5ab_batch_restore_score_context = yes
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_quote_pending_open
            key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            value = 0
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_candidate_pending_factor > 0
            }
            add_to_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_quote_pending_open
                key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                value = 1
            }
        }
        if = {
            limit = {
                owner.var:eu5ab_batch_ranking_mode = 2
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
                value = eu5ab_batch_quote_rank_base
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
                value = eu5ab_pending_profit_rank
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
                value = eu5ab_cached_capacity_profit_rank
            }
            add_to_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_quote_score
                key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                value = eu5ab_profit_candidate_rank_value
            }
            remove_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_candidate_rank
        }
        else = {
            add_to_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_quote_score
                key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_current_candidate_score
            }
        }
        add_to_variable_map = {
            name = eu5ab_quote_ledger_generation
            key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
            value = scope:eu5ab_engine_country.eu5ab_batch_market_generation_value
        }
        eu5ab_clear_recipe_score_snapshot = yes
        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_quote_restored
    }
    scope:eu5ab_batch_saved_location = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
    }
    scope:eu5ab_batch_saved_type = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
    }
}

eu5ab_dispatch_legacy_queue_bridge = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_schema has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request } }
        save_scope_as = actor save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
        eu5ab_ensure_build_pending = yes
        remove_variable = eu5ab_winner_waiting
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire } eu5ab_q_waiting_data_value > 0 } eu5ab_retry_waiting_candidate_data = yes }
        while = { count = 18 limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_quote_waiting } NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_winner_waiting } }
            if = { limit = { OR = {
                any_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_bridge_unread_locations NOT = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country } }
                any_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_bridge_unread_rgos NOT = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country } }
            } } set_variable = eu5ab_bridge_rebuild }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_rebuild }
                if = { limit = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_candidate_ranking_mode = 1
                    NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_rank_refreshed } var:eu5ab_q_processed = 0 var:eu5ab_q_approved = 0 }
                    eu5ab_refresh_planning_queue = yes set_variable = eu5ab_q_rank_refreshed }
                eu5ab_rebuild_queue_bridge = yes
            }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire }
                ordered_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_approved_locations order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                    limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country any_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_approved_types
                        NOT = { prev = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = prev } } } } }
                    save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    ordered_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_q_approved_types order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                        limit = { NOT = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_q_confirmed_types target = prev } } } }
                        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
                        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_location value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
                            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_type value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
                            set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_kind value = 4 } eu5ab_publish_queue_bridge = yes }
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_fire_issued } owner = { eu5ab_publish_bridge_confirmation = yes } } }
                    }
                }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request } } eu5ab_check_engine_confirmation_completion = yes }
            }
            else = {
                ordered_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_bridge_unread_rgos order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                    limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country } save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_location value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
                        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_kind value = 3 } eu5ab_publish_queue_bridge = yes } }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request } }
                    if = { limit = { eu5ab_manual_value_global_candidate_ranking_mode = 2 NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } }
                        eu5ab_rank_cached_queue = yes
                    }
                    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting }
                        eu5ab_publish_winner_batch = yes eu5ab_process_winner_batch = yes
                    }
                    else = {
                    ordered_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_bridge_unread_locations order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                        limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country } save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                        ordered_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_bridge_unread_types order_by = 1 max = 1 check_range_bounds = no
                            save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_building
                            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_location value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location }
                                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_type value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building }
                                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_kind value = 1 }
                                if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_profit_selecting } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_bridge_kind value = 2 } }
                                eu5ab_publish_queue_bridge = yes }
                        }
                    }
                    }
                }
                if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_bridge_request } } eu5ab_check_engine_phase_completion = yes }
            }
        }
    }
}
eu5ab_batch_slots_ensure = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_slots_ready
                    exists = var:eu5ab_batch_slots_owner
                    owner = var:eu5ab_batch_slots_owner
                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_slots_month
                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_slots_year
                    var:eu5ab_batch_slots_month = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
                    var:eu5ab_batch_slots_year = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
                }
            }
        }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_slot_holds
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slots_held
            value = 0
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slots_owner
            value = owner
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slots_month
            value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slots_year
            value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
        }
        eu5ab_batch_slots_reconcile = yes
        set_variable = eu5ab_batch_slots_ready
    }
}

# Only serial approval/recovery owns the country's touched-location index.
eu5ab_batch_slots_track = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_slot_location
    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                NOT = {
                    is_target_in_variable_list = {
                        name = eu5ab_batch_slot_locations
                        target = scope:eu5ab_slot_location
                    }
                }
            }
            add_to_variable_list = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_slot_locations
                target = scope:eu5ab_slot_location
            }
        }
    }
}

# Recovery runs after unissued approvals have been withdrawn. It also accounts
# for native/manual queue changes since the saved monthly snapshot.
eu5ab_batch_slots_reconcile = {
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_slots_occupied
        value = num_civil_constructions
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_slots
        value = {
            value = modifier:max_constructions_at_same_time
            floor = yes
            subtract = eu5ab_batch_slots_occupied_value
            subtract = eu5ab_batch_slots_held_value
            min = 0
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_slots_reserve = {
    eu5ab_batch_slots_ensure = yes
    eu5ab_batch_slots_track = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                is_target_in_variable_list = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_slot_holds
                    target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                }
            }
        }
        add_to_variable_list = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slot_holds
            target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slots_held
            value = {
                value = eu5ab_batch_slots_held_value
                add = 1
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slots
            value = {
                value = eu5ab_batch_slots_value
                subtract = 1
                min = 0
            }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_slots_commit = {
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:eu5ab_batch_slots_owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
            is_target_in_variable_list = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_slot_holds
                target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
            }
        }
        remove_list_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slot_holds
            target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slots_held
            value = {
                value = eu5ab_batch_slots_held_value
                subtract = 1
                min = 0
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slots_occupied
            value = {
                value = 0
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_batch_slots_occupied
                    }
                    add = var:eu5ab_batch_slots_occupied
                }
                add = 1
            }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_slots_release = {
    eu5ab_batch_slots_track = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            var:eu5ab_batch_slots_owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
            is_target_in_variable_list = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_slot_holds
                target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
            }
        }
        remove_list_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slot_holds
            target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slots_held
            value = {
                value = eu5ab_batch_slots_held_value
                subtract = 1
                min = 0
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_slots
            value = {
                value = eu5ab_batch_slots_value
                add = 1
            }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_slots_resume = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_slot_country
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_slot_locations
        limit = {
            owner = scope:eu5ab_slot_country
        }
        eu5ab_batch_slots_ensure = yes
        eu5ab_batch_slots_reconcile = yes
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_close = {
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_close = yes
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
    set_variable = eu5ab_batch_closing
    eu5ab_batch_confirm = yes
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_records
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_id
            value = this
        }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = 2
                }
                eu5ab_batch_select_context = yes
                eu5ab_batch_withdraw = yes
            }

                                    has_variable = eu5ab_q_processed
                                }
                                add = var:eu5ab_q_processed
                            }
                            add = 1
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_snapshot_ready
                            }
                        }
                        eu5ab_batch_rgo_add = yes
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        8 = {
            every_in_list = {
                variable = eu5ab_q_phase_8_rgo_locations
                limit = {
                    owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                    NOT = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_q_rgo_attempted
                    }
                    NOT = {
                        AND = {
                            exists = var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_attempt_owner
                            var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_attempt_owner = owner
                            has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_attempt_month
                            has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_attempt_year
                            var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_attempt_month = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
                            var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_attempt_year = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
                        }
                    }
                }
                save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        NOT = {
                            AND = {
                                exists = var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_snapshot_owner
                                var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_snapshot_owner = owner
                                has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_snapshot_month
                                has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_snapshot_year
                                var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_snapshot_month = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
                                var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_snapshot_year = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    eu5ab_batch_rgo_screen = yes
                }
                owner = {
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_q_processed
                        value = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_q_processed
                                }
                                add = var:eu5ab_q_processed
                            }
                            add = 1
                        }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_snapshot_ready
                            }
                        }
                        eu5ab_batch_rgo_add = yes
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_groups
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
            value = this
        }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            eu5ab_batch_rgo_refresh_group = yes
        }
    }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_rgo_dirty

eu5ab_batch_rgo_compute_factor = {
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_rgo_factor
        value = 0
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_group_emergency|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)" > 0
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_rgo_factor
            value = 1
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            local_var:eu5ab_rgo_unknown > 0
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_rgo_factor
            value = 0
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            local_var:eu5ab_rgo_pending = 0
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_rgo_factor
            value = 1
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            local_var:eu5ab_rgo_pending < local_var:eu5ab_rgo_limit
            local_var:eu5ab_rgo_limit > 0
        }
        set_local_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_rgo_factor
            value = {
                value = 1
                subtract = {
                    value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_pending
                    divide = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_limit
                    multiply = {
                        value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_pending
                        divide = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_limit
                    }
                }
                min = 0.00001
            }
        }
    }
}

                                        scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row < "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"

                            }

                save_scope_value_as = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_row
                    value = this
                }
                scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                    if = {
                        limit = {
                            "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_group|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)" = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
                            "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)" = 1
                        }
                        set_local_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_map_write_value
                            value = {
                                value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_base|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)"
                                multiply = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_price|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)"
                                multiply = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_factor
                                multiply = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_labor|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)"
                            }
                        }
                        add_to_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_score
                            key = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row
                            value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                local_var:eu5ab_rgo_factor > 0
                                OR = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                            name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best
                                            target = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
                                        } } }
                                    }
                                    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)" > "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                                    AND = {
                                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)" = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                                        scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row < "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            add_to_variable_map = {
                                name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best
                                key = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
                                value = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row
                            }
                            add_to_variable_map = {
                                name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score
                                key = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
                                value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)"
                            }

                            value = {
                                value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_base|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)"
                                multiply = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_price|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)"
                                multiply = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_factor
                                multiply = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_labor|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)"
                            }
                        }
                        add_to_variable_map = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_score
                            key = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row
                            value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                local_var:eu5ab_rgo_factor > 0
                                OR = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                            name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best
                                            target = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
                                        } } }
                                    }
                                    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)" > "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                                    AND = {
                                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)" = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                                        scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row < "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                                name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best
                                key = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
                                value = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row
                            }

                                key = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group

                                    }

                                value = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row

                            }

                                    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)" > "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                                    AND = {
                                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)" = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                                        scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row < "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            add_to_variable_map = {
                                name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best
                                key = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
                                value = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row
                            }
                            add_to_variable_map = {
                                name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score
                                key = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
                                value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_row)"
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    remove_list_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_active_groups
        target = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best
                target = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
            } } }
        }
        add_to_variable_list = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_active_groups
            target = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_rgo_select = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_winner
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_active_groups
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
            value = this
        }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_best
                        target = scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
                    } } }
                    OR = {
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_winner
                        }
                        "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)" > var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_winner_score
                        AND = {
                            "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)" = var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_winner_score
                            "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)" < var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_winner
                        }
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_winner
                    value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_winner_score
                    value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_best_score|scope:eu5ab_batch_rgo_group)"
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_rgo_context = {
    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_location|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_candidate_location
    }
    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_market|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = {
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_market
    }
    save_scope_value_as = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
        value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_group|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
    }
}
