eu5ab_batch_rgo_reserve = {
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = 2
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_q_approved
        value = {
            value = 0
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_q_approved
                }
                add = var:eu5ab_q_approved
            }
            add = 1
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_reserved
        value = {
            value = eu5ab_batch_reserved_value
            add = 1
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_planned
        value = {
            value = eu5ab_batch_planned_value
            add = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_cost|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
        }
    }
    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
        eu5ab_batch_slots_reserve = yes
    }
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_rgo_hold_direction
        value = 1
    }
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_hold_output = yes
    add_to_variable_list = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_approved
        target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
    }
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_remove = yes
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_refresh_group = yes
}

eu5ab_batch_rgo_release = {
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_reserved
        value = {
            value = eu5ab_batch_reserved_value
            subtract = 1
            min = 0
        }
    }
    set_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_planned
        value = {
            value = eu5ab_batch_planned_value
            subtract = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_cost|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
            min = 0
        }
    }
    set_local_variable = {
        name = eu5ab_rgo_hold_direction
        value = -1
    }
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_hold_output = yes
}

eu5ab_batch_rgo_withdraw = {
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_release = yes
    add_to_variable_map = {
        name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status
        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
        value = 7
    }
    set_variable = {

        value = {

            add = 1

        eu5ab_batch_slots_release = yes
    }
}

eu5ab_batch_rgo_approve = { clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_rgo_approved remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_boundary eu5ab_batch_rgo_select = yes while = { count = 100000 limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_winner NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_boundary } } save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_batch_id value = var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_winner } eu5ab_batch_rgo_context = yes scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { if = { limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country } eu5ab_batch_slots_ensure = yes } } if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country eu5ab_batch_slots_value > 0 } var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick < { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota subtract = eu5ab_batch_reserved_value } eu5ab_global_budget_remaining_value > eu5ab_batch_planned_value gold >= { value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_cost|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" add = eu5ab_batch_planned_value add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve } } if = { limit = { eu5ab_global_budget_remaining_value >= { value = eu5ab_batch_planned_value add = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_cost|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" } } eu5ab_batch_rgo_reserve = yes } else_if = { limit = { OR = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_computing eu5ab_batch_reserved_value = 0 } } eu5ab_batch_rgo_reserve = yes set_variable = eu5ab_batch_boundary } else = { set_variable = eu5ab_batch_boundary } } else_if = { limit = { OR = { var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick >= { value = var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota subtract = eu5ab_batch_reserved_value } eu5ab_global_budget_remaining_value <= eu5ab_batch_planned_value } } set_variable = eu5ab_batch_boundary } else = { if = { limit = { eu5ab_batch_reserved_value > 0 scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country OR = { eu5ab_batch_slots_value > 0 eu5ab_batch_slots_held_value > 0 } } gold >= { value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_cost|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve } } add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id value = 8 } add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_deferred target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id } } else = { add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id value = 7 } eu5ab_batch_rgo_remove = yes } eu5ab_batch_rgo_refresh_group = yes } eu5ab_batch_rgo_select = yes } }

            if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_computing } eu5ab_manual_remember_rgos = yes }

    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_approved
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_id
            value = this
        }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {

                    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = 4
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status
                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                    value = 6
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_q_confirmed
                    value = {
                        value = 0
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_q_confirmed
                            }
                            add = var:eu5ab_q_confirmed
                        }
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects
                    value = {
                        value = 0
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                has_variable = eu5ab_diag_active_mod_projects

                        }
                        add = 1
                    }
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run
                    value = 1
                }
                set_variable = {
                    name = eu5ab_diag_last_build_location
                    value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_location|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"

                    value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_debit|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
                }
            }
        }
    }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_rgo_approved
}

eu5ab_batch_rgo_run = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_sampling } }

    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                AND = {
                    has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_phase
                    var:eu5ab_batch_rgo_phase = var:eu5ab_q_phase
                }
            }
        }
        eu5ab_batch_rgo_prepare = yes
    }
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_approve = yes
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_issue = yes
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_select = yes
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = {
                has_variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_winner
            }
        }
        set_variable = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_done_phase
            value = var:eu5ab_q_phase
        }
    }

} else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_done_phase value = var:eu5ab_q_phase } }
}

                owner = scope:eu5ab_rgo_resume_country
                has_variable = eu5ab_q_rgo_attempted
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_attempt_owner
                value = owner
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_attempt_month
                value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_month
            }
            set_variable = {
                name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_attempt_year
                value = owner.var:eu5ab_scan_year
            }
        }
    }
}

eu5ab_clear_worker_screening = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_location_eligible
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_replaces_existing
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_replaces_capacity
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs
    clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs_ready
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_inputs
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_cooldown
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_allowed
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_price_valid
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_weight
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_weight_ready
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_low_weight
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_low_weight_ready
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_price_factor
	clear_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_price_factor_ready
	remove_variable = eu5ab_worker_screen_active
}

eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_inputs = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_screen_active NOT = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_inputs trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_inputs } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_inputs target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } } }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_inputs key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_inputs_available_worker_live = yes } } add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_inputs key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 2 } }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_cooldown = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_screen_active NOT = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_cooldown trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_cooldown } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_cooldown target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } } }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_cooldown key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_production_cooldown_clear_worker_live = yes } } add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_cooldown key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 2 } }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_pending_ready = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_screen_active NOT = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } } }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_pending_data_ready_worker_live = yes } } add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 2 } }
			else = { add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 3 } }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_pending_allowed = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_screen_active NOT = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_allowed trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_allowed } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_allowed target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } } }
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_cooldown = yes }
			if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_production_cooldown_clear = yes } } scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_pending_ready = yes } }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_allowed key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_pending_preliminary_allowed_worker_live = yes } } add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_allowed key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 2 } }
			else_if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_production_cooldown_clear = yes } AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } "variable_map(eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_ready|scope:eu5ab_candidate_building)" = 3 } add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_pending_allowed key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 3 } }
		}
	}
}

eu5ab_prepare_worker_screen_prices = {
	scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
		if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_screen_active NOT = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_price_factor_ready trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_price_factor_ready } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_price_factor_ready target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } } }
			scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_prepare_candidate_market_prices = yes }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_price_valid key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 1 }
			if = {
				limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_output_price_data_valid_worker_live = yes } }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_price_valid key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 2 }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_weight key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_output_weight_live_worker_live }
				add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_weight_ready key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_weight trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_weight } is_key_in_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_weight target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } } "variable_map(eu5ab_worker_screen_output_weight|scope:eu5ab_candidate_building)" > 0 NOT = { AND = { eu5ab_food_emergency_enabled = yes scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { eu5ab_candidate_produces_food = yes } } } }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_low_weight key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_output_low_weight_live_worker_live }
					add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_low_weight_ready key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 1 }
				}
			}
			else_if = { limit = { NOT = { exists = market } } add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_price_valid key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 3 } }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_price_factor key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building.eu5ab_output_price_factor_live_worker_live }
			add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_worker_screen_output_price_factor_ready key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

                            limit = {
                                building_level >= 1
                            }
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                add_to_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_worker_screen_replaces_existing
                                    key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                                    value = 2
                                }
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    building_type = {
                                        employment_size > 0
                                    }
                                }
                                scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                    add_to_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_worker_screen_replaces_capacity
                                        key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                                        value = 2
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                building_type = building_type:weapon_guild
                            }
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                set_local_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_map_write_value
                                    value = {
                                        value = 0
                                        if = {
                                            limit = {
                                                NOT = {
                                                    NOT = {
                                                        AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                                            name = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs
                                                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                                                        } } }
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                            add = "variable_map(eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs|scope:eu5ab_candidate_building)"
                                        }
                                        max = 0
                                    }
                                }
                                add_to_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs
                                    key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                                    value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        building_type:winery_manufactory = {
            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_worker_screen_active
                        NOT = {
                            AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs_ready trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs_ready } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                name = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs_ready
                                target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                            } } }
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_worker_screen_replaces_existing
                        key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        value = 1
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_worker_screen_replaces_capacity
                        key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        value = 1
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs
                        key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        value = 0.16
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs_ready
                        key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                        value = 1
                    }
                    every_buildings_in_location = {
                        limit = {
                            OR = {
                                building_type = building_type:winery
                            }
                            eu5ab_upgrade_source_available = yes
                            building_can_be_upgraded_by = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.owner
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                building_level >= 1
                            }
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                add_to_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_worker_screen_replaces_existing
                                    key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                                    value = 2
                                }
                            }
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    building_type = {
                                        employment_size > 0
                                    }
                                }
                                scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                    add_to_variable_map = {
                                        name = eu5ab_worker_screen_replaces_capacity
                                        key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                                        value = 2
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                building_type = building_type:winery
                            }
                            scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                                set_local_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_map_write_value
                                    value = {
                                        value = 0
                                        if = {
                                            limit = {
                                                NOT = {
                                                    NOT = {
                                                        AND = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs trigger_if = { limit = { has_variable_map = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs } is_key_in_variable_map = {
                                                            name = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs
                                                            target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                                                        } } }
                                                    }
                                                }
                                            }
                                            add = "variable_map(eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs|scope:eu5ab_candidate_building)"
                                        }
                                        max = 0.06
                                    }
                                }
                                add_to_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_worker_screen_net_new_jobs
                                    key = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                                    value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Manual console: effect eu5ab_probe_scan_start/snapshot/stop = yes
eu5ab_probe_scan_stop = {
    remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_sp_locations
        remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_worker_runs
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_ordinary_calls
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_input_calls
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_input_reuse
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_input_native
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_ordinary_visits
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_input_visits
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_ordinary_repeat
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_input_repeat
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_input_overlap
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_workforce_calls
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_workforce_off
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_workforce_hit
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_workforce_live
        remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_country
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_sp_ordinary_seen
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_sp_input_seen
    }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_sp_locations
    remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_callbacks
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_accepted
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_screened
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_capacity_callbacks
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_merged
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_screen_early_rejected
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_screen_passed
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_screen_score_calls
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_quote_reference_calls
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_quote_production_calls
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_quote_output_calls
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_quote_input_calls
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_quote_economy_calls
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_owner
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_context
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_ticket
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_fields
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_ready
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_unrequested
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_guard_pass
remove_variable = eu5ab_sp_merge_batches

eu5ab_probe_scan_start = {
    eu5ab_probe_scan_stop = yes
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_sp_start_country
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_callbacks value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_accepted value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_screened value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_capacity_callbacks value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_merged value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_screen_early_rejected value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_screen_passed value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_screen_score_calls value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_reference_calls value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_production_calls value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_output_calls value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_input_calls value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_quote_economy_calls value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_owner value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_context value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_ticket value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_fields value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_ready value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_unrequested value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_guard_pass value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_merge_batches value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_merge_current value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_merge_max value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_windows value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_busy_windows value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_windows_ge_16 value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_windows_ge_64 value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_callbacks value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_accepted value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_screened value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_capacity_callbacks value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_merged value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_max_callbacks value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_max_accepted value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_max_screened value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_max_capacity_callbacks value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_max_merged value = 0 }
    set_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled
    every_owned_location = {
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_country value = scope:eu5ab_sp_start_country }
        scope:eu5ab_sp_start_country = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_sp_locations target = prev } }
    }
    debug_log = EU5AB_SCAN_STARTED_V1
    debug_log_date = yes
}
eu5ab_probe_scan_trace = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_trace_left value = 32 }
        debug_log = EU5AB_SCAN_TRACE_NEXT_32_BUSY_GUI_WINDOWS
    }
}
eu5ab_probe_scan_flush_window = {
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_max_callbacks value = {
        value = var:eu5ab_sp_max_callbacks min = var:eu5ab_sp_window_callbacks } }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_max_accepted value = {
        value = var:eu5ab_sp_max_accepted min = var:eu5ab_sp_window_accepted } }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_max_screened value = {
        value = var:eu5ab_sp_max_screened min = var:eu5ab_sp_window_screened } }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_max_capacity_callbacks value = {
        value = var:eu5ab_sp_max_capacity_callbacks min = var:eu5ab_sp_window_capacity_callbacks } }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_max_merged value = {
        value = var:eu5ab_sp_max_merged min = var:eu5ab_sp_window_merged } }
    if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_sp_window_callbacks >= 16 } if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_windows_ge_16 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_windows_ge_16 add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_windows_ge_16 value = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_sp_window_callbacks >= 64 } if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_windows_ge_64 } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_windows_ge_64 add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_windows_ge_64 value = 1 } } }
    if = { limit = { OR = { var:eu5ab_sp_window_callbacks > 0 var:eu5ab_sp_window_accepted > 0 var:eu5ab_sp_window_screened > 0 var:eu5ab_sp_window_capacity_callbacks > 0 var:eu5ab_sp_window_merged > 0 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_busy_windows } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_busy_windows add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_busy_windows value = 1 } }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_trace_left var:eu5ab_sp_trace_left > 0 }
            debug_log = EU5AB_SCAN_GUI_WINDOW_BEGIN
            debug_log_date = yes
            debug_log = EU5AB_SCAN_WINDOW_NUMBER
    set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_read value = var:eu5ab_sp_windows }
    local_var:eu5ab_sp_read = { debug_log_scopes = no }
            debug_log = EU5AB_SCAN_WINDOW_CALLBACKS
    set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_read value = var:eu5ab_sp_window_callbacks }
    local_var:eu5ab_sp_read = { debug_log_scopes = no }
debug_log = EU5AB_SCAN_WINDOW_ACCEPTED
    set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_read value = var:eu5ab_sp_window_accepted }
    local_var:eu5ab_sp_read = { debug_log_scopes = no }
debug_log = EU5AB_SCAN_WINDOW_SCREENED
    set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_read value = var:eu5ab_sp_window_screened }
    local_var:eu5ab_sp_read = { debug_log_scopes = no }
debug_log = EU5AB_SCAN_WINDOW_CAPACITY_CALLBACKS
    set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_read value = var:eu5ab_sp_window_capacity_callbacks }
    local_var:eu5ab_sp_read = { debug_log_scopes = no }
debug_log = EU5AB_SCAN_WINDOW_MERGED
    set_local_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_read value = var:eu5ab_sp_window_merged }
    local_var:eu5ab_sp_read = { debug_log_scopes = no }
            debug_log = EU5AB_SCAN_GUI_WINDOW_END
            change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_trace_left subtract = 1 }
        }
    }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_callbacks value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_accepted value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_screened value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_capacity_callbacks value = 0 }
set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_merged value = 0 }
}
eu5ab_probe_scan_pulse = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_windows } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_windows add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_windows value = 1 } }
        eu5ab_probe_scan_flush_window = yes
    }
}

eu5ab_probe_scan_quote = {
if = { limit = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_enabled } }
scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_callbacks } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_callbacks add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_callbacks value = 1 } } if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_window_callbacks } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_callbacks add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_window_callbacks value = 1 } } }
}
if = { limit = { NOT = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country } }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_owner } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_owner add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_owner value = 1 } } } }
else_if = { limit = { NOT = { eu5ab_quote_context_current = yes } }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_context } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_context add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_context value = 1 } } } }
else_if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { exists = scope:eu5ab_quote_ticket } NOT = { scope:eu5ab_quote_ticket = var:eu5ab_quote_ticket } } }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_ticket } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_ticket add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_ticket value = 1 } } } }
else_if = { limit = { OR = { NOT = { exists = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } NOT = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_cost } NOT = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_income } NOT = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_profit } NOT = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_province_food_balance } NOT = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_province_food_natural } NOT = { exists = scope:eu5ab_engine_rgo_revenue } } }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_fields } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_fields add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_fields value = 1 } } } }
else_if = { limit = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_ready_types target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_ready } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_ready add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_ready value = 1 } } } }
else_if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_quote_requests target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building } } }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_reject_unrequested } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_unrequested add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_reject_unrequested value = 1 } } } }
else = { scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_sp_guard_pass } change_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_guard_pass add = 1 } }
else = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_sp_guard_pass value = 1 } } } }
}

eu5ab_batch_issue_live = { if = { limit = { eu5ab_manual_physical_calendar = yes }
            if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_approved } set_variable = eu5ab_manual_dispatch_started }

    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_approved
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_id
            value = this
        }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            eu5ab_batch_select_context = yes
            if = {
                limit = {
                    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = 2
                }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        has_variable = eu5ab_q_active
                        eu5ab_queue_calendar_open = yes
                        NOT = {
                            has_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load
                        }
                        has_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema
                        eu5ab_global_budget_remaining_value > 0
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                            owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                        }
                        gold >= {
                            value = eu5ab_batch_planned_value
                            add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_batch_status
                        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                        value = 3
                    }
                    set_variable = {
                        name = eu5ab_q_seen
                        value = {
                            value = 0
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    has_variable = eu5ab_q_seen
                                }
                                add = var:eu5ab_q_seen
                            }
                            add = 1
                        }
                    }
                    scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                        eu5ab_batch_restore_quote = yes
                        set_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_q_type_queue_before
                            value = eu5ab_candidate_queued_levels
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_q_type_level_before
                            value = eu5ab_candidate_completed_levels
                        }
                        set_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_q_approved_build_kind
                            value = eu5ab_batch_quote_kind
                        }
                        eu5ab_pf_capture_start_geometry = yes
                        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                            add_to_variable_map = {
                                name = eu5ab_batch_queue_before
                                key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_candidate_queued_levels
                            }
                            add_to_variable_map = {
                                name = eu5ab_batch_levels_before
                                key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                                value = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_candidate_completed_levels
                            }
                        }
                        set_local_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_gold_before
                            value = owner.gold
                        }
                        construct_building = {
                            building_type = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                            cost_multiplier = 1
                            instant = no
                            owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                            payer = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                        }
                        set_local_variable = {
                            name = eu5ab_batch_debit
                            value = {
                                value = local_var:eu5ab_batch_gold_before
                                subtract = owner.gold
                                min = 0
                            }
                        }
                        if = {
                            limit = {
                                OR = {
                                    eu5ab_candidate_queued_levels > "scope:eu5ab_engine_country.variable_map(eu5ab_batch_queue_before|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
                                    eu5ab_candidate_completed_levels > "scope:eu5ab_engine_country.variable_map(eu5ab_batch_levels_before|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
                                }
                            }
                            eu5ab_record_confirmed_building = yes
                            eu5ab_pf_confirm_start = yes
                            eu5ab_record_queue_start_location = yes
                            eu5ab_batch_slots_commit = yes
                            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                                add_to_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_debit
                                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                                    value = local_var:eu5ab_batch_debit
                                }
                                add_to_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_status
                                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                                    value = 4
                                }
                                set_local_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_budget_charge
                                    value = local_var:eu5ab_batch_debit
                                }
                                eu5ab_charge_annual_budget = yes
                                eu5ab_batch_release = yes
                                set_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
                                    value = {
                                        value = 0
                                        if = {
                                            limit = {
                                                has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
                                            }
                                            add = var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
                                        }
                                        add = 1
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                            set_variable = eu5ab_action_taken
                            set_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_started
                            remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown
                            if = {
                                limit = {
                                    NOT = {
                                        eu5ab_batch_quote_kind = 4
                                    }
                                }
                                add_to_variable_list = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_consumed_types
                                    target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_building
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else = {
                            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                                eu5ab_batch_fail = yes
                            }
                        }
                        eu5ab_clear_recipe_score_snapshot = yes
                        remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_quote_restored
                        remove_local_variable = eu5ab_batch_gold_before
                        remove_local_variable = eu5ab_batch_debit
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    eu5ab_batch_withdraw = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
    eu5ab_batch_confirm = yes
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_pool
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_id
            value = this
        }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = 8
                }
                add_to_variable_map = {
                    name = eu5ab_batch_status
                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                    value = 1
                }
            }
        }
    }
} }

                                OR = {
                                    num_civil_constructions > "scope:eu5ab_engine_country.variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_queue_before|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
                                    rgo_level > "scope:eu5ab_engine_country.variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_level_before|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
                                }
                            }
                            eu5ab_record_queue_start_location = yes
                            eu5ab_record_rgo_start = yes
                            eu5ab_batch_slots_commit = yes
                            set_variable = eu5ab_active_rgo_construction
                            set_variable = eu5ab_action_taken
                            remove_variable = eu5ab_failure_cooldown
                            owner = {
                                add_to_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status
                                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                                    value = 4
                                }
                                add_to_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_debit
                                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                                    value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_paid_cost
                                }
                                set_local_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_budget_charge
                                    value = local_var:eu5ab_rgo_paid_cost
                                }
                                eu5ab_charge_annual_budget = yes
                                set_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
                                    value = {
                                        value = 0
                                        if = {
                                            limit = {
                                                has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
                                            }
                                            add = var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick
                                        }
                                        add = 1
                                    }
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick
                                    value = {
                                        value = 0
                                        if = {
                                            limit = {
                                                has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick
                                            }
                                            add = var:eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick
                                        }
                                        add = 1
                                    }
                                }
                                if = {
                                    limit = {
                                        NOT = {
                                            is_target_in_variable_list = {
                                                name = eu5ab_active_project_locations
                                                target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location
                                            }
                                        }
                                    }
                                    add_to_variable_list = {
                                        name = eu5ab_active_project_locations
                                        target = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location
                                    }
                                }
                                eu5ab_batch_rgo_release = yes
                                set_local_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_map_write_value
                                    value = {
                                        value = eu5ab_batch_market_generation_value
                                        add = 1
                                    }
                                }
                                add_to_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_market_generation
                                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_market
                                    value = local_var:eu5ab_map_write_value
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else = {
                            owner = {
                                eu5ab_batch_rgo_withdraw = yes
                                add_to_variable_map = {
                                    name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status
                                    key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                                    value = 5
                                }
                                set_variable = {
                                    name = eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla
                                    value = {
                                        value = 0
                                        if = {
                                            limit = {
                                                has_variable = eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla
                                            }
                                            add = var:eu5ab_diag_fail_vanilla
                                        }
                                        add = 1
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_output
                        remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_level
                        remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue
                        remove_variable = eu5ab_rgo_start_queue_known
                        remove_local_variable = eu5ab_rgo_gold_before
                        remove_local_variable = eu5ab_rgo_paid_cost
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    eu5ab_batch_rgo_withdraw = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
    eu5ab_batch_rgo_confirm = yes
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_deferred
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_id
            value = this
        }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            if = {
                limit = {
                    "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_status|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = 8
                }
                eu5ab_batch_rgo_context = yes
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = {
                            owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country
                            eu5ab_batch_slots_value > 0
                        }
                        gold >= {
                            value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_cost|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)"
                            add = scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_current_min_cash_reserve
                        }
                    }
                    add_to_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status
                        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                        value = 1
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    add_to_variable_map = {
                        name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status
                        key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id
                        value = 7
                    }
                    eu5ab_batch_rgo_remove = yes
                }
            }
        }
    }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_rgo_deferred
    every_in_list = {
        variable = eu5ab_batch_rgo_dirty
        save_scope_value_as = {
            name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_group
            value = this
        }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            eu5ab_batch_rgo_refresh_group = yes
        }
    }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_rgo_dirty
} }
eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue_live = {
    eu5ab_clear_queue_bridge = yes
    if = { limit = { has_variable_list = eu5ab_q_approved_locations } eu5ab_settle_saved_approvals = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick }
		set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_previous_month_added value = var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick }
	}
	if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_rgo_quota_used value = var:eu5ab_rgo_started_this_tick } }
	# Reconstruct the round result from confirmed starts, including saved rounds.
	set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 2 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick } if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick > 0 } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_built_this_run value = 1 } } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { var:eu5ab_diag_queue_state = 5 } } set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_queue_state value = 4 } }
	eu5ab_settle_scan_candidate_batch = yes
	eu5ab_clear_engine_candidate_queue = yes
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_scan_refill_active } } eu5ab_reset_committed_construction_demand = yes }
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_active
	remove_variable = eu5ab_q_fire
	# Keep phase/expected/tick counters as harmless sentinels until the next
	# prepare call; an already-scheduled GUI animation may finish one frame late.
}

eu5ab_manual_expire = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_year NOT = { eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes } }
        eu5ab_manual_discard = yes eu5ab_sync_cmm_settings = yes eu5ab_refresh_global_budget = yes
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_event_open has_variable = eu5ab_manual_event_started }
            set_variable = eu5ab_manual_expired set_variable = eu5ab_manual_ready }
    }
}
eu5ab_manual_begin = {
    if = { limit = { eu5ab_manual_allowed = yes has_variable = eu5ab_manual_event_open
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_event_started } }
        save_scope_as = actor save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country save_scope_as = eu5ab_scan_country
        eu5ab_manual_discard = yes
        # No native orders can have started before the date gate.
        eu5ab_clear_engine_candidate_queue = yes eu5ab_clear_scan_continuation = yes
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country }
            eu5ab_clear_location_worker_state = yes eu5ab_clear_location_candidate_state = yes }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
        remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_active remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_finalizing
        remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load
        eu5ab_sync_cmm_settings = yes eu5ab_refresh_global_budget = yes
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { remove_variable = eu5ab_manual_saved_eu5ab_tpl_1_preset_origin }
scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_tpl_1_preset_origin }
    scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_manual_saved_eu5ab_tpl_1_preset_origin value = scope:eu5ab_engine_country.var:eu5ab_tpl_1_preset_origin } } } }
scope:eu5ab_engine_country = { remove_variable = eu5ab_manual_saved_eu5ab_tpl_1_paused }

eu5ab_manual_remember_buildings = {
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_batch_approved save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_batch_id value = this }
        scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
            add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_manual_plan target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id }
            add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_manual_plan_kind key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id value = 1 }
            add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_status key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id value = 9 }
            eu5ab_batch_select_context = yes
            # Preserve expansion behavior, consuming a distinct ID and slot.
            if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_kind = 4 scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_slots_value > 0
                eu5ab_batch_reserved_value < var:eu5ab_monthly_build_quota
                eu5ab_batch_planned_value < eu5ab_global_budget_remaining_value }
                scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_location }
                scope:eu5ab_candidate_building = { save_scope_as = eu5ab_batch_refresh_type }
                scope:eu5ab_candidate_location = { eu5ab_batch_refresh_quote_pending = yes }
                if = { limit = { scope:eu5ab_candidate_location.eu5ab_batch_quote_pending_open > 0 } eu5ab_batch_add_candidate = yes }
            }
        }
    }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_approved
}

eu5ab_manual_finish = {
    # All phases reached a real terminal condition, not a GUI timeout.
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country save_scope_as = eu5ab_manual_copy
    # Zero is also persisted by the engine; do not rely on has_variable alone
    # to publish completion. Preserve genuine no-coverage/quota/eligible states.
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_diag_run_state } }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_run_state value = 5 } }
    else_if = { limit = { var:eu5ab_diag_run_state = 0 }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_diag_run_state value = 5 } }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_manual_count value = eu5ab_batch_reserved_value }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_manual_cost value = eu5ab_batch_planned_value }
    scope:eu5ab_manual_copy = { remove_variable = eu5ab_manual_saved_eu5ab_batch_backfill_added }
scope:eu5ab_manual_copy = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_added }
    scope:eu5ab_manual_copy = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_manual_saved_eu5ab_batch_backfill_added value = scope:eu5ab_manual_copy.var:eu5ab_batch_backfill_added } } } }
scope:eu5ab_manual_copy = { remove_variable = eu5ab_manual_saved_eu5ab_batch_backfill_country }

scope:eu5ab_manual_copy = { if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_batch_backfill_exhausted }
    scope:eu5ab_manual_copy = { set_variable = { name = eu5ab_manual_saved_eu5ab_batch_backfill_exhausted value = scope:eu5ab_manual_copy.var:eu5ab_batch_backfill_exhausted } } } }
scope:eu5ab_manual_copy = { remove_variable = eu5ab_manual_saved_eu5ab_batch_backfill_phase }

eu5ab_manual_recover = {
    # No day must pass for pending GUI reads to resume behind the native event.
    save_scope_as = actor save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
    remove_variable = eu5ab_scan_resume_after_load remove_variable = eu5ab_batch_running
    if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_computing }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_worker_pending_locations
            limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_worker_complete } }
            eu5ab_request_building_capacity = yes }
        eu5ab_clear_queue_bridge = yes
        if = { limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_q_active }
            set_variable = eu5ab_bridge_rebuild eu5ab_dispatch_construction_batch = yes }
        else = { eu5ab_reduce_capacity_batch = yes }
    }
}
eu5ab_manual_execute = {
    if = { limit = { is_human = yes eu5ab_manual_month_current = yes
        eu5ab_manual_date_allowed = no has_variable = eu5ab_manual_ready
        NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_manual_executed } }
        save_scope_as = actor save_scope_as = eu5ab_engine_country
        set_variable = eu5ab_manual_executed set_variable = eu5ab_manual_dispatch_started
        eu5ab_manual_restore_scope = yes
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_manual_locations limit = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country } eu5ab_manual_restore_scope = yes }
        set_variable = eu5ab_batch_schema set_variable = eu5ab_q_active
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_constructions_started_this_tick value = 0 }
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_manual_plan save_scope_value_as = { name = eu5ab_batch_id value = this }
            scope:eu5ab_engine_country = {
                clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_approved clear_variable_list = eu5ab_batch_rgo_approved
                set_variable = { name = eu5ab_batch_reserved value = 1 }
                if = { limit = { "variable_map(eu5ab_manual_plan_kind|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_phase|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" }
                    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_batch_planned value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_cost|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" }
                    add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_status key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id value = 2 }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_batch_approved target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id }
                    if = { limit = { "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_location|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country } }
                        eu5ab_batch_issue_live = yes }
                    else = { add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_status key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id value = 7 } }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_q_phase value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_phase|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" }
                    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_batch_planned value = "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_cost|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" }
                    add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id value = 2 }
                    add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_approved target = scope:eu5ab_batch_id }
                    if = { limit = { "variable_map(eu5ab_batch_rgo_location|scope:eu5ab_batch_id)" = { owner = scope:eu5ab_engine_country } }
                        eu5ab_batch_rgo_issue_live = yes }
                    else = { add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_batch_rgo_status key = scope:eu5ab_batch_id value = 7 } }
                }
            }
        }
        eu5ab_finish_engine_candidate_queue_live = yes
    }
}

eu5ab_profile_ensure_identity = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_profile_token } }
        if = { limit = { has_global_variable = eu5ab_profile_next_token }
            change_global_variable = { name = eu5ab_profile_next_token add = 1 } }
        else = { set_global_variable = { name = eu5ab_profile_next_token value = 1 } }
        set_variable = { name = eu5ab_profile_token value = global_var:eu5ab_profile_next_token }
    }
}

    scope:eu5ab_profile_target = { add_to_variable_map = { name = eu5ab_profile_cmm key = scope:eu5ab_state_key
        value = "scope:eu5ab_profile_source.variable_map(eu5ab_profile_cmm|scope:eu5ab_state_key)" } } } }
            set_variable = eu5ab_profile_pending
        }
        else = { eu5ab_profile_capture = yes }
        clear_variable_list = eu5ab_profile_countries
        scope:old_country = { every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_profile_countries save_scope_as = eu5ab_profile_country
            scope:eu5ab_profile_target = { add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_profile_countries target = scope:eu5ab_profile_country } } } }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_profile_countries target = scope:old_country }
    }
}
eu5ab_profile_remember_location = {
    # Called only when this location is registered to its current owner.
    owner = { eu5ab_profile_ensure_identity = yes }
    set_variable = { name = eu5ab_profile_data_token value = owner.var:eu5ab_profile_token }
    save_scope_as = eu5ab_profile_location
    owner = { if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = {
        name = eu5ab_profile_locations target = scope:eu5ab_profile_location } } }
        add_to_variable_list = { name = eu5ab_profile_locations target = scope:eu5ab_profile_location } } }
}
eu5ab_profile_clear_owned_state = {
    # Caller has verified that this country belongs to the requesting player.
    # Lost locations require both an explicit registration and its profile stamp.
    # A new human owner, or a newer registration to another Tag, excludes them.
    every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_profile_locations
        limit = { has_variable = eu5ab_profile_data_token
            var:eu5ab_profile_data_token = scope:eu5ab_profile_target.var:eu5ab_profile_token
            OR = { owner = scope:eu5ab_profile_target owner = { is_human = no } } }
        eu5ab_profile_clear_scope = yes remove_variable = eu5ab_profile_data_token
    }
    every_owned_location = { eu5ab_profile_clear_scope = yes remove_variable = eu5ab_profile_data_token }
    clear_variable_list = eu5ab_profile_locations
    eu5ab_profile_clear_scope = yes
}

eu5ab_profile_reset = {
    if = { limit = { is_human = yes }
        save_scope_as = eu5ab_profile_target
        eu5ab_profile_ensure_identity = yes
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = eu5ab_profile_pending } }
            eu5ab_sync_cmm_settings = yes
            save_scope_as = eu5ab_profile_source eu5ab_profile_capture = yes
        }
        # Do not clear a former Tag now controlled by a different human.
        every_in_list = { variable = eu5ab_profile_countries
            limit = { is_human = no NOT = { this = scope:eu5ab_profile_target }
                var:eu5ab_profile_token = scope:eu5ab_profile_target.var:eu5ab_profile_token }
            eu5ab_profile_clear_owned_state = yes
            remove_from_variable_map = { name = cmm key = flag:eu5ab_regional_development__enabled }
